entities.visual_description: A large lion has a golden-brown coat with a white underbelly. Its face is round with a dark mane around the neck. Bright, expressive eyes and a strong, muscular build show its power. Thick, dark whiskers frame its mouth.

A big tiger has a golden-brown coat with black stripes. Its face is round with dark eyes. It has a long tail with a black tip. Its body is muscular and strong. It has sharp teeth and big paws. Its fur is thick and shiny.

A large elephant with a long, curved trunk, big floppy ears, and thick legs. Its body is covered in wrinkled, gray skin. It has a wide, flat head and a long tail with a tuft at the end. Eyes are small and dark.
A tall giraffe with a long neck and legs, spotted brown and white coat, large dark eyes, and a long tongue. It stands on slender legs, head tilted up, looking around with a gentle expression.

A zebra has a black and white striped body. Its stripes are unique, like a pattern on its skin. It has a long neck and a small head. Its eyes are large and dark. It stands on strong legs with hooves. Its tail is long and ends in a black tip.

A large rhinoceros has a thick, dark brown body with wrinkled skin. It has a broad, flat face with two horns on its nose. Its eyes are small and dark, and it has a short tail and sturdy legs. The animal moves slowly with a heavy, powerful gait.

A large hippopotamus has thick, gray skin with wrinkled folds. It has big, round eyes and a wide mouth with large teeth. Its body is heavy and short, with strong legs and a wide snout. The animal stands in water, showing its massive, muscular form.

A cheetah has a slender body with a golden-tan coat, long legs, and a small head. It has a distinctive black tear mark down each cheek, a long tail with a black tip, and large nostrils. Its eyes are round and dark, with a white spot on the forehead.

A leopard has a spotted coat with dark rosettes and a lighter underbelly. Its body is muscular and sleek, with a short tail and powerful legs. Large, round eyes and a sharp nose make it instantly recognizable.

A hyena has a large, muscular body with a distinctive sagittal crest on its head. Its face is wide and flat with sharp teeth. It has long, thick legs and a bushy tail. Its fur is short and sandy brown, with a lighter underbelly. Dark stripes run down its back and sides.

A large wolf has a thick, fluffy gray coat with a white underbelly. Its face is narrow with a pointed snout, and dark eyes. Sharp teeth and a bushy tail complete its look. Long legs and a muscular build show its power.

A red fox has a fluffy tail, pointed ears, and a slender body. Its fur is orange with a white chest and black tip on the tail. Sharp black eyes and a snout with a black nose make it easily recognizable.

A large brown bear has a thick, fluffy fur coat in shades of brown and black. Its round face has small, dark eyes and a short, snout. Big paws with sharp claws and a bushy tail complete its sturdy, wild appearance.

A giant panda has a round, fluffy body with thick white fur. Its face is black with small round eyes and a black nose. Large black patches cover its ears and shoulders. It has short, sturdy legs and a bushy tail. Its paws are round with black claws.

A kangaroo has a long, muscular body, a round belly, and powerful hind legs. Its tail is thick and bushy, used for balance. It has a short, pointed snout and large, round eyes. Its fur is grayish-brown with a lighter underbelly.

A fluffy koala has thick, gray fur with a white belly. Its round face has large black eyes and a small nose. It has strong limbs with sharp claws and a long, bushy tail. Its ears are rounded and dark.

A large gorilla with a thick, dark brown fur coat. Broad shoulders and a strong, muscular build. Big, round eyes with white pupils. A prominent, curved nose. Thick, black eyebrows. A wide, heavy face with a mouth open slightly. Short, stubby fingers and toes.

A chimpanzee has a dark, fur-covered body with a prominent face. Its large, round eyes stand out, and a thick, bushy tail swings behind. Strong limbs and a broad chest show its power. Black fur covers most of its body, with lighter patches on the face and chest.

A camel has a long neck, hump on its back, thick legs, and a large head with big eyes. Its body is covered in thick, coarse fur, and it has a long, curved neck. It stands on sturdy legs and has a wide mouth with large teeth. Its tail is long and hairy.

A deer has a slender body, long legs, and a graceful neck. Its antlers branch out from the head, and its tail is short and bushy. Large, expressive eyes and a soft, velvety nose stand out. The fur is brown with white markings on the face and chest.

subcategories.visual_description: A big brown bear stands on its hind legs, front paws raised, fur thick and dark. Large round eyes, a short snout, and a bushy tail. Strong legs and a wide body. Black nose and dark claws.

entities.visual_description: A large cow with a brown coat, wide body, and curved horns. Its face has dark eyes, a moist nose, and a mouth with a wide mouth. It has a tail hanging down and four legs with hooves.

A large bull with a thick, muscular body. Its head is broad with a curved horn. Short, dark coat with a white face. Strong, sturdy legs. Wide, heavy horns curve backward. Dark eyes and a broad, powerful neck.

A small calf with soft, brown fur, floppy ears, and large, dark eyes. It has a short tail and sturdy legs. Its face is round with a gentle expression. The body is plump and covered in fine, short hair.

A pink pig with a rounded body, short legs, and a snout. It has floppy ears, a tail, and a belly. Its eyes are small and black. The skin is smooth and slightly wrinkled. It stands on four legs with hooves.

A large boar with a thick, coarse black coat, wide snout, and tusks. Short legs, sturdy body, and a wrinkled face. Dark eyes, and a tail that swishes back and forth. Spots or stripes may be present on the body.

A fluffy white sheep with broad, rounded ears and a gentle face. Its body is thick and soft, with a short tail and small legs. Large, dark eyes and a curved horn on its head make it instantly recognizable as a sheep.

A fluffy white lamb with soft, pink ears and a tiny tail. Its body is round and covered in thick, white wool. Large, gentle eyes and a small, pink nose. Legs are short and sturdy. Overall, it looks cute and peaceful.

A small goat with curved horns, a floppy face, and a short tail. Its body is covered in brown fur with white markings on the face and legs. Large, expressive eyes and a gentle expression make it look friendly and approachable.

A large, sturdy horse with a brown coat, thick mane, and tail. Its eyes are bright and alert, with a gentle expression. The body is muscular, and the legs are strong. A white stripe runs down its nose.

A large, sturdy donkey with a thick, coarse coat. Its long ears are floppy and dark, with a small, curved horn on each side. The body is muscular, with a broad back and strong legs. A short tail swishes behind, and its face has a gentle, expressive look with dark, alert eyes.

A chicken has a small, round body with feathers in brown, white, and black. It has a beak, two eyes, and a waddle. Its wings are folded, and it has a tail with feathers. The legs are short and covered in feathers.

A rooster stands tall with a red comb on its head. Its feathers are bright gold and black, with a long tail. It has a strong beak and sharp eyes. Its legs are yellow and strong. A crown of feathers sits on its head.

A plump hen with a yellow beak and orange cheeks. Her body is covered in brown feathers, with a white belly. She has a red comb on her head and small, dark eyes. Her wings are folded, and her legs are short and sturdy.

A duck has a short, rounded body with webbed feet. Its head is small with a flat bill. It has a fluffy neck and a tail that flaps when it walks. Its feathers are mostly brown and white, with a dark back. Eyes are black and round. It waddles and quacks.

A fluffy white goose with a dark brown neck and head. Its wings are broad and slightly curved, with short, rounded feathers. Bright orange beak and black eyes. Small, webbed feet with yellow claws. A short, curved tail.

A turkey has a large, plump body with soft feathers in brown, black, and white. It has a small head with a red, fleshy comb on top, a beak, and small eyes. Its legs are strong with spurs, and it walks with a waddling gait.

A fluffy white rabbit with long ears and a short, round body. Large black eyes, a pink nose, and a bushy tail. Soft fur covers its body, and it has four small, strong legs. Its ears are floppy and stand straight up.

A water buffalo has a large, thick body with a short, curved horn on its head. Its skin is dark brown with a white patch on the neck. It has big, wide horns and a long tail. Its eyes are small and dark. It stands on strong, sturdy legs.

A fluffy alpaca has a thick, wooly coat in light brown and white. Its face is round with small, dark eyes and a short, straight nose. It has straight, slender legs and a short tail. Its ears are small and rounded, and its body is stocky with a gentle, calm expression.

A fluffy llama with a long, slender body. It has a thick, wooly coat, a small head with big, alert eyes, and a curved neck. Its legs are sturdy and short, with hooves. A long tail swishes behind, and it carries a small, curved horn on its head.

subcategories.visual_description: A big brown cow stands on four legs, head up, horns curved outward. Its body is thick and short, with a long tail swishing. Large black spots cover its body. It has wide, soft eyes and a wide mouth with a pink nose.

entities.visual_description: A large bird with a brown body, white underparts, and a dark head. Sharp, hooked beak and strong legs. Broad wings with dark and light feathers. Eagle eyes are bright and focused. Feathers on the head and neck are dark and sleek.

A bright green parrot with a yellow head and red tail feathers. It has a curved beak, small black eyes, and wings with green and blue patterns. Its body is plump, and it stands on two legs with clawed feet.

A large owl with round, yellow eyes and soft feathers. Its face is covered in dark, fluffy down. It has a small beak and short legs. The wings are broad and covered in white and gray feathers. The body is plump and covered in dark, mottled feathers.

A penguin has black and white feathers, a short beak, and a fluffy belly. It stands upright on wobbly legs, with flippers for swimming. Its eyes are black and round, and it has a stubby tail. The body is round and compact, with a distinctive black head and white chest.

Small bird with brown and white streaked feathers, a slender body, and a short tail. Black eyes and a beak. Wingspan about 10 inches. Feathers show subtle gray and brown patterns. Bright yellow legs and feet. Short, pointed wings.

A small bird with gray feathers, a plump body, and a short neck. It has a distinctive white patch on its wings and a dark head with a light stripe. Its beak is short and pink, and its eyes are dark and round. It stands on one leg, wings slightly spread.

A crow has a sleek black body with shiny feathers. Its head is round with a sharp, pointed beak. Bright yellow eyes stand out against the dark. Long wings and a straight neck make it easily recognizable. It stands tall with a strong, sturdy posture.
A large white bird with long neck and broad wings. Its body is covered in smooth, shiny white feathers. It has a black beak and dark eyes. The tail is long and pointed. It stands on one leg in water.

A bright pink flamingo stands on one leg, neck curved, head tilted. Long, slender legs and a sharp beak. Feathers are soft pink with white and black accents. Eyes are dark, and the body is slender with a distinctive pink color.

A peacock has bright blue and green feathers with eye-like patterns. Its tail is long and fan-shaped, covered in shimmering feathers. The body is sleek, with a golden neck and dark wings. It stands tall with a proud posture.

A woodpecker has a black and white striped head, a red cap, and a long, chisel-like beak. Its body is brown with white spots, and it has short legs and strong claws. It wiggles its tail feathers while pecking.

A falcon has a slender body, sharp beak, and hooked claws. Its wings are long and pointed, with dark feathers. Bright eyes stand out, and the neck is short with a small head. Feathers are mostly dark with lighter markings. It has a strong, streamlined look.

A hawk has a sharp, pointed beak, dark eyes, and strong, curved claws. Its wings are broad and powerful, with feathers in brown and gray. The body is streamlined, and the tail is long and narrow. It has a distinctive, alert posture and a loud, piercing call.
A large white bird with a long, hooked beak and a big, pouchy throat. It has gray wings and a long tail. Its eyes are dark and sharp. It stands on one leg, holding a fish in its beak.

A seagull has a white body with a gray back, a sharp black beak, and bright yellow eyes. Its wings are long and pointed, with dark tips. It stands on one leg, feathers fluffed, and looks alert, ready to fly.

A large ostrich stands tall with long legs and a thick neck. Its body is covered in dark brown feathers, and it has a distinctive black and white face with a prominent beak. Two long, black eyelashes frame bright, alert eyes.

A bright yellow canary with a slender body and long tail feathers. Its wings are folded, showing a smooth, rounded shape. Large, dark eyes stand out against its vibrant yellow color. A small, pointed beak and fluffy legs add to its delicate appearance.
A small bird with a red breast, dark wings, and a white belly. It has a slender body, a long tail, and a sharp, pointed beak. Its eyes are black, and it has a distinctive black cap on its head.

A small bird with bright green feathers, a long, slender beak, and fast wings. It has a short tail and a distinctive black chest. Its wings beat rapidly, creating a humming sound. Bright colors like red and orange on its throat.

A stork stands tall with long legs and a long neck. Its body is white with black wingtips. It has a red beak and bright red feet. Feathers are sleek and smooth. Wingspan is wide, with sharp, pointed wings. Eyes are dark and alert. It looks strong and graceful.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright yellow canary with a black mask around its eyes. Its wings are folded neatly, and its tail feathers spread slightly. Small black dots cover its body. It sits upright on a branch, head tilted slightly, beak open showing a tiny tongue.

entities.visual_description: A dolphin has a sleek, torpedo-shaped body with a smooth, shiny skin. It has a curved dorsal fin on its back and a triangular snout. Its eyes are round and black, with a white patch around them. It has a long, flexible tail fluke used for swimming.

A large whale has a smooth, dark blue body with white underbelly. It has a wide, curved mouth and a blowhole on top. Its tail fluke is broad and triangular. Small bumps cover its skin. Eyes are tiny and set high on the head.

A large shark has a streamlined, dark gray body with white underbelly. It has sharp, pointed teeth and two triangular fins. Its eyes are small and dark, and it has a long, pointed snout. The skin is rough and covered in scales.

A large octopus has eight tentacles with suction cups, a soft body, and a rounded head. Its skin is dark with patterns, and it has large, round eyes. The creature is flexible and can change color and texture.

A large squid has a long, soft body with ten arms and two longer tentacles. Its skin is dark purple with lighter patterns. It has large, round eyes and a wide mouth with sharp teeth. The body is flexible and can change color and texture.

A glowing jellyfish floats in water, translucent bell with trailing tentacles. Its body is soft and round, with a central mouth opening. Bright colors shimmer through its gelatinous skin, and it pulses gently as it moves.

A starfish has a round, flat body with five arms radiating out. Its skin is rough and spiky, with a soft, bumpy texture. Each arm has tiny tube feet. It is usually purple, orange, or brown. Eyes are small and located at the end of each arm.

A seahorse has a curled, horse-like body with a crown of bony rings. Its tail is spiraled and prehensile. It has large, round eyes and a snout shaped like a tiny nose. Its skin is covered in bony plates and comes in orange, brown, and yellow.

A seal has a thick, smooth fur coat in gray and white. Its round, dark eyes sit above a short snout. Large flippers help it swim, and a blunt nose is visible. Its body is stocky with a short tail. The skin is dark with a soft, fluffy texture.

A sea lion has a thick, dark fur coat with a lighter belly. Its round, wide head has large eyes and a short, blunt snout. Big flippers help it swim, and its body is sturdy with a streamlined shape. It has a short tail and strong limbs for moving on land.

A large walrus has thick, wrinkled skin, a prominent mustache, and big, round eyes. Its body is stocky with short legs, and it has a wide, flat snout. Two large tusks curve from its mouth. Its back is covered in short, coarse fur, and its flippers are wide and rounded.

A crab has a hard, shell-like body with ten legs. Its front legs are thick and clawed. It has two large eyes on top of its head. Its body is usually blue or green with patterns. It moves sideways on its legs.
A large lobster has a hard, thick shell in red and brown colors. Its tail is curled under, and it has long, powerful claws. Big, bulging eyes and thick legs make it look strong and ready to move.
A small, slender shrimp with a translucent, pink body. Long, segmented legs and a tail fan. Two large, bulging eyes. Thin, curved claws on each leg. Bright red and white stripes along the body.

A clam has a thick, oval shell with a rough, ridged surface. It is typically white or light brown with dark patterns. The shell opens slightly, revealing a soft, pink interior. Two siphons extend from the shell, and the animal is usually buried in sand or mud.

A small, oval-shaped shell with a rough, ridged surface. It has a dark, iridescent color with hints of green and purple. The opening is narrow with a frilly edge. Inside, a smooth, pearly interior glows faintly.

A coral has a branching, rock-like structure with soft, colorful polyps. It has a rough, textured surface with tiny holes. Its branches spread out in all directions. It is usually pink, orange, or white. It looks like a coral reef in the ocean.
A spiky, round sea urchin with a hard, bumpy shell. Bright red and orange spines stick out in all directions. Small, dark eyes are near the top. A soft, white underbelly shows through the shell.

Long, slim body with smooth, scaleless skin. Dark, mottled pattern of black and brown. Eyes small and round. Fins along the back and tail. Slithers through water with graceful movement. Has a pointed snout and a forked tongue.

A stingray has a flat, wide body with a rounded tail. Its skin is tough and covered in spines. It has large, triangular wings for swimming. Its eyes are small and set on the top of its head. It has a pointed snout and a mouth on the underside.

subcategories.visual_description: A big blue whale swims through the ocean, its long body covered in light gray patches. It has a wide mouth with tiny teeth, and a tall blowhole on top. Its tail flaps in the water as it moves.

entities.visual_description: A colorful butterfly with bright wings, orange and black stripes, delicate antennae, and a slender body. Its wings have intricate patterns and shimmer in the sunlight.

A small, buzzing insect with a golden-brown body and black stripes. It has hairy legs, a rounded abdomen, and wings that shimmer like glass. Its face has black eyes and a proboscis for drinking nectar.
Small, dark brown ant with a narrow waist and segmented body. Long legs and antennae. Black head with large eyes. Thin, straight body with six legs. Bright red abdomen. Antennae twitching.
A bright red shell with black spots, rounded body, and six legs. Black head with two black eyes. Thin antennae. Small wings folded on back. Bright colors make it easily recognizable.

A dragonfly has a long, slender body with transparent wings. Its head is large with big, bulging eyes. It has six legs and a long, thin abdomen. Its wings are delicate and shimmer in the sunlight. It has a bright, colorful body with patterns on its wings.

A grasshopper has a long, slender body with a hard, green shell. Its wings are folded over its back, and it has six legs. Large, bulging eyes and long antennae stick out from its head. Its hind legs are strong and powerful.

A small, brown insect with long, thin legs and a slender body. It has wings that look like a shield on its back. Its antennae are straight and thin. It has six legs and moves quickly. Its body is segmented and covered in fine hairs.

A small, shiny black beetle with hard, dark shell. Its body is oval and segmented, with six legs and two antennae. Bright red eyes stand out against its dark color. It has a rounded back and a pointed tail.

A tiny mosquito has long, thin legs and a slender body. Its wings are transparent with dark veins. It has a long, thin proboscis for sucking blood. Its head is dark with large, bulging eyes. Its body is covered in fine hairs. It moves quickly with a jerky flight.

A small, dark brown fly with shiny, translucent wings. Its body is slender and covered in fine hairs. Two large, bulging eyes take up most of its head. Thin legs and a long, pointed abdomen complete its look.

A cockroach has a hard, dark brown shell with segmented body. It has six legs, two long antennae, and tiny wings. Its eyes are large and bulging, giving it a watchful look. The body is long and flat, with a distinct head and tail.
Small, pale brown insect with a segmented body and long, thin legs. It has a narrow head with pincers and a soft, rounded abdomen. Its wings are delicate and folded over its back.
A small, winged insect with gray and white striped wings. Its body is slender and covered in fine hairs. Large, round eyes stand out. Antennae curve gently. Wings flutter when it moves.

A wasp has a slender, black body with bright yellow stripes. Its head is small with large, dark eyes. It has long, thin legs and two pairs of wings. Its antennae are thin and move quickly. It has a pointed abdomen with a narrow waist.

A cicada has a dark, shiny body with a hard shell. Its large, bulging eyes are red or orange. It has long, thin legs and wings that are transparent and veined. Its body is segmented and covered in small bumps. It looks like a small, winged robot.

A praying mantis has long, slender legs, a triangular head with large eyes, and a body shaped like a leaf. Its wings are folded over its back, and it holds its front legs together like prayer. Its color is green with brown markings, and it has a pointed abdomen.

A tiny glowing insect with a slender body and long, delicate wings. Its abdomen shines with a soft green light, and its wings are transparent with faint patterns. It has large, bulging eyes and thin legs, hovering gently in the air.
Long, slender body with segmented legs. Brown and green coloration. Antennae at the head. Two large eyes. Thin, stick-like limbs. Body covered in tiny bumps. Appears motionless when still.

The leaf insect has a long, flat body shaped like a leaf. It is green with brown veins, mimicking a leaf's texture. Its wings are folded over its body, and it has tiny legs and a tail-like appendage. Eyes are small and hidden, blending perfectly with foliage.

A tiny, dark brown flea with long legs and a flat body. It has six legs, a rounded back, and two antennae. Its body is covered in fine hairs, and it moves quickly with a jerky motion. Small, piercing mouthparts are visible near its head.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright red ladybug with 12 black spots, tiny legs, and a rounded body. Its wings are a shiny red with black edges. It stands on a leaf, head slightly up, antennae twitching.

entities.visual_description: A long, sinuous body with smooth, scaly skin in shades of green and brown. Bright red eyes with vertical pupils. A forked tongue flicking out. Scales arranged in rows. Slender, flexible form. Dark markings along the back. Tail ending in a pointed tip.

A cobra has a long, slender body with a thick, muscular tail. Its head is triangular with a distinct neck, and it has large, round eyes. The body is covered in smooth, overlapping scales, and it has a hood that flares when threatened. Its color is usually brown or green with darker patterns.

A long, sinuous body with smooth, scaly skin in shades of brown and green. Bright yellow underbelly. Round, dark eyes with vertical pupils. Small, movable head with a pointed snout. Slight ridge along the back. Tail ends in a tapered tip.
A sleek, green snake with diamond-shaped scales, bright yellow underbelly, and a long, slender body. It has sharp, triangular head and vertical slit pupils. Its tail ends in a curved, pointed tip.
A small lizard with a long, slender body and a tail. It has scaly skin in green and brown tones. Bright yellow eyes and a pointed snout. Four legs with clawed toes. Scales are smooth and shiny.

A small gecko with a rough, scaly skin in earthy tones. It has large, round eyes with vertical pupils. Its body is slender, with a long tail that flicks constantly. Noticeable are the spiky toes and a distinct, triangular head.

A green iguana has a long, slender body with a spiky crest along its back. Its head is triangular with bright yellow eyes. It has a long tail, and its legs end in sharp claws. Its skin is scaly and rough to the touch.
A chameleon has a long, slender body with a flat head. Its skin is scaly and can change colors. It has large, round eyes and long, sticky fingers. Its tail is prehensile, helping it grip branches.

A large Komodo dragon has a thick, scaly body with dark brown and yellow patterns. Its long tail ends in a clawed foot. Sharp teeth show in a wide mouth. Spiky horns rise from its head. Bright yellow eyes stare forward.

A large crocodile has a long, flat snout with wide, sharp teeth. Its body is thick and covered in tough, armored scales. Two large eyes sit on top of its head, with vertical pupils. A long tail extends from its body, and it has four short legs with webbed feet.

entities.visual_description: A large alligator has a thick, scaly body with dark green and black stripes. Its wide mouth shows sharp teeth, and it has a long, pointed snout. Two small eyes with vertical pupils peek from the top of its head. A long tail swishes behind.

A turtle has a round, shell-like body with a hard, bumpy shell on its back. Its head is small with a beak-like mouth and dark eyes. It has four legs with webbed toes and a tail. Its skin is scaly and usually a dark green or brown color.

A large, slow-moving tortoise with a thick, domed shell. Its shell is dark green with yellow markings. It has a short neck, small head, and stubby legs. Its eyes are small and dark. It carries a long tail with a pointed tip.

A sea turtle has a smooth, oval shell in shades of green and brown. Its head is small with a beak-like mouth. Two small eyes peek from above. Its flippers are wide and webbed, perfect for swimming. The skin is dark with a pattern of light spots.

A skink has a long, slender body with a smooth, shiny scale pattern. It has a pointed snout, bright eyes, and a tail that can detach. Its skin is usually dark green or brown with light stripes. Small legs and a blunt nose make it easily recognizable.

A small lizard with a long, slender body and a sticky tongue. Bright green scales cover its back, while the underbelly is pale. It has large, round eyes and a tail that flicks quickly. Its legs are short but strong, and it has a pointed snout.

A large, thick-bodied reptile with rough, spiky skin. Dark brown and gray scales cover its body. A distinctive, broad head with a pointed snout. Bright pink and orange skin on the throat and belly. Long, sturdy legs with clawed toes.

A marine iguana has a slender, elongated body with a rough, scaly skin. It has a long, pointed snout and small, round eyes. Its tail is long and muscular, and its legs are short and sturdy. It sports a dark, earthy green body with a lighter underbelly.

A frilled lizard has a long, slender body with a thick tail. It has a flat, triangular head with large, round eyes. Its most distinctive feature is the wide, ruffled frill around its neck, which flares out when threatened. Its skin is scaly and can change color.

The tuatara has a long, scaly body with a blunt snout and tiny eyes. It has a crest along its back and a spiky tail. Its skin is dark green with light spots. It looks like a lizard but has a more rounded head and a unique, ancient appearance.

subcategories.visual_description: A green iguana stands on one leg, tail curled. Its body is long and covered in rough, dark green scales. Bright yellow eyes look forward. A wide, flat head with a pointed snout. Sharp teeth show in a small mouth. Four legs end in clawed feet.

entities.visual_description: A bright green frog with a rounded body and long legs. It has large, bulging eyes and a moist, smooth skin. Its mouth is wide with small teeth, and it carries a tiny umbrella on its back.

A toad has a round, bumpy body with dry, warty skin. It has large, bulging eyes with vertical pupils. Its legs are long and powerful, with webbed toes. A pointed snout and rough, textured skin make it easily recognizable.

A small, bright red salamander with a long, slender body and a pointed snout. It has large, round eyes with vertical pupils and a tail that flicks side to side. Its skin is smooth and covered in tiny, dark spots.

A small, greenish-brown newt with a smooth, slimy skin. It has a rounded body, a blunt snout, and large, round eyes. Its limbs are short and sturdy, with webbed toes. A distinct stripe runs down its back, and it has a tail that is longer than its body.

A small, pink amphibian with feathery gills on its sides. It has large, round eyes and a flat, wide head. Its body is covered in smooth, dark skin with a distinctive stripe down its back. It has four short legs and a tail for swimming.

A tree frog has a smooth, moist skin with bright green color. It has large, round eyes with vertical pupils. Its limbs are long and webbed, with sticky toes for climbing. The body is slender, and it has a short, blunt snout.

A large bullfrog with a rough, green skin, dark spots, and a wide mouth. It has bulging eyes, a thick body, and strong legs. Its tongue is long and sticky. The skin is moist and textured. It sits on a log with webbed toes visible.
Small, bright yellow frog with black spots and a smooth, slimy skin. Has a rounded body, large eyes, and a short tail. Bright orange belly with black markings. Short legs and a pointed snout.

A small frog with transparent skin showing a bright green belly and pink organs. Its eyes are large and black with vertical pupils. It has a rounded body and short legs. Its back is dull brown with dark spots.

A small, smooth-scaled amphibian with a long, slender body and no legs. It has large, round eyes and a blunt snout. Its skin is shiny and slimy, with a dark, mottled pattern. It moves slowly through muddy water, using its tail for propulsion.

A fire salamander has a slender body with bright orange skin, black stripes, and a pointed snout. Its legs are long and thin, with webbed toes. It has large, round eyes and a tail that tapers to a point. Its skin is smooth and glossy, with a striking red and black color pattern.

A large, stocky amphibian with a rough, mottled green and brown skin. It has a broad head, small eyes, and a short, blunt snout. Its body is covered in warty bumps and it has four sturdy legs with webbed toes. Dark markings run along its back and sides.

Small, plump amphibian with a dark, mottled back and bright yellow belly. Has a rounded body, short legs, and a long, slender tail. Eyes are large and dark with vertical pupils. Skin is smooth and slightly wrinkled.

A small, slimy amphibian with a rough, bumpy skin. It has a dark green back covered in bright yellow spots. Its belly is pale with a red or orange stripe. Large, round eyes and a short, stubby tail help identify it.

A small frog with a long, slender body and a pointed snout. It has smooth, warty skin in bright green with dark spots. Its legs are long and powerful, with webbed toes. Large, round eyes stand out against its body.

A small, plump frog with a mottled brown and green back. Its skin is rough and bumpy, with a distinctive yellow belly. Large, round eyes sit above a broad head. Short legs and a rounded body give it a chubby appearance.

A small, dark salamander with bright yellow spots. Its skin is rough and bumpy. It has a blunt snout and large, round eyes. The body is thick and short. The color is mostly black with yellow markings. It has four legs and a tail.

A muddy, plump amphibian with smooth, dark skin and warty bumps. It has large, round eyes and a broad, flat body. Short legs and a tail help it swim. Its color is mottled brown and gray, with a muddy texture.

A small, round amphibian with smooth, shiny skin. It has large, round eyes and a wide mouth with tiny teeth. Its body is mostly green with dark spots. Four short legs and a tail help it swim. Bright yellow underbelly stands out.

names.vi: Con Kỳ giông khổng lồ Mỹ

vi.syllable: Con Kỳ giông khổng lồ Mỹ

entities.visual_description: A large, slimy amphibian with a dark, mottled green and brown skin. It has a flat, wide head and a long, eel-like body. Its eyes are small and round, with vertical pupils. It lacks limbs and has a rough, textured skin with distinct patterns.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright green frog sits on a leaf. It has smooth skin, big round eyes, and a long tail. Its legs are strong and webbed. The frog has a pointed nose and a wide mouth with small teeth. Its back is covered in warty bumps.

entities.visual_description: A fluffy white dog with big, expressive brown eyes. Its floppy ears and wagging tail show happiness. Short, smooth fur covers its body. A small black nose and pink paw prints add charm. Bright, round eyes and a joyful smile make it instantly recognizable.

A fluffy white cat with bright blue eyes and a small black nose. Its ears are pointed and tufted, and it has a sleek, soft coat. The tail is long and bushy, with a slight curve. Its paws are round and padded, and it has a gentle, curious expression.

A large, four-legged mammal with a long neck and tail. Thick, shaggy coat in chestnut brown. Broad, muscular body. Large, rounded ears. Strong, sturdy legs. Long, flowing mane and tail. Bright, expressive eyes.
A small, fluffy rabbit with long ears, a round face, and bright eyes. Its body is covered in soft, white fur with a small tail. Long legs and a twitching nose make it look alert and cute.

A monkey has a fluffy tail, big eyes, and a round face. Its fur is thick and varies in color. It has long arms and legs, and a pointed nose. Its hands and feet are dexterous with opposable thumbs. It wears a tiny hat and a red scarf.

A bat has large, dark wings made of skin stretched over finger bones. Its eyes are small and round, with a nose that is pointed and slightly curved. It has a long, pointed snout and sharp teeth. Its fur is short and varies in color from black to brown. It hangs upside down by its claws.

A large bear with thick, fluffy fur in brown and white. Round, black eyes. Short, strong legs. Big paws with sharp claws. A stubby nose. A long, bushy tail. Broad, muscular body. Rounded ears. A wide, strong jaw with big teeth.

A round, fluffy panda with black eyes and a black nose. Its body is covered in thick white fur with large black patches on the ears, shoulders, and legs. The face has a small black nose and a black eye patch around each eye.
A fluffy koala has thick, soft gray fur with a white belly. Large round eyes and a small nose sit on a rounded face. Its ears are rounded and black. Strong limbs and a long tail help it climb trees.

A kangaroo has a long, muscular tail, strong back legs, and a pouch on its belly. It has a round face with large eyes, a short snout, and a pointed nose. Its fur is grayish-brown with a lighter underbelly. It stands on its hind legs and hops with powerful jumps.

A small squirrel with a fluffy tail, brown fur, and a slender body. It has big, round eyes and tiny paws. Its ears are pointed, and its nose is black and snout-like. It stands on its hind legs, holding a acorn in its front paws.

A small mammal with spiky brown fur, round body, and a short tail. It has a pointed snout, tiny black eyes, and four short legs. Its back is covered in stiff, white quills, and it carries a round belly.

A small, sleek mammal with a long, pointed snout and webbed paws. Its fur is dark brown with a lighter belly. Large, round eyes and a fluffy tail help it swim. It has whiskers around its mouth and a flexible body for moving through water.

A beaver has a thick, dark brown fur coat, a flat, square tail, and webbed paws. Its face is round with sharp teeth, and it has small, round eyes and a short, snout. The tail is black and wide, used for swimming and balance.

A slow-moving sloth with a fuzzy, gray-brown coat. Long, curved claws hang from its limbs. Its face is small with dark, round eyes and a short snout. A long, prehensile tail swings behind. Soft, rounded body with a wrinkled belly.

A raccoon has a sleek, dark gray body with a distinctive white chest and face. Its tail is bushy and ringed with black and white stripes. Sharp, black eyes and a pointed snout add to its alert look. Thick fur covers its body, and it has small, dexterous paws with five fingers.

A badger has a thick, dark brown body with a white chest. Its face is round with short, sharp snout. It has strong, stocky legs and a bushy tail. Its fur is coarse and dense, with black stripes on the face and back. Eyes are small and dark.

A small, furry mammal with velvety brown fur. Large, round ears and a short, pointed snout. Dark eyes and a fluffy tail. Short legs and a rounded body. Mole has a distinctive, wrinkled face and tiny, clawed hands.

A platypus has a round, duck-like body with a flat, beak-like snout. It has webbed feet, a tail like a duck’s, and a furry body. Its eyes are small and dark, with a yellowish beak. It has a distinctive, flat tail and a waterproof coat.

A small mammal with a thick, armored shell made of bony plates. Its body is round and covered in dark, shiny scales. It has short legs, a long snout, and tiny, round eyes. A tail with a tuft of fur at the end completes its look.

subcategories.visual_description: A small, fluffy mammal with round ears and a short tail. Big, dark eyes. Soft gray fur with a white chest. Four legs, two short front legs and two longer back legs. Standing on all fours, looking curious.

entities.visual_description: A salmon has a sleek, streamlined body with a silver-blue back and golden sides. Its belly is white, and it has a small, pointed snout. Large, crescent-shaped fins are on its back and tail, with a distinctive red stripe along its sides. Eyes are dark and round.

A sleek, silver fish with a streamlined body. Long, pointed tail and forked fins. Dark stripes along the back. Bright red fins. Large, round eyes. Smooth, shiny skin. Thin, slender body. Strong, muscular build.

A goldfish has a round, shiny body with bright orange and white stripes. Its large, round eyes are black with white rings. It has a small mouth and a long, flowing tail. Its skin is smooth and scales are visible under the water.
A small, bright orange fish with white stripes. Big, round eyes. Black spots on the face. Short, pointed fins. Thick, rounded body. Long, flowing tail. Bright colors stand out in the water.

A carp has a long, slender body with a slightly pointed snout. Its skin is covered in small, smooth scales that shimmer in the water. It has large, round eyes and a tail that flares wide when swimming. Its mouth is positioned at the front, and it has a single dorsal fin along its back.

A catfish has a long, flat body with a wide, rounded head. Its skin is slimy and covered in small, bumpy scales. It has no visible eyes but has a long, sensitive barbel near its mouth. Its tail is short and pointed, and it moves by undulating its body through water.

A tilapia has a streamlined, oval body with a silver-blue back and a lighter, yellowish belly. Its eyes are large and round, and it has a wide mouth with small, rounded teeth. Fins are positioned along the sides, with the dorsal and tail fins being the most prominent.

A trout has a slender, streamlined body with a silvery-blue back and golden sides. Its belly is white, and it has a sharp, pointed snout. Dark vertical stripes run along its sides, and its tail is forked with a dark edge. Large, round eyes and small, pointed teeth are visible.

A large, sleek fish with a dark blue body and vertical stripes. It has a pointed snout, wide mouth with sharp teeth, and large, expressive eyes. Its tail is fan-shaped and powerful, helping it move swiftly through the water.

A cod has a long, slender body with a silver-blue back and pale white belly. Its skin is smooth and covered in small, scattered spots. Large, round eyes and a pointed snout help identify it. Fins are small and triangular, with a distinctive tail fin that helps it swim efficiently.

A mackerel has a sleek, silver body with dark blue stripes. Its tail is forked and shiny. It has small, pointed fins and large, dark eyes. The sides are covered in tiny, scattered spots. Its mouth is small with sharp teeth. It swims quickly through the water.

Small, silver fish with a streamlined body. Has tiny, scaleless skin. Large, round eyes. Thin, pointed tail. Fins are small and triangular. Often seen in schools. Bright silver color with dark stripes. Short, stubby snout.

Small, slender fish with silver sides and a dark back. Has a pointed snout and large eyes. Fins are small and rounded. Body is covered in tiny scales. Often seen in schools near the surface of the water.

A small, colorful fish with shimmering scales in red, orange, and white. It has a rounded body, large round eyes, and a tall dorsal fin. Its tail is fan-shaped and bright, making it look playful and lively in the water.

A bright orange betta fish with long, flowing fins. Its body is slender and sleek. It has large, round eyes. The tail is fan-shaped and vibrant. Stripes run along its body. Fins are colorful and flowing.

A round, spiky fish with a smooth, shiny skin. Bright orange body with white spots. Large, round eyes. Small, pointed fins on the back and tail. Puff up when threatened, making it look rounder and spikier.
A large, dark fish with a glowing light on its forehead. Big, sharp teeth in a wide mouth. Long, flowing fins. Slender body with a pointed tail. Eyes are large and bulging. Skin is rough and spiky.

A swordfish has a long, flat, sword-like bill, sleek body, and silver scales. Its large eyes are set on the sides of its head. It has a pointed snout and a streamlined shape. The tail is powerful and crescent-shaped. Its body is dark blue on top and lighter below.

A bright orange fish with vertical black stripes. Long, slender body. Large, expressive eyes. Fins are triangular and pointed. Has a distinctive black spot near the tail. Streamlined shape. Smooth, shiny scales.
A bright orange koi fish with black stripes and a white belly. Large, round eyes and a flowing tail. Scales shimmer in the water. Long, sleek body with a pointed snout. Fins are pale with dark edges.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright orange fish with vertical black stripes, big round eyes, and a tall, pointed fin on its back. It sits upright in clear water, tail curled slightly, showing its shiny, scale-covered body.

names.ja: ティラノサウルス・レックス

entities.visual_description: A large dinosaur with a long tail, short legs, and a massive body. It has a large head with sharp teeth, tiny arms, and a strong jaw. Its skin is rough and scaly, with a muscular build and a prominent crest on its head.

A large dinosaur with a triangular frill on its neck, three horns on its face, and a short tail. Its body is bulky with a wide back, and it has a long, sturdy neck. The skin is scaly and rough, with a heavy, robust build.

A large, four-legged dinosaur with a bulky body and short legs. It has a spiked tail and a row of plates along its back. Its head is small with a blunt snout and tiny eyes. Thick skin covers its body, and it walks on sturdy, hoof-like feet.

names.vi: Con Khủng long cổ dài Brachiosaurus

entities.visual_description: A large, long-necked dinosaur with a bulky body. Its head is small compared to its neck, which is thick and long. It has four sturdy legs, a tail that curves slightly, and a broad back. Its skin is scaly and rough, with a dark, earthy color.

names.ja: ブロンティオサウルス

entities.visual_description: A large, long-necked dinosaur with a bulky body. Thick, sturdy legs support its massive frame. A long, whip-like tail swings behind. Small, rounded head with tiny teeth. Skin has bumps and ridges. Overall, a slow, heavy-looking creature.

A large, long-necked dinosaur with a bulky body. It has a long, trailing tail, small head, and four thick legs. Its skin is scaly and rough, with a wide, flat back. The neck is very long and droops downward.

A small, fast dinosaur with a long tail and sharp claws. It has a slender body, two long legs, and a short, stiff neck. Its head is small with a beak-like mouth and large eyes. Dark, scaly skin covers its body.

A large dinosaur with a long snout and sharp teeth. It has a tall sail on its back made of bones. Its body is thick and muscular. It has short legs and long, powerful tail. Dark green skin with dark spots. Eyes are small and round.

A large, heavy dinosaur with a broad body and short legs. It has a thick, bony tail with spikes, a row of bony plates along its back, and a wide, flat head with small eyes. Its body is covered in armor-like bumps and spikes.

A large, long-necked dinosaur with a distinctive crest on its head. It has a thick body, short legs, and a long tail. Its skin is scaly and gray, with a wide, flat beak. The crest is curved and hollow, pointing backward.

A large, bulky dinosaur with a long, flat head and a short neck. It has a heavy body, four sturdy legs, and a tail that curves backward. Its skin is scaly and rough, with a broad, rounded body and a distinctive thumb spike on each forelimb.

A large, fierce dinosaur with a long, narrow snout and sharp teeth. It has a tall, bony crest on its head. Its body is muscular, with four strong legs and a long, powerful tail. Scaly skin covers its body, and it has large, clawed feet.

A Carnotaurus has a short, stocky body with a narrow skull. Its head is small and triangular with a short snout. It has large, muscular legs and a short tail. Two horns curve backward from its skull. Its skin is covered in small bumps and scales.

A large, long-snouted dinosaur with a distinctive double crest on its head. It has a slender body, short legs, and a long tail. Its skin is rough and scaly, with dark, earthy colors. Bright yellow eyes and a narrow, toothy mouth stand out.

names.ja: パキケファロサウルス

entities.visual_description: A large, bulky dinosaur with a thick, flat skull. Its body is short and stocky, with a wide back and strong legs. It has small, rounded eyes and a short tail. Its skin is rough and scaly, with a distinctive dome-shaped head.

A small, feathered dinosaur with a rounded body and short, strong legs. It has a large, toothless beak and a crest on its head. Its eyes are large and forward-facing, and it has a fluffy tail with a fan-like structure.

Small, feathered dinosaur with a long, slender head and sharp teeth. Has a short neck, tiny wings, and a tail. Body is covered in fine feathers, with a rounded belly. Legs are long and thin, and eyes are large and forward-facing.

A large, feathered dinosaur with a long tail and strong legs. It has a slender body, sharp beak, and two small horns on its head. Brightly colored feathers cover its neck and back. Its eyes are large and alert, showing quick movement.

A massive, long-necked dinosaur with a thick, sturdy body. Its skin is rough and scaly, with dark gray coloring. It has a long tail and four sturdy legs. Large, rounded eyes and a wide mouth with tiny teeth are visible.
A large, long-necked dinosaur with a tiny head. Its body is thick and robust. It has long, slender legs and a massive, clawed arm. The tail is short and sturdy. Its skin is scaly and rough.

subcategories.visual_description: A large, long-necked dinosaur with a thick, bumpy skin. It has a small head with tiny eyes and a long tail. Four thick legs support its heavy body. Its mouth is wide and toothy, showing sharp teeth. It stands upright on the ground.

entities.visual_description: A spider has eight legs, a rounded body, and long, thin legs. It has eight eyes, some in pairs. Its body is covered in fine hairs. It has a segmented abdomen and a cephalothorax. Its legs end in small claws. It can have colorful patterns on its body.

A large tarantula with a hairy, dark brown body. Its legs are long and spindly, with thick, hairy segments. Bright orange or red markings on the abdomen. Eight legs, two pairs of pedipalps, and a rounded head with prominent eyes.

A small spider with eight legs, round body, and eight eyes arranged in two rows. Bright colors on its abdomen, long legs, and a hairy appearance. It jumps with its hind legs, showing quick movement and detailed patterns on its body.

A wolf spider has a dark, hairy body with eight legs and two pairs of eyes. Its front legs are thick and strong, used for hunting. The abdomen is rounded with a distinctive pattern. It moves quickly and has a tough, segmented exoskeleton.

Small spider with a round, shiny abdomen covered in fine hairs. Long, slender legs with hairy tarsi. Eight eyes arranged in two rows. Bright orange or yellow markings on the abdomen. Spindly legs and a delicate, web-spinning appearance.

Black Widow spider has a shiny black body with a red hourglass mark on its belly. Its legs are long and slender, with dark patterns. Two pairs of legs are visible, and its abdomen is rounded and distinct. Eyes are small and clustered.

A brown recluse spider has a dark, mottled brown body with a distinctive violin-shaped mark on its back. Its legs are long and slender, with six pairs. The abdomen is rounded and pale, with a dark stripe running down the middle.

A scorpion has a long, segmented body with a hard, dark shell. It has eight legs, a tail with a stinger, and two large pincers. Its eyes are small and placed on top of its head. The body is thick and curved, with a tail that curls under its body.

names.ja: エンペラーサソリ (Enperā Sasori)

entities.visual_description: A large, thick-bodied arachnid with a segmented, armored exoskeleton. Bright red and black stripes run along its back. Eight legs, two large pincers, and a long, segmented tail with a stinger at the end. Eyes are small and dark.

A small, oval-shaped tick with eight legs and a rounded body. It has a dark, segmented shell and six pairs of tiny legs. Its mouthparts are visible at the front, and it has a pale belly. The tick is brown with a reddish tint.

A tiny, eight-legged arachnid with a rounded, segmented body. It has two pairs of legs, a pair of pedipalps, and eight eyes. Its exoskeleton is hard and pale, with dark markings. It moves quickly, scuttling across surfaces with tiny, spindly legs.

A small, slender arachnid with long, thin legs and a rounded body. It has two large, dark eyes and eight jointed legs. Its body is usually brown or gray, with a segmented abdomen. The legs are delicate and extend outward, giving it a spider-like appearance.

A camel spider has a long, slender body with eight legs. Its head is broad with large, forward-facing eyes. It has a thick, segmented abdomen and a long, thin tail. Its color is mostly brown with darker markings. It moves quickly on sand.

A whip spider has a long, slender body with eight legs. Its head is narrow with two long, whip-like feelers. It has two large, bulging eyes and a segmented, tough exoskeleton. Its color is dark brown with lighter markings.

A whip scorpion has a long, segmented body with a hard, dark brown exoskeleton. It has two pairs of walking legs, and a long, slender tail ending in a stinger. Its head has large, bulging eyes and a pair of pincers. The tail is whip-like and moves quickly.
Small, flat arachnid with a rounded body and segmented legs. Has a pair of pincers near the front. Covered in fine hairs. Dark brown with lighter markings. Appears motionless, clinging to surfaces.

A small, dark red spider with a shiny black abdomen. Long, slender legs and a narrow body. Two dark red stripes run down the back. Eight legs, no wings, and a pointed abdomen. Bright red legs and a black body with red markings.

A trapdoor spider has a dark, glossy body with a rounded abdomen. Its legs are long and slender, with hairy patches. A small, oval-shaped trapdoor sits in the ground near its burrow, partially covered by soil and leaves.

A Huntsman Spider has a large, flat body with long legs. Its color is usually brown or gray with darker markings. It has eight legs, two pairs of pedipalps, and a segmented abdomen. Its eyes are small and arranged in two rows.

A cellar spider has a long, slender body with eight legs. Its legs are thin and spindly, with small, delicate feet. It has two pairs of eyes, small and widely spaced. Its abdomen is rounded and pale, with a distinctive pattern of dark markings.

subcategories.visual_description: A small spider with eight legs, two pairs of front legs, and a rounded body. It has eight eyes arranged in two rows. Its abdomen is covered in fine hairs, and it stands on its legs, ready to move.

entities.visual_description: A small rodent with a long, slender body, round ears, and a pointed snout. It has large, dark eyes and a bushy tail. Its fur is soft and grayish-brown, with a white belly. The mouse moves quickly with tiny, dexterous paws.

Small, slender rodent with a long, pointed nose and whiskers. Dark brown fur with a lighter belly. Large, round eyes. Long tail with a tuft at the end. Sharp teeth visible in the mouth. Scurries with quick, stilted legs.
A small, round rodent with fluffy gray fur, large round eyes, and a short, stubby nose. It has tiny ears, a short tail, and whiskers. Its body is plump, with a pointed snout and rounded paws.
A small, round guinea pig with soft, fluffy fur. Large, dark eyes. Short, stubby ears. A tiny nose and whiskers. Thick, rounded body. Short legs. A fluffy tail. Mostly white with some brown spots.

A small, furry gerbil with a rounded body and long whiskers. Its ears are small and rounded, and it has big, dark eyes. Its tail is short and stubby, and its fur is soft and sandy-colored with a light belly.

A small, striped rodent with a fluffy tail. Bright orange cheeks and a black stripe down its face. Dark eyes and a pointed snout. Short, bushy ears. Body covered in alternating black and orange stripes. Nimble legs and a long, bushy tail.

A porcupine has a long, spiky body covered in thick, white quills. Its face is round with small, dark eyes and a short, pink nose. It has a bushy tail and short legs. Its body is stocky and covered in soft, gray fur beneath the quills.

A large, stocky rodent with short legs and a barrel-shaped body. Its fur is brown and coarse, with a white belly. Big, round ears and a short, blunt snout. Long, whisker-like vibrissae on its face. Eyes are small and dark. It has a short tail and webbed feet.

A beaver has a thick, flat tail, round ears, and a sturdy body. Its fur is dark brown with a lighter chest. It has small, black eyes and a wide, square snout. Front paws are large and webbed. Its back is covered in short, dense fur.

A marmot has a thick, fluffy brown coat with a white belly. Its round, dark eyes sit above a short snout. Large, rounded ears stick out from the sides. Strong, stubby legs support a stocky body. A bushy tail adds balance and movement.

A small, plump rodent with a pointed snout and dark, round eyes. Its ears are tiny and rounded, and its body is covered in short, dark fur. It has a stubby tail and small, pink paws. Its nose is wet and twitching, showing curiosity.

A small, plump rodent with a pointed snout and dark, beady eyes. Its fur is dense and dark brown, with a lighter belly. It has whiskers along its face and short, rounded ears. Its tail is short and scaly, and its feet are webbed for swimming.

A chinchilla has soft, fluffy gray fur, long whiskers, and large ears. Its body is small and round, with big, round eyes. It has a fluffy tail and tiny, pink nose. Its legs are short and strong, with small feet. Its fur is very dense and looks fluffy.

A small, round dormouse with soft brown fur, large dark eyes, and a fluffy tail. Its body is plump, with tiny ears and a short snout. It has a wrinkled face and a fluffy, bushy tail that looks like a small cloud.

A small, plump rodent with a round body and short legs. It has a fluffy tail, large black eyes, and a pointed snout. Its fur is gray-brown on top and white underneath. It waddles with a clumsy, energetic gait.

A small, fluffy ground squirrel with a round body and long bushy tail. Its face is pointed with dark eyes and a small nose. It has short legs and a stubby tail. Its fur is gray with a white belly. It carries a small object in its front paws.

A flying squirrel has a fluffy tail, large round eyes, and a soft, gray-brown fur coat. It has a membrane stretched between its limbs for gliding, and small, rounded ears. Its body is slender with a pointed nose and tiny, dark feet.

A nutria has a thick, dark brown fur coat, a flat, paddle-like tail, and webbed feet. Its face is rounded with whiskers and small, round eyes. It has a short, stocky body and a long, pointed snout. Its ears are small and rounded, and its legs are short and strong.

A small rodent with a thick, brown body and a fluffy tail. Its fur is striped in dark and light brown, running from head to tail. Large, round eyes and a pointed snout. Short legs and a bushy tail. Overall, it looks like a plump, striped rodent with a friendly face.

A small rodent with a round, fluffy body. It has large, dark eyes and a long, slender tail. Its ears are small and pointed. The fur is soft and gray-brown on top, with a lighter underside. It has a short, stubby nose and tiny, black feet.

subcategories.visual_description: A small furry rodent with big round eyes, a long tail, and tiny ears. Its body is plump and covered in soft gray fur. It sits upright on its hind legs, holding a small stick in its paws. Its nose is twitching and its whiskers are clearly visible.

names.vi: Động vật hoạt động ban đêm

entities.visual_description: A raccoon has a sleek, dark gray body with a white chest and face. Its tail is bushy and ringed with black and white stripes. Sharp, black eyes glow in the dark. Its paws are small and dexterous, with long fingers. A distinctive mask covers its eyes and nose.

A small, furry opossum with a long, pointed snout and large, round eyes. Its body is covered in coarse gray fur, with a fluffy tail and stubby legs. It has a distinct face with whiskers and a pointed nose, and its ears are small and rounded.

A large, burrowing animal with a long, slender snout and large, round ears. Its body is covered in coarse, sandy-colored fur. It has a long, thin tail and short, powerful legs. Its eyes are small and dark, adapted for night vision.

Aardwolf has a sandy brown coat with dark stripes on its back. Its face is narrow with long legs and a long, slender tail. Large, dark eyes and a pointed snout help it hunt at night. Its ears are small and rounded, and it has a fluffy, white underbelly.

A small, sleek feline with a spotted coat, dark eyes, and a bushy tail. Its body is slender, with long legs and a pointed snout. It has a distinctive black mask around its eyes and a fluffy chest. Its fur is short and dense, with a mix of gray, brown, and black patches.

A small, sleek mammal with a long, slender body and a distinctive black stripe running from its nose to the base of its tail. It has large, rounded ears and dark, expressive eyes. Its fur is short and dense, with a mix of brown and black markings.

names.ja: ナックルリーマー (nakkaru rīmā)

entities.visual_description: A slow loris has thick, fuzzy fur in gray or brown, with a white chest and face. Large, round eyes glow in the dark. Its arms are long and slender, with tiny hands and fingers. A distinctive white stripe runs from its forehead to its shoulders. It has a short, stubby tail and soft, round cheeks.

A tarsier has large, round eyes, wide-set, forward-facing, and glowing in the dark. Its body is slender with long legs and a short, fluffy tail. It has big, round ears and a face that looks wide and flat. Its fur is gray with a lighter belly. Its hands and feet are large with long fingers and toes.

A pangolin has a long, scaly tail, a pointed snout, and a body covered in overlapping scales. Its legs are short with large claws. It has small, round eyes and a mouth with tiny teeth. Its body is thick and armored, with a distinctive, curved tail.

A striped skunk has a long, sleek body with black fur and bright white stripes across its back. Its face is round with small black eyes and a short snout. It has short legs and a bushy tail. Its fur is soft and shiny, with a strong odor when threatened.

A ringtail has a slender body with a long, bushy tail marked by distinct black rings. Its face is small with large, round eyes and a pointed snout. It has soft, gray fur with a lighter belly, and tiny, rounded ears. Its paws are small and dexterous, with sharp claws.
A small, fuzzy brown animal with a round body and a distinctive yellow belly. Large, black eyes glow in the dark. Short, fluffy legs and a tiny tail. Has a beak-like nose and soft, round ears.
A small bird with mottled brown and gray feathers, large dark eyes, and a long, pointed beak. It has a distinctive facial mask and short wings. Its body is slender, and it has a soft, rounded tail.

A kinkajou has a long, slender body with soft, fuzzy fur. It has large, round eyes and a short, bushy tail. Its face is wide with a pointed snout and small, rounded ears. Its limbs are long and flexible, with sharp claws. Its fur is typically brown or gray, with a white belly.

Small, round-faced primate with large, dark eyes and a long, slender snout. Has big ears, a fluffy tail, and short, thick limbs. Covered in soft gray fur with a lighter belly. Appears alert and curious, with a wide, expressive face.

A small fox with large, round ears and a fluffy tail. Its body is covered in soft, sandy-colored fur. Bright, expressive eyes glow in the dark. A white chest and black nose add contrast. Short legs and a pointed snout complete the look.

A honey badger has a short, sleek body with thick, dark brown fur. Its face is round with a white stripe above the eyes. It has strong, stocky legs and a long, bushy tail. Its nose is black and snout-like, with small, rounded ears.

A small, furry jerboa has long, slender legs and a bushy tail. Its large, round eyes glow in the dark. It has a pointed snout and tiny ears. Its body is covered in soft, sandy-colored fur. It moves quickly on its hind legs, leaving small tracks in the sand.

A small, round-faced animal with thick, fluffy fur. Large, round eyes glow in the dark. Short, stubby ears. A long, bushy tail. Soft, pink nose. Dark, expressive eyebrows. Thick, padded paws. Bright, alert gaze.

A small, plump mammal with a pointed snout and large, round eyes. It has a fuzzy, gray-brown coat with dark stripes along its back. Its tail is short and bushy, and it has tiny, clawed feet. Its ears are small and rounded, and it has a short, stubby nose.

subcategories.visual_description: A big, round-eyed owl sits on a branch. Its yellow eyes glow in the dark. Soft feathers cover its body. A small beak sticks out. Wings are folded close. Dark feathers blend with the night.

entities.visual_description: A fluffy white puppy with big, round brown eyes and a tiny nose. Its ears are floppy and pink, and it has a short, soft coat. The puppy wags its tail and has a small, pink mouth with tiny teeth. Its paws are round and fluffy.

A fluffy white kitten with bright blue eyes and a tiny black nose. Its soft fur is covered in small gray patches. Short legs and a round belly show it's young and playful. Long whiskers twitch as it curls into a ball.

A baby calf has soft, fluffy white fur with a few dark spots. Large, dark eyes look curious. A tiny nose and wet snout. Short legs and a small tail. A wrinkled face with a pink mouth. Overall, it looks cute and newborn.

A small horse with soft brown fur, big round eyes, and a tiny nose. It has floppy ears and a short tail. Its legs are thin and covered in fine hair. The foal stands on four legs, looking curious and wide-eyed.
A baby lamb has soft white fur, big round eyes, and tiny floppy ears. Its face is pink with a black nose. Small legs and a fluffy tail add to its cute appearance.

A tiny baby animal with soft fur, big round eyes, and a tiny nose. It has floppy ears and a small tail. Its body is round and fluffy, with a tiny mouth and paws. It looks cute and helpless, with a gentle expression.

A tiny pink piglet with soft, round body. Big black eyes, floppy ears, and a snout. Short legs, fluffy tail, and a tiny belly. White snout tip, tiny toes, and a wrinkled face. Bright eyes and a cute, round shape.

A fluffy baby chick with soft, downy feathers in light yellow. Big, round black eyes. Tiny beak and short legs. Small, fluffy tail. Bright orange feet. Round body with a tiny head. Chick pecks at the ground.

A fluffy duckling with soft, downy feathers, tiny webbed feet, and a small beak. Its eyes are large and dark, with a gentle expression. The body is round and wobbly, with a short tail. It has a small, fluffy crest on its head.

A tiny baby goose with fluffy white feathers, wide black eyes, and a small beak. It has a rounded body, short legs, and a tiny tail. Its wings are folded close to its body, and it waddles with a clumsy gait.

A fluffy white cub with round, dark eyes and a tiny nose. Its ears are soft and floppy, and it has a short, fluffy tail. The body is round and covered in soft, white fur with small black spots. Paws are tiny and round, with black claws.

A baby fawn has soft brown fur with light tan spots. Its eyes are large and dark, with a gentle gaze. Small ears twitch, and a tiny tail flicks behind. The body is slender, with delicate legs and a fluffy nose.

names.ja: カンガルーの赤ちゃん

ja.syllable: カンガルーの赤ちゃん

entities.visual_description: A fluffy white baby bunny with big, round black eyes and tiny pink nose. Soft ears twitch slightly. Short, fluffy tail. Small paws with pink claws. Overall, a cute, innocent look with gentle expressions.
A small, fluffy leveret with round, wide eyes and a tiny nose. Its body is covered in soft, light brown fur with a white belly. Short legs and a fluffy tail add to its cute appearance.

A small, fluffy cygnet with soft gray feathers, tiny webbed feet, and a short, curved beak. Its eyes are dark and curious, and it waddles with a wobbly gait. A tiny downy crest sits on its head, and its body is round and plump with a gentle, baby-like expression.

A small, fluffy eaglet with bright golden eyes and a soft brown body. Its wings are tiny and feathered, with dark tips. A tiny beak peeks out from under a downy head. Feathers are light brown with darker streaks along the back.

A tiny owlet with soft gray feathers, big round eyes, and a small beak. Its wings are fluffy and folded close to its body. It has a tiny head with a short neck and a small, fluffy tail. The eyes are bright and alert, showing curiosity.

A tiny, slimy tadpole with a dark, oval body and a long, thin tail. It has a rounded head with a small, black eye and a mouth full of tiny teeth. Its body is covered in tiny bumps and a transparent, gelatinous skin.

names.ja: 孵化したばかりの幼体

zh.pinyin: gāng fū huà de yòu tǐ

ja.syllable: 孵化したばかりの幼体

entities.visual_description: A tiny, fluffy hatchling with soft, downy feathers. Large, round eyes wide open. Beak small and pointed. Body curved, legs short and wobbly. Tiny wings folded against the body. Overall, a cute, helpless baby bird.

A tiny, fluffy baby bird with soft gray feathers, tiny wings tucked close to its body, and a small, rounded head. Large, dark eyes peek out from under a downy crest. Its beak is tiny and pink, and it has a tiny tail feather sticking out.

subcategories.visual_description: A fluffy white baby rabbit with big round black eyes, tiny floppy ears, and a short tail. Its body is soft and round, with pink nose and paws. It sits upright on a patch of grass, looking curious and wide-eyed.

entities.visual_description: A round, hollow structure made of twigs, sticks, and leaves. It has a small entrance hole at the top. The surface is covered in moss and soft feathers. It sits in a tree branch, slightly tilted. The inside is lined with soft materials.

A burrow is a narrow, winding tunnel dug into the ground. It has soft, earthy walls with small openings. The entrance is covered with dirt and leaves. Inside, there are smooth, curved passages and hidden chambers. It looks cozy and safe, perfect for hiding.

A large, sturdy den with a curved entrance. It has rough, earthy walls made of dirt and sticks. The roof is sloped and covered in moss. A small pile of dry leaves sits near the entrance. The den is dark inside with a few small openings for light.

A cave is a dark, rocky shelter with smooth walls and a narrow entrance. It has damp floors, glowing moss, and maybe a small stream. The air feels cool and still, with shadows dancing in the dim light.

A hexagonal hive made of smooth, dark brown wax. It has a rounded, clustered shape with many small, pointed cells. The surface is covered in tiny, uniform patterns. It sits on a tree branch, surrounded by bees moving in and out.

A large, round web hangs from a tree branch, shimmering with dew. It has a complex, lace-like pattern with many sticky strands. The web is mostly silver and transparent, with some parts glowing faintly in the light.

A cluster of tiny, dark brown mounds with smooth, rounded tops. Narrow tunnels snake through the soil. Small, dark ants move quickly along the paths. The structure is compact, with a central opening leading into the underground.

A tall, cone-shaped mound made of soil and sand, with a dark brown surface. It has a wide base and a pointed top. Small tunnels and openings dot the sides. The structure is rough and uneven, with a dry, cracked texture.

A beehive is a dark brown, hexagon-shaped structure with a smooth, waxy surface. It has a rounded top and a narrow entrance. Bees move in and out, showing the hive's active life. It sits on a tree or stand, surrounded by flowers.

A sturdy wooden house with a thatched roof, painted in bright yellow and blue. It has a small door with a handle, two windows with white frames, and a chimney on the roof. The walls are smooth and weathered, showing signs of age and use.
A red wooden barn with a peaked roof and a wide door. It has large windows, a hayloft ladder, and a roof covered in shingles. The sides are weathered and painted, with a metal roof and a small porch.
A wooden kennel with a slanted roof and a small door. It has a fence around it with posts and wire. The structure is painted light brown with a red roof. A few toys and a bowl are near the door.
A small wooden chicken coop with a sloped roof, red paint, and a door with a small window. It has a fence around it, a few chickens inside, and a hay-filled nest in the corner.

A pigsty is a small, sturdy building with a sloped roof and a thatched or metal roof. It has a narrow door, a few small windows, and a dirt floor. The walls are made of wood or stone, and there are pig pens inside with straw and piglets.
A small, round pond with smooth, still water. Green lily pads float on the surface. A few ducks swim nearby. Reed plants line the edges. Sunlight glints on the water. A frog sits on a rock nearby.

names.ja: サンゴ礁 (さんごじょう)

entities.visual_description: Colorful coral branches twist and curve in a vibrant underwater scene. Bright orange, pink, and blue polyps sway with the current. Tiny fish dart between rocky outcrops and sea fans. Shells and seaweed add texture to the reef’s surface.
A hollow tree with smooth bark and a wide opening. Inside, soft moss covers the floor, and small branches stick out. A few feathers lie near the entrance, and a tiny nest hangs from a branch above.

A spiral shell with a smooth, glossy surface. It has a light brown color with darker swirls and patterns. The shell is wide at the top and tapers to a point. It has a ridged texture and a small opening at the end.

A large, hollow tree with a wide entrance, smooth bark, and mossy edges. Inside, soft feathers line the floor, and a nest of twigs and leaves hangs from the ceiling. A few eggs rest near the entrance, covered in tiny speckles.

A beaver lodge is a sturdy structure made of mud, sticks, and branches. It has a rounded entrance, a flat roof, and a dam nearby. The walls are thick and rough, with small holes for water flow. It sits in a stream, surrounded by trees and reeds.

subcategories.visual_description: A small brown squirrel sits upright on a tree stump. Its fluffy tail curls around its body, and big black eyes look forward. Gray fur covers its back, with a white chest and belly. Sharp claws grip the stump, and tiny ears twitch at the sound of rustling leaves.

categories.visual_description: A small, fluffy gray squirrel with a bushy tail sits upright on a tree stump. Its round black eyes peek out from a face with a tiny nose and whiskers. Dark ears stand straight, and its paws are tucked close to its body.

entities.visual_description: A bright pink flower with layered petals, soft and velvety. Stem is green and slender, with thorns along the base. Leaves are dark green, oval, and slightly serrated. Center has golden stamens and a dark brown pistil.

A tall, bright yellow flower with a large, rounded disk in the center. Long, green leaves at the base. Stalks are thick and sturdy. Petals are wide and radiate outward. Bright yellow center with dark brown seeds.

A bright pink lotus flower with wide, layered petals. The petals are soft and rounded, with a slight curve. The center has a yellowish-brown seed pod. The flower sits on a green, leafy stem in a pond.

A tulip has a tall, sturdy stem with broad, waxy leaves. Its flower is cup-shaped, with layers of bright, colorful petals. The petals are smooth and slightly curled, often in shades of red, yellow, or pink. The center is a soft, rounded cluster of stamens.

A tall, elegant orchid with a single, wide bloom. Purple petals with white edges, soft curves, and a velvety texture. Green leaves at the base, slightly curled. Delicate, fragrant flowers on a slender stem. Bright, vivid colors.

A bright yellow flower with white petals and a green center. Long, slender stems with soft green leaves. Round, fluffy seed heads on top. Bright yellow color with white details. Simple, cheerful appearance.

A pink flower with layered petals, soft and rounded. Stem is green and slender, with a few leaves at the base. Petals have a slight gradient from light pink to white at the edges. Center has a yellow-brown spot.

Jasmine has white, star-shaped flowers with a faint yellow center. Its slender stems twist upward, and small green leaves line the branches. The fragrance is sweet and strong, making it easily recognizable.

Lavender is a tall, slender plant with purple flowers. Its stems are green and covered in fine hairs. The flowers are small, clustered in spikes, and have slender, pointed petals. The leaves are narrow, gray-green, and slightly fuzzy. The overall look is soft and delicate.
A bright red hibiscus flower with wide, layered petals. The center has a yellow throat and a dark brown stamen. Thick, green leaves with serrated edges. Strong, sturdy stems with a few buds nearby.

Soft pink petals with white edges, delicate and layered. Branches covered in clusters of tiny, fluffy blooms. Light green stems with tiny leaves. Petals gently sway in the breeze. Fragrant, sweet scent fills the air.

A large, colorful peony flower with layered, ruffled petals in shades of pink, red, and white. Broad, rounded leaves with serrated edges. Stem with green, hairy texture. Bright, bold colors and soft, fluffy center.

Camellia has dark green, waxy leaves with serrated edges. It features showy, camellia-shaped flowers in shades of red, pink, and white. The petals are layered and slightly curled, with a soft, velvety texture. The flower has a prominent, pointed center and a subtle, fragrant scent.

Magnolia has large, soft pink petals with white edges. Its leaves are broad and dark green. It has a tall, slender stem with a few branches. The flower has a subtle fragrance. The petals are velvety and slightly curled.

Marigold has bright orange petals with dark brown centers. Its leaves are green and feathery. It has a tall, slender stem with small, fuzzy leaves. The flower has a rounded shape and a textured surface. It looks cheerful and vibrant.

A carnation has layered petals in soft pink, red, or white. Its center is a tight cluster of tiny, dark brown seeds. The stem is green and sturdy, with dark green leaves at the base. It has a compact, rounded shape with a delicate, flower-like appearance.

Iris has tall, slender stems with deep green leaves. It features a vibrant violet-blue flower with three upright petals and three drooping petals. The center has a yellow beard and a dark purple spot. The flower stands upright on a slender stem.
A bright red flower with white petals and a yellow center. Thick, waxy petals curve outward. Green leaves with serrated edges. Stalks are sturdy and green. Petals have a soft, velvety texture.

A tall, bushy plant with large, round flower clusters. Bright pink, blue, or white blooms with layered petals. Leaves are large, heart-shaped, and dark green. Stems are thick and covered in soft, fuzzy hairs.

Violet has purple petals with white centers, soft and rounded. Its leaves are heart-shaped, dark green, and slightly fuzzy. The flower stands on a slender stem, bright and delicate, with a subtle glow in the light.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall green stem with soft pink flowers. Big round leaves on top. Bright yellow center in the middle. Small green buds at the bottom. Bright colors and round shapes.

entities.visual_description: A tall, sturdy oak tree with a thick, gnarled trunk and rough, bark-like texture. Broad, dark green leaves fan out from branches. A few acorns hang from twigs. The tree stands strong with a wide, spreading crown.
Tall tree with straight trunk, rough bark in gray and brown. Dark green needles in clusters on branches. Cones at the top, pointed and brown. Leaves sharp and stiff. Strong, sturdy appearance.

A tall tree with a broad, spreading crown. Thick, dark bark with vertical ridges. Long, slender branches reach upward. Bright green leaves are oval, pointed, and arranged in pairs. Small, red seeds hang in clusters at the ends of branches.
