Tall, slender bamboo with smooth, green stalks. Narrow, segmented stems grow in clusters. Leaves are long, thin, and slightly curved. Bright green color with a slight white stripe down the center. Stems have a hollow, cylindrical shape.

Tall, slender tree with a straight trunk and broad, feathered leaves. Green fronds droop from the top, some with small coconuts. Trunk has rough, bark-like texture. Bright green leaves and white coconuts make it instantly recognizable.

A tall mango tree with thick, rough bark in shades of gray and brown. Broad, green leaves form a dense canopy. At its top, clusters of yellow mangoes hang heavy, some ripe and orange, others still green. Branches spread wide, supporting the fruit and creating a shady, tropical look.

A tall tree with thick, gnarled branches. Broad, oval leaves are green on top and lighter underneath. Small, red apples hang in clusters. Bark is rough and gray. Twigs twist upward. Some leaves are just beginning to change to orange.

Tall green stalk with broad, pointed leaves. Large, clustered bananas at the top, yellow with green tips. Thick, ridged trunk. Spiky, leafy stems around the base. Bright yellow flowers at the cluster's end.

A tall, slender tree with white bark that peels in thin, papery strips. It has a narrow, upright trunk and branches that spread out like arms. Its leaves are small, triangular, and dark green, turning golden in fall. It stands alone, surrounded by moss and small stones.

Willow has long, slender branches that drape like hair. Its leaves are narrow, pointed, and light green. The bark is pale, smooth, and gray. It often grows near water, with a graceful, weeping shape. Small yellow flowers appear in spring.

Tall, straight tree with rough, scaly bark in reddish-brown and gray. Broad, spreading branches with sharp, pointed leaves. Dark green foliage on top, lighter underneath. Cones hang from branches. Needle-like leaves in clusters of two or three.

Tall, slender tree with a thick, gnarled trunk. Dark green, needle-like leaves form a dense canopy. Bark is rough, furrowed, and reddish-brown. Long, straight branches reach upward. Crown is wide and conical.

A tall, thick tree with a wide, rounded trunk. Its bark is rough and gray, with deep cracks. Large, umbrella-shaped leaves grow at the top. Long, thin branches reach out. Bright yellow flowers hang from the branches.

Tall tree with smooth, pale bark in shades of white and cream. Broad, lance-shaped leaves with a bluish-green hue. Bright yellow flowers in clusters at the ends of branches. Strong, straight trunk with a single trunk. Dark green, waxy leaves.

Teak is a tall, straight tree with a broad, rounded crown. Its bark is smooth and light gray, often with vertical stripes. Leaves are long, narrow, and dark green. It has sturdy, straight branches and produces small, yellow flowers.

Mahogany tree has a tall, straight trunk with smooth, dark brown bark. Its branches spread wide, forming a rounded crown. Leaves are long, narrow, and dark green. Small, red flowers bloom at the base of the tree. Fruits are round, hard, and dark purple.

A rubber tree has thick, smooth bark in light gray with vertical stripes. It has large, oval leaves that are dark green on top and lighter underneath. Long, drooping branches hold clusters of small, white flowers. Its trunk is sturdy and wide at the base.

A tall, thick fig tree with broad, lobed leaves. Dark green, waxy foliage. Small, clustered figs hang from branches. Bark is rough and gray. Twigs have thorns. Fruits are green with a soft, fuzzy skin.

Acacia is a tall, straight tree with a thick, gnarled trunk. It has a wide, spreading crown of feathery, green leaves. Its branches are slender and droop downward. Small, yellow flowers bloom in clusters at the ends of the branches. The bark is rough and grayish-brown with deep cracks.

A tall, slender tree with dark green needles. Sharp, cone-shaped crown. Bark is rough and gray. Long, thin branches reach upward. Small, cone-like fruits hang from branches. Needles are soft and slightly curved.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall tree with a thick, brown trunk and green leaves. The trunk is straight and strong. Leaves are wide and green, some shaped like hands. Small white flowers bloom at the top. Fruits hang from branches, round and yellow.

entities.visual_description: A red apple with a smooth, shiny surface. It has a rounded shape and a small stem at the top. The skin is slightly textured with tiny bumps. A green leaf is attached near the stem. The fruit is firm and juicy, with a sweet aroma.

A yellow banana with a curved shape, smooth skin, and a slight bend. It has a brown stem at the top and a pointed tip. The surface is slightly wrinkled with small brown spots. Bright yellow color with a soft, glossy texture.

A round, bright orange fruit with a smooth, slightly textured skin. It has a pointed stem at the top and a small, narrow base. The color is vivid and uniform, with a slight glossy sheen. The fruit is firm and slightly oval in shape.

A round, dark purple grape with a slightly wrinkled skin. It has a tiny stem at the top and a pointed end. The surface is shiny and smooth, with a juicy, plump interior. Bright green seeds are visible inside.

A large, oval fruit with a thick, yellow-orange skin. It has a rough, textured surface with small bumps. The skin is slightly curved at the top, with a pointed end. The fruit is bright and juicy, with a sweet aroma.

A pineapple has a spiky, green exterior with a rough, diamond-shaped pattern. Its top is a crown of leafy green fronds. The fruit is yellow and golden on the outside, with a slightly pointed tip. It has a textured, segmented surface with a sweet, tropical aroma.

A large, round watermelon with a rough, green exterior. Bright red flesh inside, streaked with dark black seeds. Thick, juicy texture. Smooth, waxy skin with a dull, matte finish. Bright green tendrils at the bottom.

A bright red fruit with a slightly curved shape. It has a smooth, glossy surface with tiny green seeds visible on the top. The stem is green and attached at the top. It has a soft, juicy appearance with a slight indentation at the bottom.

A round, yellow fruit with a smooth, slightly wrinkled skin. It has a green stem at the top and a small, pointed tip. The surface has a dull, shiny mix of yellow and green tones. It looks juicy and fresh.

A round, fuzzy peach with a golden-yellow skin and a slight blush of pink. Smooth, soft texture with a small stem at the top. Bright red seeds visible inside. Sweet, juicy appearance with a slight indentation at the bottom.

A plump, round fruit with a deep purple skin, slightly wrinkled. Bright red flesh inside, juicy and sweet. Has a small stem at the top and a pointed tip at the bottom. Smooth, shiny surface with a slight blush of red on the skin.

A bright red cherry with a smooth, glossy skin. It has a small stem at the top and a pointed tip. The fruit is round, firm, and juicy. A few tiny white seeds are visible inside. It looks plump and fresh, with a shiny, deep red color.

A small, oval fruit with a fuzzy brown skin. Green spots cover the surface. A white, fuzzy interior surrounds a black seed. The fruit is about the size of a plum. It has a pointed tip and a rounded bottom.

names.ja: ドラゴンフルーツ (Doragon furūtsu)

entities.visual_description: Bright pink skin with green speckles, oval shape, soft texture. White flesh with tiny black seeds. Has a crown of green leaves at the top. Appears juicy and tropical.
A large, orange-yellow fruit with a rough, speckled skin. It has a pointed stem end and a rounded bottom. The skin is slightly wrinkled with green spots. The fruit is firm and heavy for its size.

A round, green fruit with a smooth skin covered in small, white bumps. It has a pale yellow flesh inside, dotted with tiny, dark seeds. The fruit is firm and slightly textured, with a sweet, tropical aroma.

A lychee fruit is round with a rough, bumpy red skin. It has a single, smooth, white seed inside. The skin is thick and has a fragrant, sweet scent. The fruit is small, about the size of a cherry. It has a pointed tip at the top.

A longan fruit has a smooth, round skin that is pale yellow with a slight blush. It has a small, pointed stem at the top and a soft, fuzzy texture. The fruit is about the size of a plum and has a sweet, fragrant aroma.

A large, spiky green fruit with a thick, leathery shell. It has a crown of sharp, pointed spines on top. The skin is rough and bumpy, with a strong, unpleasant odor. Inside, it contains soft, creamy flesh in segments.

A coconut has a thick, hairy brown shell with a pointed top. It has three distinct eyes on the top, and a small hole at the base. The outer husk is rough and fibrous, with a white, soft interior inside the hard shell.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright red apple hangs from a green leafy branch. The tree has a thick brown trunk and small green leaves. The apple is round, shiny, and has a white stem. The leaves are pointed and spread out.

entities.visual_description: A bright orange carrot with smooth skin and a pointed tip. It has a firm, cylindrical shape and a slightly curved end. The surface is slightly wrinkled with small bumps. It stands upright with a thin, green stem at the top.

A round, brown potato with smooth skin and a slightly wrinkled texture. It has a pale yellow interior, firm and starchy. The top is slightly rounded, with small eyes visible. It looks like a small, oval-shaped vegetable with a rough, earthy appearance.

A bright red, round fruit with smooth, shiny skin. Thick stem at the top, small leaves at the base. Green, pointed leaves around the stem. Tiny, yellow flowers at the top. Firm, juicy interior with seeds inside.
A round, bulbous vegetable with layered, papery skin in shades of yellow, white, and brown. It has a pointed top and a flat bottom, with concentric rings visible through the translucent layers.

A cluster of white, bulbous cloves wrapped in papery skin. Each clove is rounded, with a slightly pointed tip. The skin is dry, yellowish-white, and has a textured, wrinkled surface. The whole garlic head is compact and firm to the touch.

A round, green vegetable with crinkled leaves and a white stem. It has a rough, waxy surface and tightly packed, pale green layers. The top is slightly pointed, and the bottom is flat with a white ring.

A tall, leafy green plant with broad, wavy leaves. Dark green on top, lighter underneath. Crisp, juicy texture. Has a thick, white stem. Often found in gardens or grocery stores. Bright green leaves with a slightly curly edge.

A tall, leafy plant with dark green, oval-shaped leaves. Broad, pointed leaves with smooth edges. Stems are thick and light green. Has a deep green, slightly curled leaf at the top. Leaves are arranged in a rosette pattern.

A tall, green vegetable with thick, woody stalks and tightly packed, dark green florets. Each floret has small, white buds at the center. The leaves are broad, crinkled, and slightly curled. The whole plant has a rough, textured surface with a slightly fuzzy feel.

A cauliflower has a round, white head made of small, tightly packed florets. The stem is thick and green, with a rough texture. It has a slightly crinkled surface and a firm, solid shape. The florets are soft and tender, with a mild, slightly bitter taste.

A long, green cucumber with a slightly bumpy surface. It has a smooth, pale green skin and a pointed end. The stem is thin and attached near the top. It looks fresh and juicy, with a slightly curved shape.
A large, purple vegetable with smooth, shiny skin. It has a rounded shape and a slightly pointed end. The surface is firm and has a deep, rich color. It stands upright on thick, sturdy stems.
A round, orange pumpkin with a rough, bumpy skin. It has a flat top and a pointed bottom. Dark green stems and leaves grow from the top. Some have small, white flowers nearby.

A tall, green plant with broad, flat leaves at the top. A thick, sturdy stalk holds a cluster of golden, plump ears. Each ear has tightly wrapped, silvery husks and rows of round, yellow kernels. The plant has deep green, jagged leaves along the stem.

A bell pepper has smooth, waxy skin in shades of green, red, yellow, or orange. It is round with a flat top and bottom, and has a firm, segmented interior. Its thick walls and small seeds make it instantly recognizable as a vegetable.
A bright red, round vegetable with a smooth, slightly wrinkled skin. It has a white, crisp interior and a small green stem at the top. The radish is firm and has a distinct, oval shape.

A tall, green stalk with ridges and a white core. Thin, leafy fronds at the top. Bright green veins run through the stalk. Has a crisp, watery texture. Often found in bunches with a fresh, green appearance.

Tall, slender green stalks with tiny, pointed leaves at the top. White, tender stems with a slightly fibrous texture. Bright green, cone-shaped tips at the end of each stalk. Bright green, smooth skin with a slightly waxy feel.
A small, round green vegetable with a smooth, slightly wrinkled surface. It has a pale yellow interior and a tiny stem at the top. The pea is firm and has a slightly pointed end.

A green bean is a slender, curved pod with a smooth, shiny green surface. It has small, pointed ends and tiny, visible seeds inside. The skin is firm and slightly textured, with a bright, fresh green color. It stands upright, often seen in clusters on a vine.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright green stem with thick, waxy leaves. Small yellow flowers bloom at the top. A round, red fruit hangs below. The plant has a bushy shape with smooth, shiny leaves.

entities.visual_description: Basil has dark green, oval leaves with a slightly wrinkled texture. Its stems are square and upright, with small, purple flowers at the top. The leaves are fragrant and have a shiny surface. It has a compact, bushy shape with a light green stem.

Mint is a small, bushy plant with bright green, wrinkled leaves. It has square stems and tiny white flowers. The leaves are pointed and have a cool, fresh scent. It grows in clusters and has a compact, tidy shape.

Rosemary has silver-green needle-like leaves with a piney scent. It has small blue flowers in clusters, soft stems, and a bushy shape. The leaves are stiff and pointed, with a grayish hue. It looks like a small shrub with fragrant, spiky foliage.

Thyme is a small, bushy plant with tiny, fragrant leaves. It has green, oval-shaped leaves arranged in pairs. The stems are square and slightly hairy. Tiny white flowers bloom in clusters at the tips. It has a woody base and grows close to the ground.

Oregano is a small, bushy plant with dark green, wrinkled leaves. It has tiny, white flowers and thin, square stems. The leaves are oval and slightly curled, with a strong, aromatic scent. It grows in clusters, often in dry, sunny areas.

Parsley has bright green, feather-like leaves with curled edges. It has small, white flowers in clusters. Its stems are light green and thin. The leaves are flat and arranged in a compact, bushy shape. It has a fresh, herb-like scent.

Cilantro has feathery, green leaves with a slightly serrated edge. The stems are thin and light green, with small, white flowers at the top. It grows in clusters, with a fresh, bright appearance. The leaves are soft and delicate, with a slightly curled shape.
Dill has feathery, green leaves with fine, thread-like strands. It has small, yellow flowers in umbels. The stems are thin and branched. It grows tall and upright with a delicate, airy appearance.

Sage has gray-green, fuzzy leaves with silver veins. It has square stems and small blue flowers. The leaves are wrinkled and slightly curled. It grows in clusters, with a compact, bushy shape. The overall look is soft and textured, with a calming, earthy appearance.

Chives are tall, slender plants with hollow, cylindrical leaves. They have a purple flower spike at the top. The leaves are soft, light green, and slightly curved. They grow in clusters, often in gardens or lawns. The flowers are small and clustered together.

Lemongrass has tall, slender green stalks with a light yellow base. Its leaves are long, narrow, and slightly curved, with a smooth, waxy texture. The plant has a fresh, citrusy scent and stands upright with a neat, grass-like appearance.

Ginger has a knobby, brown root with a rough, hairy skin. It has green shoots growing from the top, with broad, pointed leaves. The plant has a strong, spicy scent and small white flowers at the base of the leaves.

Turmeric is a tall, slender plant with bright yellow rhizomes. Its leaves are broad, green, and slightly curled. The stems are green and have a rough texture. The plant has a strong, earthy scent and grows in clusters near water.

Galangal has knobby, finger-like roots with brown skin and white flesh. It has narrow, grass-like leaves with a sharp, pointed tip. The plant stands upright with a strong, woody stem. Its leaves are dark green and have a slightly rough texture.

A bay leaf is a dark green, oval-shaped leaf with a slightly curled edge. It has a smooth, leathery texture and a pointed tip. The leaf is narrow and has a faint, wavy pattern along its surface. It is typically found in clusters on the bay tree.

Fennel has feathery, light green leaves with fine, thread-like veins. Its stems are slender and slightly hairy. Small, yellow flowers cluster at the top, and it has a bulbous base with a strong, licorice-like scent.

Tarragon has slender, upright stems with fine, gray-green leaves. The leaves are narrow, slightly curled, and have a soft, feathery texture. It produces small, pale green flowers in clusters. The plant has a delicate, aromatic scent.

Marjoram is a small, bushy plant with bright green, oval leaves. It has tiny, white flowers in clusters. The stems are square and slightly hairy. It grows low to the ground, with a compact, neat shape. The leaves are slightly wrinkled and have a strong, aromatic scent.

Lavender is a tall, slender plant with purple flowers. It has green, needle-like leaves and a woody stem. The flowers are clustered in spikes, with soft purple petals and yellow centers. It has a fragrant scent and grows in sunny, well-drained soil.

Stevia is a small plant with green, heart-shaped leaves. Its leaves are bright green, slightly serrated, and have a soft, fuzzy texture. The stems are thin and upright, with tiny white flowers at the top. The leaves are often curled and have a slightly waxy appearance.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall green stem with soft, rounded leaves. Small white flowers bloom at the top. The plant has a bushy shape with bright green leaves and white blossoms. It stands upright with a full, rounded top.

entities.visual_description: A Button Mushroom has a round, white cap with a slight bump in the center. Its stem is thick, pale, and slightly curved. Small, scattered gills run from the stem to the edge of the cap. The surface is smooth and slightly sticky to the touch.

A round, brown mushroom with a slightly curved cap. The surface has a smooth, shiny texture with small bumps. A slender stem rises from the center. The color is deep brown with a lighter edge. The cap is wide and flat.

The oyster mushroom has a fan-shaped cap with a smooth, pale brown surface. Its edges are curled inward, and the stem is short and thick. The gills are pale, closely spaced, and run down the stem. The cap is slightly sticky when touched.

Enoki mushrooms have long, white stems with a slight curve. They grow in clusters, with small, umbrella-like caps that are pale yellow. The stems are smooth and slim, and the caps have a slight indentation in the center. They look delicate and fresh, with a soft, powdery texture on the caps.

The straw mushroom has a pale yellow cap with a slightly curled edge. Its stem is white and hollow, with a small ring near the base. The surface is smooth and slightly sticky, with a faint brownish hue on the stem. The cap is rounded and often has a small, pointed tip.

A small, umbrella-shaped mushroom with a brown, velvety cap. The cap has a distinctive hole in the center. The stem is short and thick, with a ring near the top. The surface is soft and spongy to the touch.

zh.pinyin: bō tè bèi luó mó gū

entities.visual_description: A Portobello mushroom has a large, round cap with a brown, wrinkled surface. The stem is thick and slightly bulbous, with a pale, fibrous texture. The edges of the cap are curled inward, and the gills are pale, running from the stem to the cap's edge.

A small, brown mushroom with a rounded cap. The cap is smooth and slightly sticky. The stem is short and thick, with a ring near the top. The surface has a soft, earthy texture. The color is light to dark brown, with a slightly curled edge on the cap.

The chanterelle has a golden cap with wavy edges, covered in small, rounded bumps. Its stem is pale yellow, smooth, and slightly curved. The gills are thick, sticky, and cream-colored, running down the stem. The cap is wide and umbrella-shaped, with a slightly sticky surface.

Morel has a rounded, honeycomb cap with a dark brown, wrinkled surface. Its stem is pale, smooth, and slightly swollen at the base. The cap is usually light brown with a yellowish center. It has a distinct, sponge-like texture on top.

A small, round fungus with a rough, bark-like skin. Brown and gray bumps cover its surface. It has a wrinkled, earthy texture. Dark, speckled patches blend into a muddy color. No visible stem or cap. Slightly bulbous shape.

The Lion's Mane Mushroom has a white, fluffy, pinecone-like cap with soft, radiating tendrils. Its stem is short and off-white, with a slightly bulbous base. The texture is spongey and porous, giving it a cloud-like appearance.
A large, dark brown mushroom with a wrinkled cap. Broad, thick stems. Spore sacs in clusters at the top. Smooth, slimy texture. Deep grooves and ridges on the cap. Golden gills beneath the cap.

ja.syllable: マ イ タ ケ

entities.visual_description: A tall, slender mushroom with a wide, umbrella-shaped cap. The cap is brown with a slightly curled edge. The stem is smooth, pale, and slightly curved. The surface has a fine, fuzzy texture. The color fades from brown to light tan near the stem.

ja.syllable: ポ ル チ ー ニ

entities.visual_description: Porcini mushrooms have a large, umbrella-shaped cap with a brown, scaly texture. The stem is thick, white, and slightly bulbous at the base. The gills are pale, and the skin has a slightly sticky feel. The cap is often curled at the edges.

ja.syllable: キン グ オ イ ス テ ー

entities.visual_description: A large, round mushroom with a golden-brown cap, smooth and slightly sticky. White gills run from the cap to the stem. The stem is thick, pale, and slightly curved. A ring is visible near the top of the stem. The surface has a shiny, glossy appearance.

ja.syllable: ブラッ ク ト ラン ペ ット

entities.visual_description: The Black Trumpet has a dark, wrinkled cap with a smooth, trumpet-shaped body. Its stem is thick and short, with a bulbous base. The surface is rough and dotted with small, irregular pores. It has a deep, earthy color with subtle gray and brown tones.

ja.syllable: ビッ チ マッ ッシュ ルーム

entities.visual_description: Beech mushroom has a pale yellow cap with a slight brownish tint, smooth and slightly sticky. The stem is white with a ring near the base. Small, rounded gills are pale brown. The cap is umbrella-shaped and slightly curled at the edges.

ja.syllable: パ ディ スト ロ マッ ッシュ ルーム

entities.visual_description: The Paddy Straw Mushroom has a white, umbrella-shaped cap with a slightly curled edge. Its stem is pale yellow, slender, and slightly bent. The surface is smooth and shiny, with a faint ring near the base. The gills are pale yellow and closely spaced.

ja.syllable: シー ザー マッ ッシュ ルーム

entities.visual_description: A Caesar's Mushroom has a pale yellow cap with a distinctive white ring around the stem. The stem is thick and white, with a bulbous base. The gills are pale yellow, and the mushroom has a smooth, slimy texture. It grows in clusters on decaying wood.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall, slender mushroom with a rounded, brown cap and a thick, white stem. The cap has a soft, fuzzy texture. The stem is sturdy and connects the cap to the earth. The whole mushroom stands alone, slightly curved at the top.

ja.syllable: サ グ ア ロ

entities.visual_description: A tall, spindly cactus with a thick, branching trunk. It has a rough, gray-green skin with white spines. Its arms spread out like fingers, and it bears small, red flowers at the tips. The base is wide and sturdy, with a wrinkled texture.

ja.syllable: バ ー ル カ クトス

entities.visual_description: A tall, spiky barrel cactus with a rounded, green body. It has thick, ribbed stems and short, spiky arms. Bright yellow flowers bloom at the top. Its rough, waxy skin has a textured, bumpy surface.

A tall, spiky cactus with thick, green stems covered in bright red spines. It has clusters of yellow flowers at the top, and small, oval-shaped fruits hanging from the stems. The skin is rough and waxy, with a pale green color.

names.ja: クリスマス・サボテン

entities.visual_description: A Christmas cactus has thick, segmented stems with waxy, pointed leaves. Its stems are green with red or pink bumps. It has bright, star-shaped flowers in red, pink, or white. The leaves are fleshy and arranged in a zigzag pattern.

names.ja: イースター・サボテン

zh.pinyin: fù huó jié xiān rén zhǎng

entities.visual_description: A compact, rounded plant with thick, segmented stems. Each segment is slightly swollen at the top, with small, rounded leaves. Bright green stems have soft, fuzzy texture. Tiny, clustered flowers bloom in pink and white, resembling Easter eggs.

A Moon Cactus has a round, fat stem with a bright green body. It has a small, round, white or pale pink top that looks like a moon. The stem is thick and smooth, with spines along the edges. It has a soft, waxy texture and bright green color.

A tall, spiky cactus with a rounded, golden-yellow body. It has thick, segmented stems and short, stiff spines. Bright green leaves grow at the base. The top has a wide, flat, spiky crown. Its color is vivid and shiny in the sunlight.

names.ja: ヘッジホッグサボテン

ja.syllable: ヘッジホッグサボテン

entities.visual_description: Spiky green stem with rounded, segmented body. Short, soft spines cover the surface. Bright yellow flowers bloom at the top. Thick, waxy leaves form a dense, rounded shape. Brown, segmented stem with a rough texture.

names.ja: オルガンパイプサボテン

zh.pinyin: guǎn fēng qín xiān rén zhǎng

entities.visual_description: The Organ Pipe Cactus has tall, ribbed stems with deep green color. It has thick, spiny arms that branch out like fingers. Each arm ends in a rounded, swollen tip. The cactus has short, stiff spines and a rough, textured surface. It stands upright with a sturdy, columnar shape.

A tall, spiky cactus with a wide, flat top. Bright green stems covered in small, rounded bumps. Short, stiff spines along the sides. A crown of soft, fuzzy white flowers at the top. Bright yellow flowers bloom in clusters.

A tall, spiky cactus with wrinkled, gray-green skin. It has thick, twisted arms ending in sharp spines. Its top is a rounded, brownish head with a small, red flower. The whole plant looks ancient and rugged, like an old man with a crown of thorns.

names.ja: レディフィンガーサボテン

entities.visual_description: A tall, spiky cactus with a slender, finger-like shape. Bright green stems with soft, rounded edges. Covered in small, white spines. Has a thick, swollen base and short, branching arms. Bright yellow flowers bloom at the tips.

names.ja: フィッシュフックサボテン

entities.visual_description: A tall, spiny cactus with a thick, green stem and bright red flowers. It has long, sharp spines and a hooked shape at the top. The flowers are vibrant and stand out against the green body.

Tall, spiny cactus with a thick, green trunk and bright red flowers at the top. Thick, waxy leaves form a crown. Bright yellow spines cover the body. Red flowers bloom in clusters at the top. Bright green stem with a rough texture.

names.ja: トーテムポールサボテン

zh.pinyin: tú téng zhù xiān rén zhǎng

entities.visual_description: A tall, spiky cactus with a slender trunk and a crown of bright red flowers. It has thick, waxy stems and sharp, green spines. The flowers bloom in clusters at the top, adding a vibrant splash of color to the desert landscape.

A tall, spiny cactus with thick, segmented stems. Bright green, ribbed body. Numerous small, sharp spines in clusters. Some stems bend slightly. Has a rough, textured surface. Appears sturdy and desert-adapted.

zh.pinyin: jù zhù xiān rén zhǎng shǔ

entities.visual_description: Tall, spiny cactus with thick, green stems. Bright yellow flowers bloom at the top. Spines are short and dense. Stem has a rough, bumpy texture. Leaves are modified into spines. Bright green color with white markings.

Small, spiny cactus with bright green stems and clusters of small, rounded, light yellow flowers. Has thick, ribbed stems and short, white spines. Appears compact and sturdy with a unique, otherworldly look.

A tall, spiky cactus with wide, flat stems covered in soft, velvety purple flowers. Each bloom has a deep purple hue with white centers and delicate, fuzzy edges. The plant has a thick, green trunk with small, sharp spines along its sides.

names.ja: ラットテイルスボテン

entities.visual_description: A tall, spiky cactus with a thick, rounded trunk and a long, thin tail-like stem at the top. It has green, ribbed body with sharp spines and a few small, round flowers at the end of the tail. The tail is flexible and slightly curved.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall, thick plant with a spiky green stem. It has wide, flat leaves at the top. Bright yellow flowers bloom at the end of the stem. The plant is short and round, with soft spines. It stands upright on the ground.

entities.visual_description: Green vines with heart-shaped leaves climb along a trellis, twisting around wooden posts. Bright yellow flowers bloom in clusters, adding a cheerful touch. The plant has a soft, textured appearance with tiny, fuzzy stems and delicate, curling tendrils.

A grapevine has twisting, green stems with small, heart-shaped leaves. It has clusters of tiny, green grapes along its branches. The vine has tendrils that curl around supports. Its bark is rough and brown, with visible growth patterns.

Morning Glory is a climbing vine with heart-shaped leaves and trumpet-like flowers. Bright purple petals curve upward, with a white throat. It has a spiral stem that twines around supports, and small green tendrils at the tips.

Wisteria has long, hanging clusters of purple flowers. Its vines twist and climb, covered in small leaves. The flowers bloom in soft purple, hanging in loose bunches. The stems are green and flexible, with tiny, heart-shaped leaves.

Honeysuckle is a climbing vine with small, fragrant flowers. It has green, heart-shaped leaves and thin, twisting stems. Its flowers are yellow with a red or orange throat, often appearing in pairs. The vine has a sweet scent and produces small, red berries.

Bright green vines with heart-shaped leaves, clusters of waxy, purple flowers with yellow centers. Each flower has five petals and a spiral pattern. Bright red berries grow at the base of the flowers.

Bougainvillea has vibrant pink, red, or orange bracts surrounding small white flowers. Its woody stems are thorny and trailing, with glossy green leaves. The plant grows in dense, colorful clusters, often cascading from supports.

Dark green leaves with waxy texture, twisted vines climbing upward. Small, black pepper-like fruits hang in clusters. Bright red stems with white veins. Spiky, oval berries with a glossy surface. Vines curl around supports, showing growth and movement.

The Betel Vine has thick, twisting stems with heart-shaped leaves that are dark green on top and lighter underneath. It bears small, red berries clustered along the vines, with a waxy, shiny surface. The leaves have a slightly rough texture and prominent veins.

A Vanilla Orchid vine has pale green stems with soft, velvety leaves. It bears clusters of white, fragrant flowers with purple veins. Each bloom has a slender, curved lip and a sweet scent. The vine grows along branches, trailing gently with delicate, waxy petals.

Clematis has long, twisting vines with heart-shaped leaves. It has clusters of small, fragrant flowers in shades of purple, blue, and white. The stems are slender and covered in fine hairs. Bright yellow stamens peek out from the petals.

Trumpet vine has heart-shaped leaves with pointed tips, bright green on top and lighter underneath. It has long, twisting vines with orange-yellow flowers shaped like trumpets, five petals, and a curled throat. Bright red stamens contrast with the yellow.

Jasmine Vine has twisting, green stems with heart-shaped leaves. Small, white flowers with yellow centers bloom along the vines. The plant has a fragrant scent and delicate, curling tendrils that grip surfaces.

A Moonflower is a climbing vine with large, white, star-shaped blooms that glow softly at night. Its petals are thick and waxy, with a faint blue tint. The vine has heart-shaped leaves and tendrils that curl around supports.

Climbing rose has thick, twisted stems with thorns. Leaves are dark green, oval, and slightly serrated. Flowers are pink, layered, and bloom in clusters. Petals are soft and velvety. Vines climb using tendrils and spread across surfaces.

names.ja: イングリッシュアイビー

entities.visual_description: English Ivy has dark green, shiny leaves with curled edges. It grows in thick, tangled vines with small, white flowers. Its stems are flexible and often climb walls or trees. The leaves are heart-shaped and slightly toothed. It spreads quickly with tiny, green berries in fall.

names.ja: バージニアクリーパー

entities.visual_description: Virginia creeper has heart-shaped leaves with pointed tips, bright green on top and lighter underneath. It climbs with tendrils, often covering walls. In fall, leaves turn bright red or orange. Small, yellow berries appear in clusters.

Creeping fig has trailing stems with small, heart-shaped leaves. Leaves are glossy green, slightly wavy, and have a pale underside. It grows close to the ground, spreading outward with tiny, pale flowers in spring.

names.ja: スカーレットランナービーン

entities.visual_description: Scarlet Runner Bean vines have bright red flowers with yellow centers, trailing along green stems. Leaves are heart-shaped, deep green, and slightly fuzzy. Small, bean-like pods hang from the vines, turning yellow as they mature.

Kudzu is a fast-growing vine with thick, green stems covered in tiny, fuzzy leaves. Its heart-shaped leaves are light green with a slightly hairy texture. It produces small, pale green flowers in clusters, and its tendrils curl around supports as it climbs.

subcategories.visual_description: A green vine with long, twisting stems climbs upward. Small, heart-shaped leaves grow along the stem. Tiny white flowers bloom at the ends of the stems. The vine has a soft, flexible look and is covered in tiny green bumps.

entities.visual_description: A Boston Fern has feathery, arching fronds with a deep green color. Each frond is divided into smaller, finger-like segments. The plant has a compact, bushy shape with a thick, upright trunk. Its leaves are soft and slightly curled at the tips.

names.vi: Dương xỉ tóc thần vệ nữ
names.ja: メイデンヘア・フェーン

entities.visual_description: The maidenhair fern has delicate, lace-like fronds with feathery splits. Each leaf is dark green, with a slightly curled edge. The fronds grow in a tight, upright cluster. Small, spore-bearing structures dot the leaf tips. The overall look is soft and intricate, like a tiny, green lace doily.

names.ja: バードネスト・フェーン

entities.visual_description: A Bird's Nest Fern has a broad, upright frond with a curled, nest-like base. Its dark green leaves are wavy and have a velvety texture. The plant has a thick, sturdy stem and produces small, spore-bearing structures at the base.

A staghorn fern has a thick, curled leaf like a deer's antler. Its fronds are broad, wavy, and dark green. The plant has a central trunk with a rough, bark-like texture. It grows on trees, with roots hanging down. The leaves are leathery and slightly curled at the tips.

Bracken is a tall fern with feathery, triangular fronds. Its dark green leaves are broad and stiff, with a rough texture. The fronds have a curled, finger-like shape and a light brown stem. It grows in clusters on the forest floor.

names.ja: シュレンキ・フェーン

entities.visual_description: Tall, slender tree fern with a thick, fibrous trunk and a crown of feathery, green fronds. The trunk has a rough, bark-like texture. Fronds are long, narrow, and layered, with a soft, wispy appearance. Some have brown, curled tips.

A silver fern has feathery, lance-shaped fronds with a silvery-blue hue. The fronds are curled and layered, with a soft, waxy texture. Each leaf has a delicate, fern-like structure and a pale, metallic sheen under light.

Button fern has a compact, rounded shape with soft, fuzzy green fronds. Each leaf is round and button-like, with a slightly curled edge. The fronds are light green, covered in tiny, fuzzy hairs. It has a short, thick stem and grows close to the ground.

names.ja: カンガルー・フェーン

entities.visual_description: The Kangaroo Fern has long, arching fronds with a zigzag pattern. Each leaf is dark green, glossy, and has a rough texture. The fronds are divided into finger-like segments, giving it a feathery look. It has a sturdy, upright stem with a rough, brown surface.

Holly Fern has tall, slender fronds with a zigzag edge. Each leaf is dark green, glossy, and slightly curled. The fronds grow upright, with a neat, clustered appearance. Small, spore-bearing clusters are visible on the underside of the leaves.

A sword fern has long, narrow, sword-shaped fronds with a dark green top and lighter green underside. The fronds are stiff and upright, with a curled tip. Small, fuzzy spore cases dot the leaf edges. The plant has a thick, dark brown, segmented stem.

Lady Fern has feathery, light green fronds with a curled, fuzzy texture. Its crown is round and soft, with tiny, spore-bearing clusters at the top. The stems are slender and bend gracefully, with a pale, mossy base.

The Royal Fern has tall, feathery fronds with a dark green, glossy surface. Its crown is a cluster of bright orange spore sacs. The fronds are stiff and upright, with a slender, branched stem. The leaves are long, narrow, and slightly curled at the tips.

names.ja: ウォーター・ファーン

entities.visual_description: A water fern has feathery, light green fronds that float on water. Its leaves are long, narrow, and split into delicate, finger-like tips. The plant has a soft, waxy texture and grows in clusters. It has a pale, translucent stem and tiny, spore-producing structures at the leaf ends.

names.ja: リザレクション・ファーン

entities.visual_description: Tiny, moss-like green fronds hang in clusters, curled and wrinkled. They have a soft, velvety texture with a dusty gray underside. The fronds are delicate, with a zigzag pattern along their edges. They grow on bark, twisting around branches in tight, spiral shapes.

names.ja: ラビット・フット・ファーン

ja.ipa: おるて ごぴとにぬ

entities.visual_description: A Rabbit's Foot Fern has feathery, light green fronds with a fuzzy texture. Its distinctive, round, brown rhizomes look like rabbit feet. The plant has a compact, bushy shape with soft, curled leaves. The fronds are delicate and slightly curled at the tips.

Lace Fern has delicate, feathery fronds with intricate, lacy patterns. Its leaves are light green, soft and airy, with fine, branching veins. The fronds curl slightly at the tips, giving it a graceful, flowing look. It has a compact, upright shape with a textured, matte surface.

Autumn Fern has feather-like fronds with bronze and gold edges, curled and crinkled. Its leaves are dark green with a rusty brown tip, soft and delicate. The plant has a wiry stem with tiny, fuzzy brown spores at the base.

names.ja: クライミング・ファーン

entities.visual_description: Climbing fern has long, slender fronds with feathery, delicate leaves. Its stems twist around supports, with small, scale-like structures along the vines. The fronds are light green, with a slightly curled edge. Bright spore cases dot the underside of the leaves.

A Shield Fern has a broad, shield-shaped frond with a smooth, dark green top and lighter underside. Its leafy structure is compact, with curled, feather-like segments along the edges. The base is thick and sturdy, with a rough, textured surface.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall, slender plant with a green, upright stem. Large, feathery leaves spread out from the top, each leaf made of many small, pointed parts. The leaves are bright green and soft looking. No flowers or fruits are visible.

entities.visual_description: Tall, slender tree with a straight trunk and crown of feathery leaves. Broad, fan-shaped fronds at the top. Smooth, gray bark. Spiky, green coconut fruits hang from branches. Bright green leaves with a silvery underside.

Tall, slender tree with a thick, trunk covered in ridges. Broad, fan-shaped leaves at the top, green and feathery. Small, clustered fruits at the base, brown and oval. Trunk has a rough, bark-like texture.

Tall, slender tree with a straight trunk and broad, feather-like leaves at the top. Large, fan-shaped leaves at the base. Smooth, gray bark. Spiky, yellow flowers at the top. Long, slender fruits with a woody shell and oily seeds inside.

The Areca Palm has tall, slender trunks with a smooth, grayish-brown color. It has large, feather-like leaves at the top, arranged in a crown. The leaves are bright green, long, and narrow, with a pointed tip. The trunk is straight and slightly curved at the base.

A tall, slender palm with a crown of long, narrow leaves. The trunk is smooth and gray, with a few leaf bases near the top. The leaves are bright green, curved, and spread out like a fan. The plant has a simple, elegant shape.

Tall, slender trunk with smooth, gray bark. Broad, fan-shaped crown of long, arching fronds. Dark green, feathery leaves at the top. Trunk has a swollen base with a crownshaft. Fronds curve outward like a royal fan.

The foxtail palm has a slender, tall trunk with a smooth, grayish-brown surface. It features a crown of long, narrow, feather-like leaves that curve outward, giving it a feathery, elegant look. The leaves are bright green and slightly pointed at the tips.

The Bismarck Palm has a tall, slender trunk with a smooth, grayish-brown color. It features a crown of large, feather-like leaves that are bright green and slightly curled. The leaves are arranged in a fan shape at the top.

The Sago Palm has a thick, trunk-like stem with a crown of feathery, fan-shaped leaves. Its leaves are dark green, stiff, and arranged in a tight circle. The trunk is short and smooth, with a rough, bark-like texture. Small, clustered flowers appear at the base of the leaves.

Tall, slender trunk with smooth, gray bark. Broad, feather-like fronds spread outward in a fan shape. Dark green leaves with white veins. Spiky, cone-like fruit at the top. Bright yellow flowers near the base.

A tall, slender palm with a single, straight trunk. Broad, feather-like leaves fan out at the top. The trunk has a rough, gray bark with vertical grooves. Small, clustered flowers appear at the base of the leaves.

names.ja: メキシカンファンヤシ

ja.ipa: /メキシカン ファン ヤシ

entities.visual_description: The Mexican Fan Palm has a tall, slender trunk with a smooth, grayish-brown bark. It features a wide, fan-shaped crown of stiff, dark green leaves. The leaves are arranged in a circular pattern, giving it a distinctive, palm-like appearance.

The Traveler's Palm has tall, slender stems with large, fan-shaped leaves. Its leaves are bright green on top and silvery white underneath. Long, narrow leaflets form a striking blue-green pattern. The plant has a tall, slender trunk with a few short, thick roots at the base.

The Nipa palm has a slender, straight trunk with smooth, gray bark. It has feather-like leaves at the top, arranged in a fan shape. Small, clustered flowers grow near the base, and tiny, round fruits hang below the leaves. The trunk is short and thick, with a rough texture.

A tall, slender palm with a smooth, green trunk. Broad, feather-like leaves fan out at the top. The trunk has a rough, ridged texture. Bright yellow flowers bloom at the leaf tips. Long, thin roots spread beneath the soil.

A tall, slender palm with a smooth, green trunk and a crown of wide, waxy leaves. The leaves are light green with a white, fuzzy underside. Small, yellow flowers bloom at the base of the leaves. The trunk has a slight curve and a few small, brown bumps.

The Pindo Palm has a slender trunk with a rough, grayish-brown bark. It has a crown of stiff, bright green leaves that form a rounded shape. The leaves are long and narrow, with a pointed tip. Small, white flowers appear at the base of the leaves.

A tall, slender palm with a smooth, gray trunk and a crown of long, narrow leaves. The leaves are bright green, slightly curled at the tips. Small, clustered flowers appear at the base of the leaves. The trunk has a few horizontal ridges and a few small, brown bumps.

A tall, slender palm with a triangular trunk and smooth, waxy bark. Broad, feather-like leaves fan out at the top. The trunk has a distinct three-sided shape, with ridges running vertically. Bright green leaves with a silvery underside.

ja.ipa: /リップスティック ヤシ

entities.visual_description: A tall, slender palm with bright red, smooth, lipstick-like stems. Broad, feathered leaves curve upward. The trunk is smooth and pinkish, with a glossy finish. Bright red flowers bloom at the top, resembling tiny lips.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall, skinny green trunk with a rough, brown bark. Wide, fan-shaped leaves grow from the top, each leaf made of many small, pointed green parts. At the very top, a yellow flower grows, and below it, a small, round green fruit hangs from the trunk.

entities.visual_description: Green, soft blades grow close to the ground, swaying in the wind. They have a slight curve at the tip, with fine, thread-like textures. The color ranges from light to dark green, often with a slight blue tint. They form dense, low patches across fields and lawns.

Green blades grow close to the ground, soft and flexible. They sway gently in the wind, forming a dense, uniform carpet. Each blade has a pointed tip and a slightly curved edge. The color is bright green, with a slight sheen in sunlight.

A tall, slender plant with thin, green stems and narrow leaves. It grows in rows, with small, white flowers at the top. The leaves are long and slightly curved, with a smooth, grass-like texture. It has a soft, green color and a delicate, upright shape.

Tall, slender stalks with narrow leaves, green and slightly bluish. Feathery, golden seed heads at the top. Narrow, parallel veins on leaves. Soft, flexible stems. Small, clustered flowers at the base. Wind moves the seed heads like dancing flags.

Barley has thin, hollow stems with a bluish-green color. Its leaves are long, narrow, and slightly rolled. Small, fluffy seeds grow in clusters at the top. The plant stands upright with a delicate, grass-like appearance.

Oats have slender, upright stalks with narrow leaves. They grow in dense clusters, with small, beige flowers at the top. The stems are slightly bent, and the leaves are slightly curled. The overall appearance is neat and clustered, with a soft, grass-like texture.

Rye has tall, slender stalks with narrow, flat leaves. The leaves are dark green with a slight blue tint. It grows in dense clusters, with small, spike-like flowers at the top. The stems are sturdy and slightly bent, showing a natural, wild appearance.

Sorghum is a tall, sturdy grass with thick, upright stems. Its leaves are wide, green, and slightly curved. Small, golden flowers form in tight clusters at the top, giving it a fluffy, feathery look. The plant has a rough, textured surface and grows in dense, upright bunches.

Millet has thin, upright stems with small, narrow leaves. The leaves are light green, slightly curled at the edges. Tiny, fluffy seeds form in clusters at the top. The plant grows in tight, compact bunches. Its color is mostly green with a hint of brown at the base.

Tall, slender stalks with broad, flat leaves. Green blades with a slight blue tint. Feathery tassels at the top. Narrow, hollow stems. Small, yellowish flowers in clusters. Rough, ridged texture on the stalks. Bright green color with subtle silver veins.

Tall, thick stalks with dark green, narrow leaves. Purple-brown stems with sharp, fibrous texture. Broad, pointed leaves at the top. Juicy, white interior visible in cut stalks. Vertical ridges along the stem.

Tall, slender stalks with smooth, green skin. Narrow leaves at the top, wide at the base. Light green color, some with white stripes. Stiff and straight, growing in clusters. Has a natural, woody texture.

Lemongrass has tall, slender stalks with a light green color. The leaves are long, narrow, and slightly curved. They have a bright yellow base and a lighter green tip. The plant has a fresh, lemony scent. The stems are hollow and stand upright.

Reed has tall, slender stems with a hollow center. Its leaves are long, narrow, and slightly curved. The plant grows in clusters near water, with a smooth, green surface and a soft, flexible texture. It stands straight and upright, often swaying gently in the breeze.

Tall, feathery plumes rise on slender stems. Silver-green, fluffy seeds sway in the wind. Narrow, grass-like leaves curve downward. Bright yellow flowers bloom at the top. Soft, wispy texture with a bold, upright shape.

Tall, thick grass with wide, flat blades. Green and gray tones. Stalks bend but don't break. Leaves grow in tight bundles. Has a rough, textured surface. Appears dense and sturdy. Looks like a wall of grass.

names.ja: バーミューダグラス (bāmiūda gurās)

entities.visual_description: Bermuda grass has narrow, flat blades with a slight bend. It grows in dense, low mats with a light green color. The leaves are smooth and have a fine texture. It often forms a thick, carpet-like surface. Small, pale flowers appear in clusters.

Fescue is a tall, slender grass with narrow, dark green leaves. It has a tufted growth habit with dense, upright blades. Its stems are slightly bent and have a rough texture. Small, spike-like flowers appear at the top, giving it a distinctive, feathery look.

Bluegrass has slender, dark green blades with a bluish tint. It grows in tight, dense clumps with a fine texture. The leaves are narrow, slightly curved, and have a smooth, waxy surface. It often forms a soft, uniform carpet in lawns and meadows.

Bentgrass has fine, soft blades that curve slightly at the tips. It grows in dense, low mats with a light green color. The leaves are narrow, slightly bent, and often lie close to the ground. It has a smooth, silky texture and forms tight, uniform patches.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall, thin plant with many green, narrow leaves growing straight up. The leaves are long and flat, bending slightly at the tips. Small brown flowers are at the top, clustered closely together. The stem is smooth and light green.

entities.visual_description: A dandelion has a bright yellow flower head with white petals. It grows on a green stem with a hollow, hairy center. The leaves are heart-shaped, dark green, and slightly toothed. It has a white puffball that releases seeds on the wind.

A clover plant has three heart-shaped leaves on one stem, sometimes with a fourth. The leaves are small, dark green, and slightly curled. The stem is thin, upright, and covered in tiny hairs. It grows close to the ground, often in sunny, open areas.

A thistle has spiky, green leaves with sharp edges. Its purple flowers are clustered in a round shape. The stems are thick and covered in tiny, prickly bumps. The leaves are pointed and have a rough texture. The plant has a bushy, compact look with a bright, showy flower center.

Crabgrass has broad, flat leaves that lie close to the ground. Its stems are short and spread out, with a light green color. Small, pale flowers appear at the tips, and the plant grows in clumps. It has a rough texture and often invades lawns.

Tall, thin plant with hairy stems and heart-shaped leaves. Bright green, rough leaves with jagged edges. Small, fluffy yellow flowers at the top. Produces a lot of pollen. Grows in clusters in dry, disturbed soil.

A Bindweed has heart-shaped leaves with scalloped edges, pale green on top and lighter underneath. It has twining stems with hairy ridges, and produces small, trumpet-shaped white flowers with five petals and a yellow center. Its roots are thick and fibrous, often creeping along the ground.
Small, leafy weed with heart-shaped leaves that are light green on top and pale white underneath. Has tiny, inconspicuous flowers in early summer. Stems are thin, hairy, and grow close to the ground.

Foxtail grass has tall, thin stems with a bushy, fluffy top that looks like a fox's tail. It has narrow, grass-like leaves and small, greenish flowers. The seed heads are upright and soft, giving it a distinctive, fluffy appearance.

Goosegrass has broad, flat leaves that lie close to the ground. Its stems are low and sprawling, with small, pale green leaves. It produces tiny, fluffy white flowers that rise on thin stalks. The plant has a rough, hairy texture and grows in dense clusters.

Nutsedge has triangular stems with purple spots. It has three narrow leaves, bright green with white veins. Small, three-sided purple flowers grow at the top. It grows close to the ground, often in wet areas. Its roots are thick and hard to pull.

Chickweed is a small, low-growing plant with tiny, oval leaves that are smooth and slightly hairy. It has small white flowers with five petals, often clustered in groups of two or three. The stems are thin, sprawling, and covered in fine hairs.

Pigweed is a tall, spindly plant with broad, heart-shaped leaves that are rough and hairy. It has a thick, sturdy stem with small, yellow flowers that bloom in clusters. Its leaves are often reddish at the edges and have a waxy texture.

Purslane is a low-growing plant with thick, fleshy stems and oval, shiny leaves. It has small yellow flowers with four petals and stamens. The leaves are often reddish at the edges. It grows close to the ground, with tiny, green seed pods along the stems.

Wild oat has tall, slender stems with thin, grass-like leaves. It grows in clusters, with small, beige flowers at the top. Its seed heads are fluffy and white, resembling a dandelion. The plant has a wiry, flexible look and often spreads along the ground.

names.ja: ジョンソングラス (jonshon guraasu)

entities.visual_description: Johnsongrass has tall, slender stems with broad, flat leaves. Its leaves are light green, slightly curled, and have a waxy texture. It grows in dense clusters, often with a reddish tinge at the base. Small, pale flowers appear at the top, followed by seed heads that look like tiny, fluffy balls.

A tall, thin plant with a brown, jointed stem. It has whorls of small, needle-like leaves at the top. The stem is rough and has a hollow center. It grows in wet, muddy areas. The leaves are green and pointy.

A tall, spindly weed with jagged, dark green leaves. It has a thick, hollow stem with a rough texture. Small, white flowers bloom at the top, and the roots spread widely underground. It grows near water, with a muddy base.

Lamb's quarters has heart-shaped leaves with scalloped edges, covered in fine hairs. The stems are square and hairy. Small yellow flowers appear in clusters at the leaf axils. The plant grows in a bushy shape with a trailing habit.

Beggar-ticks has heart-shaped leaves with serrated edges. It has hairy stems and produces small, yellow flowers. The plant has burrs with hooked seeds that stick to clothing. It grows in dry, disturbed soil. Its leaves are dark green and slightly wrinkled.

Cudweed is a small, low-growing weed with tiny, oval leaves that are pale green and slightly hairy. It has small, yellow flowers clustered in tight groups, and thin, wiry stems that spread along the ground. Its leaves are often covered in fine white hairs, making it look fuzzy and distinct.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall, thin green stem with broad, jagged leaves. Small white flowers bloom at the top. The plant has a rough, waxy texture. Bright yellow seeds are visible on the leaves. The whole plant is green with a few white parts.

entities.visual_description: Small, oval seed with a smooth, hard shell. Light brown with a slight white stripe. Has a pointed end and a rounded base. Slightly wrinkled surface. Appears dry and compact. Bright yellow inside when split open.

Small, oval seed with a smooth, hard shell. Light brown with faint horizontal lines. Has a pointed end and a rounded base. Slightly textured surface with tiny bumps. Appears dry and compact. Bright yellow inside when split open.

names.ja: トウモロコシの種 (Tomorokoshi no tane)

entities.visual_description: Small, oval seed with a smooth, hard shell. Dark brown with a slight wrinkled texture. Has a pointed end and a rounded base. Yellowish-white embryo visible inside. Slightly textured surface with tiny bumps. Bright green sprout emerging from one end.

names.ja: ヒマワリの種 (Himawari no tane)

entities.visual_description: Small, oval seed with a smooth, light brown shell. Has a tiny, dark spot near one end. Slightly wrinkled surface with a hard, dry texture. Bright yellow inside when split open. Has a distinct, flat shape with a pointed end.

names.ja: カボチャの種 (Kabōcha no tane)

entities.visual_description: A small, oval seed with a smooth, hard shell. It has a pale yellowish-brown color with faint stripes. The surface is slightly wrinkled, and one end is slightly pointed. It looks like a tiny, dried-up pumpkin kernel.

Small, oval seed with a light brown coat, slightly wrinkled. Two tiny bumps on top, one larger than the other. White streaks run through the surface. Round and flat, with a smooth texture. Bright yellow inside when split open.

Small, oval-shaped seed with a smooth, brown surface. Has a slight ridge along one side. Dark brown color with a tiny white spot near the tip. Hard and dry to the touch. Has a distinct, flat end. Looks like a tiny, brown capsule.
Small, dark brown seed with a shiny, oval shape. Has a tiny, white hilum spot. Smooth surface with a slightly wrinkled texture. Often found in green pods, but the seed itself is round and compact.

names.ja: マスタードの種 (Masutādo no tane)

entities.visual_description: Small, dark brown seed with a smooth, slightly wrinkled surface. It has a pointed end and a rounded base. The outer coat is hard and shiny, with a slightly yellowish tint. It is tiny, about the size of a grain of sand, and has a uniform shape.
A small, oval seed with a yellow-brown coat, slightly wrinkled. It has a pointed end and a rounded base. The surface is textured with tiny bumps. It is pale yellow with a dark spot near the tip.

A small, oval seed with a beige coat, slightly wrinkled and ridged. It has a pointed end and a rounded base. The surface is smooth but has tiny bumps. It is pale yellow inside, with a hard, dry shell.
A small, round red bean with a smooth, shiny surface. It has a deep red color, slightly wrinkled texture, and a pointed end. The bean is firm and compact, with a natural, dried appearance.

A small, dark brown bean with a smooth, glossy surface. It has a slightly wrinkled texture and a pointed end. The bean is round and firm, with a deep, uniform color. It resembles a tiny, dried seed, perfectly shaped and ready to sprout.
A tiny, oval pea seed with a smooth, beige surface. It has a slightly wrinkled texture and a small, dark spot near one end. The seed is round, firm, and has a pale greenish tint on the outer shell.

A coffee bean is a small, dark brown seed with a smooth, oval shape. It has a slightly wrinkled surface and a pointed end. The bean is firm and has a glossy texture. It is typically found in pairs inside a red, fleshy fruit.

A cocoa bean is a small, oval seed with a smooth, dark brown shell. It has a slightly wrinkled surface and a pointed end. Inside, the white, fleshy pulp is visible, surrounding the hard, flat bean. It is typically about 1 cm long and 0.5 cm wide.
A small, brown acorn with a smooth, oval shape. It has a hard, ridged shell and a pointed tip. The surface is slightly wrinkled, with a dark brown color and a small, rounded base.
Small, oval seed with a hard, brown shell. Has a slightly curved shape and a textured surface. Light brown color with faint white lines. Has a nutty scent and a slightly pointed end.
A small, smooth, green seed with a brown spot. It has a hard outer shell and a tiny white stem. The surface is slightly wrinkled and shiny. It looks like a tiny, round green pearl with a brown mark.

A small, dark brown seed with a smooth, wrinkled surface. It has a pointed end and a rounded base. The seed is hard and dry, with a pale white interior visible through the shell. It is about the size of a grain of rice.

subcategories.visual_description: A small plant with a green stem, round leaves, and a tiny brown seed at the top. The stem is thick and short, with soft green leaves around it. The seed is dark and round, sitting on top of the stem. The whole plant is small and simple.

entities.visual_description: A maple leaf is broad with pointed tips and rounded edges. It has a deep green top side and lighter green underside. Veins run from the tip to the base, creating a web-like pattern. The leaf is usually palm-shaped with 3 to 5 lobes. It has a crisp, waxy texture.

A broad, lobed leaf with a deep green top and lighter green underside. Edges are toothed and slightly curled. Veins run from the tip to the base, creating a web-like pattern. The leaf is sturdy and slightly waxy to the touch.

Long, slender green leaf with a smooth, waxy surface. Narrow tip and broad base, slightly curved. Veins run parallel, light green beneath. Translucent edges, slightly pointed. Has a fresh, plant-like texture.

Large, broad leaf with a waxy, green surface. Curved edges and a pointed tip. Veins run across the surface in a network pattern. Has a slightly curled edge and a smooth, glossy texture. Bright green color with a pale yellow underside.

Broad, round green leaf with a waxy surface. Veins run from center to edges. Smooth, slightly curled edges. Bright green on top, lighter underneath. Spotted with small, dark brown spots. Has a soft, slightly textured feel.

Long, narrow leaf with a pointed tip, smooth green surface, slightly curled edges, and a waxy texture. Veins run lengthwise, dark green and visible. Leaf blade is flat, with a pale white underside. Leaf stem is thin and fibrous, attached near the base.

Fern frond has feathery, layered leaves with a soft green color. Each leaf is divided into many small, pointed segments. The frond has a curled, wavy edge and a slightly curled tip. It looks like a delicate, green feather.

Tiny, slender green needles with a slight curve, covered in a soft white fuzz. They cluster in small groups, attached to a brown stem. Sharp tips and a smooth, waxy surface give them a delicate, natural look.

names.ja: ユーカリの葉 (yūkari no ha)

entities.visual_description: Long, narrow leaf with a smooth, waxy surface. Dark green on top, lighter underneath. Edges slightly curled. Veins run parallel, faint and light. Leaf tip pointed. Broad, flat shape. Bright green color. Soft, leathery texture.

names.ja: オリーブの葉 (orību no ha)

entities.visual_description: Olive leaf is dark green with a slightly wavy edge. It has a smooth, leathery texture. The surface is slightly shiny. Veins run from the base to the tip. The leaf is oval in shape. It has a pointed tip and a rounded base.

A mint leaf is oval with a pointed tip. It has a smooth, slightly waxy surface. Deep green on top, lighter underneath. Edges are slightly curled. Veins run from the base to the tip. Has a fresh, cool appearance.

names.ja: ローリエの葉 (rōrie no ha)

entities.visual_description: The bay leaf is a dark green, oval-shaped leaf with a slightly curled edge. It has a smooth, leathery texture and a pointed tip. The underside is pale green, and the veins are faint and barely visible. It is narrow and has a subtle, waxy sheen.

A tea leaf is dark green with a slightly curled edge. It has a wrinkled surface and a pointed tip. The leaf is narrow and elongated, with a pale green underside. It shows signs of being dried, with a brittle texture and a slightly browned edge.

A grape leaf is broad and heart-shaped, with a deep green top and lighter green underside. It has a slightly wavy edge and tiny hairy bumps. Veins run from the center to the edges, creating a web-like pattern. The leaf is sturdy and slightly curled at the tips.

names.ja: イチジクの葉 (ichijiku no ha)

entities.visual_description: A broad, heart-shaped leaf with smooth edges. Deep green on top, lighter green underneath. Veins run from the center to the edges. Has a slightly wavy border. Bright green color with a soft, glossy texture.

A broad, heart-shaped leaf with smooth edges and a slightly wavy outline. Deep green on top, lighter green underneath. Veins run from the base to the tip, creating a delicate pattern. Has a slightly curled edge and a pointed tip.

names.ja: クローバーの葉 (kurōbā no ha)

entities.visual_description: A clover leaf has three heart-shaped lobes with rounded edges. Each lobe is a deep green, slightly curled. The leaf is small, with a smooth, waxy surface. It has a delicate, symmetrical shape with a tiny stem at the center.

A ginkgo leaf has a fan shape with two lobes. It is bright green with a smooth edge. The leaf has a distinct, asymmetrical pattern. It has a thick, waxy texture. The veins are prominent and branching. The leaf is pale yellow in fall. It has a unique, ancient look.

The curry leaf is a small, oval-shaped leaf with a slightly pointed tip. It has a smooth, waxy surface and a dark green top, lighter green underneath. The edges are slightly curled and the veins are faintly visible, giving it a delicate, feathery look.

A broad, dark green leaf with a wavy edge. The surface is slightly crinkled and has a smooth, glossy texture. It has a pointed tip and a rounded base. The veins are light green and run across the leaf.

subcategories.visual_description: A green plant with a thick, brown stem. Broad, wavy leaves are bright green on top and lighter underneath. Small yellow flowers bloom at the top. The leaves are pointed and have a soft, fuzzy texture.

names.ja: ニンジンの根 (Ninjin no ne)

entities.visual_description: A thick, white carrot root with a smooth, slightly wrinkled surface. It has a pale yellow core and a darker, orange-brown outer layer. The texture is firm and fibrous, with small, visible veins running through the flesh.
A thick, white root with a rough, brown skin. It has a rounded, bulbous shape and small, knobby bumps. The surface is slightly wrinkled and dry. It stands straight, with a pale, firm interior.

A bright red, round vegetable with smooth, firm skin. Thick, tapered shape, slightly wrinkled at the top. Dark green leaves sprout from the top, curled and pointed. Stem is green and sturdy, with small, green leaves along its length.

A thick, white root with rough, brown skin. Long and cylindrical, slightly tapered at the ends. Has small, knobby bumps along its surface. Pale inside, firm to the touch. Appears healthy and fresh, with a natural, earthy texture.

A thick, brown root with rough, knobby skin. Orange flesh inside, streaked with white. Short, stubby shape. Crinkled surface. Earthy tones. Firm texture. Natural, organic look. Rooted in soil. Bright orange color. Distinctive sweet potato shape.

Cassava root is a thick, brown, knobby tuber with rough, uneven skin. It has a pale yellow interior, firm texture, and small, scattered nodes. The surface is dry and slightly wrinkled, with a strong earthy smell.

A thick, brown root with rough, wrinkled skin. Dark brown eyes peek from the top. Long, twisted arms extend from the surface. A wide, flat head with a pointed chin. Short, stubby fingers and toes. A broad, rounded body with a deep, dark color.

A thick, brown root with a rough, knobby surface. Orange-brown skin with small, raised bumps. White, fibrous interior. Curved, tapered shape. Earthy tones. Textured, natural look. Strong, sturdy appearance. Root-like structure. Visible layers and ridges.

Long, thin, and knobby root with a bright orange skin. Has a rough, bumpy texture. The flesh inside is pale yellow and soft. Often found in clusters. Has a slightly curved shape. Bright color makes it stand out.

A thick, knobby root with a rough, brown skin. It has a pale yellow interior and small, pointed buds. The surface is wrinkled and uneven, with a strong, earthy scent. It grows in clusters, with a firm, fibrous texture.

A gnarled, brown root with rough, knotted skin. Dark brown bark peels in strips. Small, pointed buds sprout from the top. Earthy tones with subtle green hints. Thick, twisted shape. Deep grooves and ridges along the surface.

Long, thick, brown roots with a rough, wrinkled surface. Deep grooves run along the length, giving it a twisted, knotted look. The texture is dry and leathery, with a slightly sticky residue. Dark brown color fades to lighter tan at the ends.

Long, white, and cylindrical, the lotus root has a smooth, firm texture with faint brown spots. It is segmented, with a slightly fibrous surface and a pale, crisp interior. The root is straight and thick, often found in muddy water near lotus plants.

A thick, brown root with rough, hairy skin. It has a swollen, knobby shape and dark, earthy tones. The surface is wrinkled and covered in small, stiff bristles. It looks like a twisted, gnarled stick with a rough texture.
A thick, brown root with a rough, knobby surface. Deep grooves run along its length. Dark brown skin with light brown patches. Ends are pointed and slightly tapered. Has a strong, pungent odor.
A white, round root with brown skin, slightly tapered at the ends. Smooth, firm texture. Small, green leaves sprout from the top. Bright green stems connect the leaves to the root.

A thick, brown, knobby root with rough, wrinkled skin. Dark brown eyes peek from the top. Long, twisted arms and legs extend from the root. Fuzzy, green hair grows along the sides. A wide, flat face with a big, smiling mouth.

White, thick, and long, the wasabi root has a smooth, pale skin with a slight greenish tint. Its surface is firm and slightly wrinkled, with a pale yellow interior. The root is straight and sturdy, with a strong, pungent aroma.

A white, long, and thin root with a slightly curved shape. Smooth, pale skin with faint brown spots. Thick at the end, tapering to a point. Has a fibrous texture. Appears pale and soft, with a slightly wrinkled surface.

Celeriac has a large, knobby root with a rough, brown skin. It has a bulbous shape with deep grooves and bumps. The surface is dry and textured, with a pale yellowish color underneath the outer layer. It looks like a big, irregularly shaped vegetable with a rugged appearance.

subcategories.visual_description: A tall green plant with a thick, brown stem. Broad, waxy leaves grow around the stem. Small white flowers bloom at the top. The roots are visible below, long and thin, spreading out in the soil. The plant is bright green with soft brown roots.

categories.visual_description: A tall green stem with broad, waxy leaves. Bright yellow flowers bloom at the top, each with a purple center. Small green fruits hang below. The plant has a rounded, bushy shape. Bright colors and soft textures make it easy to see.

entities.visual_description: A red car with a rounded front, large wheels, and a long body. It has a windshield, headlights, and a roof. The sides have doors and windows. The back has a trunk and tail lights. It looks fast and shiny.
A yellow school bus with large windows, a white roof, and a long body. It has black wheels and a front entrance. The sides have blue stripes and the word "BUS" in big letters.

A large red truck with a flatbed, chrome wheels, and a cab. It has a big engine, a trailer hitch, and a logo on the side. The body is boxy, with windows and a driver's seat. It looks strong and ready for travel.

A motorcycle has a sleek frame with a front wheel and handlebars. It features a fuel tank, seat, and rear wheel. Bright colors and bold lines stand out. The engine is visible, with exhaust pipes and a glowing tail light.

A red bicycle with a white frame, two wheels, a handlebar, and a seat. It has a bell on the front, a chain, and pedals. The tires are black with white walls. The bike is small, with a basket on the front.
A long metal train with a red engine and blue roof, yellow stripes, and a glass cab. It has black wheels and a green cargo car behind. Smoke rises from the chimney, and the tracks run beside it.

A tram has a long, narrow body with large windows on both sides. It has a roof with a curved top and a front section with a driver's area. Bright colors and logos are painted on the sides. Metal wheels and a track are visible beneath.

A long metal train with glass windows and a dark blue body. It has a rounded front, silver stripes, and a driver's cabin at the front. Bright lights shine from the front and sides. Metal wheels and a roof with a yellow stripe.

A yellow taxi with a black roof, curved front windshield, and a taxi meter on the dashboard. It has four wheels, a front bumper, and a license plate. The back has a door and a small window. Bright red taillights and a white stripe down the side.

A red van with a boxy body, large windows, and a flat roof. It has a white stripe down the side, black wheels, and a windshield wiper moving slowly. The front has a rounded hood and a driver's seat visible.

names.ja: ピックアップトラック

entities.visual_description: A pickup truck has a large boxy bed, a high cab, and four wheels. It has a rugged front grille, big tires, and a metal bumper. The body is usually painted in bold colors like red or blue. It looks strong and ready for adventure.

A long, sleek black car with a low roof and shiny chrome details. It has a large windshield, tinted windows, and a smooth, shiny body. The front has a distinctive emblem and a chrome grille. Twin exhaust pipes and a tail lamp with a red light.

A bright yellow recreational vehicle with a rounded roof and large windows. It has a sliding door on the side, a ladder on the back, and a small awning. The front has a logo and a windshield with a wiper.
A small, four-wheeled vehicle with a flat bed. Bright yellow with black details. Has a steering wheel and a roof. Two seats facing forward. Large wheels with tire treads. Simple, rugged design.

A rugged all-terrain vehicle with a heavy-duty frame, four large tires, and a raised front bumper. It has a boxy body, a windshield, and a reinforced ladder. The vehicle is painted in dark green with yellow accents and has a winch on the front.

A snowmobile has a long, low body with a front snow blade. It has a high seat, a handlebar, and a powerful engine. Its frame is made of metal, and it has wide tires for snow. It looks fast and strong, built for winter travel.

A bright yellow go-kart with a rounded body and a long, low front. It has large wheels, a steering wheel, and a small seat. The front has a windshield and a horn. The sides are smooth with bold racing stripes.

zh.pinyin: sài gé wēi píng héng chē

entities.visual_description: A Segway is a two-wheeled vehicle with a raised platform, a handlebar, and a front wheel. It has a sleek, silver body with a black frame, and a display screen on the front. Its design is compact and futuristic, with a low center of gravity for balance.

A red tractor with a large metal body, wide wheels, and a front blade. It has a green roof, a white dashboard, and a driver's seat. Big tires and a sturdy frame make it look strong and ready for work.

A horse-drawn carriage with a red and gold body, wooden wheels, and a brass bell. It has a high roof, a canvas top, and a hitch for the horse. The wheels are large and spoked, with iron rims. The carriage has a front bench and a rear door.

zh.pinyin: lù dì jiāo tōng gōng jù

subcategories.visual_description: A red car with a long body and four round wheels. Big windows on the front and back. Two doors on each side. Bright headlights and taillights. A roof with a curved shape. A small windshield in front.

entities.visual_description: A large cargo ship has a long, narrow hull with a flat bottom. It has a high bow and a wide beam. The ship has a bridge at the front and a stack at the back. It is painted in dark blue with white markings.

A large container ship has a long, narrow hull with a flat deck. It features stacked metal containers, a bridge structure, and a propeller at the stern. The ship has a white hull with red and black markings, and a prominent bow shape.

A large cruise ship with a bright, colorful hull, tall masts, and a curved bow. It has a deck with railings, a funnel, and a flag flying from the mast. Windows and doors are visible on the sides, and there are small boats tied to the ship.
A blue submarine with a rounded front, long cylindrical body, and a conning tower. It has portholes, a periscope, and propellers. The hull is smooth and dark, with white markings and a tail fin.

A large gray metal ship with a flat deck, towering superstructure, and angled flight deck. It has multiple hangar bays, radar dishes, and missile launchers. Jets take off and land on its deck. Bright orange and yellow markings stand out against the gray hull.

A large, dark blue submarine with a pointed bow and rounded hull. It has glowing red lights along the sides and a massive propeller at the rear. Metal plating covers its body, and it has a reinforced cockpit at the front.

A frigate is a medium-sized warship with a long, narrow hull. It has a high bow, tall masts, and a single main sail. Its wooden deck is lined with cannons, and it has a figurehead at the bow. The ship has a dark hull with white trim and a red flag flying from the mast.

A large gray battleship with a rounded bow and a tall, narrow mast. It has thick armor plating, a rotating gun turret, and a deck with many crew members. The ship has a powerful propeller and a smokestack emitting steam.

A sleek white yacht with a blue hull, curved bow, and a tall mast. It has a red cabin roof and a white deck with a small wheelhouse. The sails are folded, and there are two small outboard engines at the back.

A small sailboat with a white hull and red sail, wooden deck, and a mast. It has a pointed bow and a rounded stern. The sail flaps gently in the wind, and there are ropes and a small flag on the mast.

A speedboat has a long, narrow hull with a pointed bow. It features a high windshield, bright red and white color scheme, and a powerful engine. Its sleek design and wake in the water show it's fast and built for speed.

A small tugboat with a pointed bow and a long, narrow hull. It has a powerful engine deck and a rope winch at the front. Bright red and white stripes run along its sides. Large wheels at the back help it move on land.
