A large, white icebreaker ship with a rounded bow, strong hull, and reinforced steel structure. It has a wide, flat deck, propellers, and a powerful engine. Its design shows strength and ability to break through ice.

A fishing vessel has a long, narrow hull with a pointed bow. It features a high deck with a wheelhouse, fishing nets hanging over the side, and a mast with a small sail. The boat has a bright red hull and white stripes, with a wooden cabin at the back.

A large white ship with blue stripes, a curved bow, and a tall mast. It has a wheelhouse with windows, a deck with walkways, and a radar dish on top. The hull is sleek, and there are small boats tied to the side.

A large white ship with red cross markings, blue hull, and medical tents on the deck. It has a curved roof, metal walkways, and a helicopter landing pad. Bright lights and medical equipment are visible on the sides.

A large, boxy water vehicle with a wide, flat bottom. It has a long, narrow hull and a powerful propeller at the back. Bright yellow with bold black stripes. Two large wheels at the front and a heavy-duty ladder on the side.

A bright yellow hovercraft with a rounded front and wide, flat bottom. It has large fans on the sides and a cockpit with a windshield. The body is smooth and shiny, with red stripes running along the sides.

A large oil tanker has a long, narrow hull with a dark blue paint job. It features a rounded bow, a tall bridge, and a series of vertical orange stripes. The ship has a massive cargo hold and a prominent funnel emitting white smoke.

zh.pinyin: huà xué pǐn yùn shū chuán

entities.visual_description: A large blue tanker with a rounded hull, green stripes, and a white roof. It has a long, narrow bow and a flat deck. Two big yellow tanks sit on either side. The vessel has a propeller and a bright orange safety sign.

zh.pinyin: shuǐ shàng jiāo tōng gōng jù

subcategories.visual_description: A bright blue boat with a rounded body and a tall sail. It has big windows, a door at the front, and a small wheel at the back. Two red lights blink on the sides. The boat is made of plastic and has a friendly smiley face on the front.

entities.visual_description: A bright blue airplane with white wings and a red tail. It has large windows, a pointed nose, and a propeller. The body is streamlined, with visible engines and control surfaces. Metal details shine in the sunlight.

A large passenger airplane with a pointed nose, wide wings, and a long fuselage. It has windows along the sides, a tail with a vertical stabilizer, and jet engines at the wing roots. Bright blue and white color scheme with red accents.

A large cargo airplane has a long fuselage with a wide body, heavy-duty landing gear, and a tail section. It features a rounded nose, large windows, and a reinforced underbelly. The wings are wide and sturdy, with visible cargo doors on the sides.

names.vi: Máy bay phản lực cá nhân
names.ja: ビジネスジェット (bijinesu jetto)

vi.syllable: Máy bay phản lực cá nhân

ja.syllable: ビジネスジェット (bijinesu jetto)

entities.visual_description: A private jet has a long, sleek fuselage with large windows. It has a pointed nose and twin tail fins. The wings are wide and have small engines at the tips. It features a jet bridge door and a distinctive, streamlined shape.

A fighter jet has a sleek, streamlined body with sharp angles. It features large wings, a pointed nose, and jet engines at the back. Bright red and white color scheme with black accents. Twin tail fins and a cockpit canopy. Metal surfaces reflect light.

A large, heavy aircraft with a rounded fuselage and pointed nose. It has thick wings, four engines, and a tail with a vertical stabilizer. The body is painted in dark green and gray, with white markings and a red underbelly.

A helicopter has a large round rotor on top, spinning blades, a cockpit in the front, and a body below. It has two or more rotors, a tail rotor, and a landing skid. The body is usually gray or white with some markings.

A small, colorful glider with a sleek wooden frame and fabric wings. It has a rounded nose, a tail with a small rudder, and control lines trailing from the back. Brightly painted with bold stripes and a smiling face on the front.

names.ja: ハンドグライダー (hando guridaa)

zh.pinyin: xuán guà shì huá xiáng jī

ja.syllable: ハンドグライダー (hando guridaa)

entities.visual_description: A hang glider has a triangular wing made of fabric stretched over a wooden frame. It has a cockpit with a seat and control bar. The wing tapers to a pointed tail. It has two small wings on the back. The whole thing looks like a flying triangle.

A paraglider has a large, triangular canopy with ripstop fabric, open at the front. It has suspension lines connecting to a harness, and a control bar with toggles. The frame is made of lightweight poles and webbing. It floats in the air with a streamlined shape.

fr.syllable: ballon à air chaud (bal-on, ah, air, shō)

entities.visual_description: A colorful hot air balloon with a round, fabric envelope in bright red and white. It has a basket below with handles and a burner on top. The balloon floats in the sky with clouds around.

A large, round blimp with a smooth, silver body. It has bright red and white stripes running vertically. Long, flexible tails extend from the back. Two small, round balloons float beneath it. Bright lights blink along the sides.

A large, rounded airship with a red and white striped body. It has a balloon-like shape with a pointed nose and a long tail. Big, round balloons lift it into the sky. Metal wings and a propeller spin slowly in the air.

A small flying drone with a round body, four spinning propellers, and a bright LED light on top. It has a sleek metallic frame and a camera lens on the front. The body is mostly black with blue accents.

A seaplane has a long, narrow body with large wings. It has a sturdy hull below the wings for water landing. The front has a sharp nose and a propeller. It sits on floats instead of wheels. Its tail has a small vertical fin. The wings are wide and strong. It looks like a plane with big, flat floats under it.

names.vi: Máy bay cánh quạt tự quay

entities.visual_description: A gyrocopter has a large, rotating main rotor above, a smaller tail rotor below, and a fuselage with a cockpit. It has fixed wings, a tail fin, and landing gear. Its body is streamlined with visible engine and propeller details.

ja.syllable: 超小型航空機 (chōkogata kōkūki) (cho-ko-ga-ta, ko-ku-ki)

entities.visual_description: A small, sleek aircraft with a long, narrow fuselage. It has large, swept-back wings and a pointed nose. The body is mostly white with bright orange accents. Two small engines are mounted on the wings. Simple, clean lines and minimal details.

A small, rusty airplane with a long, narrow body. It has a single propeller, a large fuel tank under the wing, and a cockpit with a windshield. The wings are wide and slightly curved. It has a tail with a vertical stabilizer and a horizontal stabilizer. The fuselage is painted in faded green and yellow.

A large, silver aircraft with a long, pointed nose and wide wings. It has a dark cockpit and multiple sensor pods under the wings. The body is smooth and streamlined, with radar dishes on the tail. It has a high, elongated fuselage and small, swept-back tail fins.

names.ja: 救急ヘリコプター (kyūkyū herikoputā)

ja.syllable: 救急ヘリコプター (kyūkyū herikoputā) (kyu-gyu, he-ri-ko-pu-ta)

entities.visual_description: A rescue helicopter has a large, round cockpit, rotors spinning above, and a ladder hanging from the side. It has a bright red body with white stripes, and a tail rotor at the back. The helicopter is made of metal and has glowing lights on the front.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright red airplane with a long pointed nose and wide wings. Big windows show the cockpit, and colorful doors open on the sides. Two large engines sit at the back. Bright lights shine from the front and tail.

entities.visual_description: A large yellow excavator with a long arm and bucket. Big wheels, a cabin on the back, and a heavy-duty front shovel. Metal body with bold colors. Strong, rugged look. Bright yellow with black details.

A large bulldozer with a heavy metal blade in front, thick tires, and a powerful engine. It has a rugged frame, a front cabin with windows, and a track system for movement. The body is dark metal with visible bolts and a front loader attachment.

names.ja: ホイールローダー (whīru rōdā)

ja.syllable: ウィール ローダー (uīru rōdā)

entities.visual_description: A large yellow wheel loader with a front loader bucket. It has a heavy-duty cab, large tires, and a powerful engine. The machine has a long arm and a bucket for lifting materials. Its body is rugged and built for construction work.

names.ja: バックホーローダー (bakku hō rōdā)

ja.syllable: バックホー ローダー (bakku hō rōdā)

entities.visual_description: A large yellow backhoe loader with a red cab. It has a long front bucket, a digging arm, and a heavy-duty frame. The machine has big tires and a powerful engine. It looks strong and built for heavy work.
A large yellow crane with a long metal arm and a bucket at the end. It has a heavy-duty body, tires, and a cab on top. The arm swings and lifts materials. Bright red and yellow colors stand out.

A tower crane has a tall metal tower with a horizontal jib extending outward. It features a rotating base, a hook hanging from a cable, and a counterweight on the opposite side. The structure is made of steel, with bright colors and bold lines.

A large yellow road roller with a curved steel drum, heavy-duty wheels, and a sturdy frame. It has a front engine, a raised cab, and a metal body with bold markings. The drum is smooth and wide, designed for compacting roads.

A large yellow motor grader has a long, curved blade at the front. It has a heavy-duty frame, steel wheels, and a cab on top. The machine has a powerful engine and is built for rough terrain. Its blade can push and shape earth smoothly.

names.ja: スキッドステアローダー (sukkiddo sutiā rōdā)

ja.syllable: スキッドステア ローダー (sukkiddo sutiā rōdā)

entities.visual_description: A skid-steer loader has a compact, boxy body with a raised operator cabin. It has large, heavy wheels and a front bucket. The machine has a powerful engine and tracks for stability. Its front has a digging arm and a scoop. It looks strong and built for heavy work.

A large dump truck with a high cab, heavy-duty tires, and a massive open bed. It has a front loader scoop, a yellow and green color scheme, and a rugged, durable frame. The truck is built for hauling and construction work.

names.ja: コンクリートミキサー車 (Konkurīto mikisā-sha)
names.ko: 콘크리트 믹서 트럭 (konkuri teu mikeseo teureok)

zh.pinyin: hùn níng tǔ jiǎo bàn chē

entities.visual_description: A concrete mixer truck has a long, boxy body with a rotating drum on top. The drum is cylindrical, with a metal mesh cover. It has large wheels and a cab at the front. The truck is bright yellow with bold black stripes.

names.ja: コンクリートポンプ車 (Konkurīto ponpu-sha)
names.ko: 콘크리트 펌프 트럭 (konkuri teu peompeu teureok)

entities.visual_description: A large concrete pump truck with a long, curved boom arm extending upward. It has a bright yellow body with bold black markings. The front has a heavy-duty cab and a hydraulic pump unit. Wheels are large and robust. The boom is raised, showing the pumping hose extending high into the air.

A large yellow forklift with a raised fork arm. It has a heavy-duty frame, a cab with a windshield, and large tires. The front has a logo, and the back has a trailer hitch. It looks strong and built for lifting heavy loads.

names.ja: アスファルトフィニッシャー (Asufaruto finisshā)

entities.visual_description: A large yellow machine with a long, flat front deck. It has heavy tires and a blade at the front. The body is boxy with a cab on top. It has a dump bed at the back. The machine is made of metal and has a rugged look.
A large yellow bulldozer with a heavy blade. Big wheels, a metal frame, and a front loader. Dark tires, a raised cab, and a powerful engine. Strong, rugged, and built for heavy work.

A large yellow pile driver with a heavy steel hammer on a long boom. The machine has a powerful engine, thick tires, and a metal frame. It stands on a flatbed truck, ready to drive. The hammer is raised, showing its strength and size.

A large yellow bulldozer with a heavy metal blade. It has a strong, boxy frame, large tires, and a front scoop. The machine has a red engine cover and a metal bucket at the front. It looks powerful and built for heavy work.

names.ja: コンパクトローラー (Konpakuto rōrā)

entities.visual_description: A large yellow bulldozer with a heavy metal blade. It has a strong, boxy frame, thick tires, and a front loader. The machine has a powerful engine and is built for heavy-duty work. It features a high cab and a massive blade for pushing earth.

A large drilling rig with a tall, cylindrical drill mast, heavy-duty metal frame, and rotating drill bit. It has a reinforced cab, thick tires, and a boom arm. Bright warning lights and blinking signals are visible. The structure is rugged and industrial, with exposed pipes and machinery.

A large mobile crane with a long boom, heavy-duty wheels, and a control cabin on top. It has a jib arm extending forward, a hook hanging from the end, and a thick metal base. Bright yellow with black details, showing construction vehicle features.

subcategories.visual_description: A big yellow bulldozer with a strong metal body. It has large wheels, a front blade, and heavy tires. Big windows and doors. Bright lights on the front and back. Strong and powerful looking.

entities.visual_description: A bright red ambulance with a white cross on the front. It has a long, boxy body with large wheels. The roof is flat, and there are lights and sirens on top. The back has a door and a ladder. It looks fast and ready to help.
A bright red fire engine with a long ladder on top. It has a shiny black roof and a large water tank. Big wheels and flashing lights. A yellow stripe runs down the side. Strong and powerful looking.

A bright red police car with a siren and flashing blue light. It has a white roof, black bumper, and a visible badge. The front has a bullbar and a windshield wiper. The back has a license plate and a rear light.

names.ja: パトロールバイク (Patorōru baiku)

entities.visual_description: A bright red police motorcycle with a sleek black frame. It has a large front light, a siren on the side, and a mounted radio. The rider wears a white helmet and a black jacket with reflective stripes. The bike has wide tires and a sturdy chrome exhaust.

A bright yellow SWAT vehicle with a reinforced metal body, large tires, and a roof rack. It has a sliding door, a ladder on the side, and a mounted turret. The front has a bold logo and blinking lights.

A bright red rescue truck with a large white cross on the front. It has a long flatbed with yellow warning lights, a ladder on the side, and a powerful engine. The truck is sturdy and built for emergencies.
A bright yellow tow truck with a long flatbed. It has a powerful engine, large wheels, and a hook on the front. The body is sturdy and has reflective stripes. It looks strong and ready to help.

A bright red fire ladder truck with a long metal ladder extending from the top. It has a large water tank on the back, black tires, and yellow warning lights. The front has a wide windshield and a powerful engine.

names.ja: 化学物質対応車 (Kasei bussitsu taiō-sha)

zh.pinyin: wēi xiǎn pǐn chǔ lǐ chē

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow hazmat vehicle with a sealed, white body and red stripes. It has a large, rounded tank on top and a rear door with a warning sign. Thick tires and a flat bed with a containment area are visible.
A yellow robot with a long arm and a box on its back. It has a flat body, big wheels, and a red light on top. The arm has a tool at the end. It looks like a robot used for handling bombs.

names.ja: 医療ヘリコプター (Irōka herikoputā)

zh.pinyin: yī liáo jiù yuán zhí shēng jī

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow medical helicopter with a red cross on the side. It has large rotors, a glass cockpit, and a stretcher on the back. The body is sleek with white stripes and a tail rotor. It looks fast and ready for emergency rescue.

names.ja: 救助ヘリコプター (Kyūjo herikoputā)

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow rescue helicopter with a large red cross on its side. It has rotors spinning slowly, a glass cockpit, and a ladder extending from the rear. The body is sleek with white panels and bold black markings.

names.ja: 海上自衛隊の船 (Kaishō jieitai no fune)

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow Coast Guard boat with a white hull and red stripes. It has a high bow, a wheelhouse with a red light, and a ladder on the side. The boat has a radar dish on top and a small flag flying from the mast.

A bright orange lifeboat with a rounded bow and a sturdy hull. It has a collapsible ladder on the side and a red and white striped canopy. Large yellow oars are attached, and the bow has a white cross for visibility.

A bright yellow rescue boat with red stripes, a curved bow, and a white hull. It has a high bow rider seat, a ladder on the side, and a small cabin at the back. The boat has a streamlined shape and a flag flying from the mast.

A bright yellow fire truck with a long ladder on top, red stripes, and a flashing red light. It has a large water tank, black tires, and a horn. The front has a logo and a windshield with a driver inside.

names.ja: 移動医療ユニット (Idō iryō yunitto)

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow mobile medical unit with a red cross on the side. It has a flatbed with a white tent, large wheels, and a roof rack. The front has a logo and a door with a window. It looks ready for emergency response.

names.ja: 捜索救助車両 (Sōsaku kyūjo sharyō)

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow search and rescue vehicle with a large red cross on the side. It has a flatbed with a ladder extending from the back. The front has a flashing light and a siren. It has large tires and a rugged frame.

A bright red fire truck with a long ladder and water tank. It has a powerful engine, flashing red lights, and a loud siren. Big wheels and a strong frame. A hose nozzle at the front. A tall ladder on the back.

names.ja: 装甲警察車両 (Sōkō keisatsu sharyō)

entities.visual_description: A large armored police vehicle with a bright red and blue body, a flat front, and a roof-mounted light bar. It has heavy tires, a reinforced bumper, and a ladder on the side. The front has a shield emblem and a siren.

subcategories.visual_description: A red fire truck with a long ladder on top. Big round wheels, bright red body, yellow stripes, and flashing lights. Large windows, wide doors, and a horn on the front.

entities.visual_description: A mountain bike has a sturdy frame with thick tires, a front suspension fork, and a handlebar with grip tape. It features a gear shifter, a bell, and a chain. The frame is usually made of steel or aluminum, with a low seat and wide wheels for off-road trails.

A road bike has a sleek frame, thin tires, and a straight handlebar. It features a single gear, a lightweight design, and a red color. The bike has a streamlined shape, a front fork, and a rear wheel with a chain. It looks fast and sporty.

A hybrid bike has a sleek frame with a mix of road and mountain bike features. It has wide tires for stability, a comfortable upright riding position, and a single gear setup. The frame is made of lightweight steel, with a bright color and reflective accents for visibility.

A BMX bike has a small frame with a front wheel and a rear wheel. It has a handlebar, a seat, and pedals. The frame is made of metal, and the wheels are small and round. It has a sturdy look with a single gear and a front fork. The color is usually bright and bold.

A folding bike has a compact frame with foldable legs, a handlebar with grips, and a front wheel. It features a seat, pedals, and a small storage basket. The frame is made of lightweight metal, and the wheels are small with spokes. It folds neatly into a compact size.

A bright yellow electric bike with a sleek frame, large front wheel, and a battery compartment on the back. It has a handlebar with a display screen, a single gear, and reflective strips along the frame. The tires are wide and black with white stripes.

A cargo bike has a large front basket, two sturdy wheels, a handlebar with a bell, and a frame made of steel. It has a low seat, a rear rack, and a streamlined design. Its color is bright yellow with black details. It looks strong and ready for delivery.

names.ja: リクライニング自転車

entities.visual_description: A recumbent bike has a low, curved seat, wide handlebars, and a streamlined frame. It features large wheels, a front wheel with a hub, and a rear wheel with a chain. The body is made of metal or composite materials, with a sleek, aerodynamic design.

Two people sit side by side on a single bike frame. The front rider holds the handlebars, while the back rider leans forward. The bike has two seats, a shared frame, and a single set of wheels. It has a streamlined design with a front basket and a rear storage compartment.

A cruiser bike has a sleek, sturdy frame with wide, cushioned seats. It features a straight handlebar, a bell, and a single gear. Its large, fat tires provide a smooth ride, and the bike has a classic, retro look with a comfortable, laid-back design.

A bright yellow city bike with a sleek frame, wide tires, and a sturdy front basket. It has a single gear, a bell, and a comfortable seat. The handlebars are straight, and the bike has a streamlined, modern look.

A touring bike has a sturdy frame with wide tires, a front basket, and a rear rack. It features a tall handlebar, a comfortable seat, and a chain-driven gear system. The bike has a streamlined design with a single front light and a rear reflector.

A track bike has a sleek, lightweight frame with a single gear and a fixed wheel. It has a streamlined design, a low seat, and a long handlebar. The frame is made of steel or aluminum, with a smooth, shiny finish. It has no brakes, just a freewheeling rear wheel.

zh.pinyin: yuè yě gōng lù zì xíng chē

entities.visual_description: A cyclocross bike has a sturdy frame with thick tires for off-road trails. It has a low seat, handlebars, and a front rack. The bike has a front and rear wheel with knobby tires. It has a lightweight design and a sporty look.

A fat bike has wide, stubby tires, thick and rounded wheels, a sturdy frame, and a low seat. It has a heavy-duty look with a front basket and handlebars. The tires are big and flat, making it look like a snowmobile on wheels.

A gravel bike has a sturdy frame with thick tires for rough terrain. It has a lightweight design, a straight handlebar, and a single-speed setup. The frame is made of steel or aluminum, with a low seat position and a durable build. It features wide, knobby tires and a simple, functional look.

A bright yellow bike with red wheels and a white seat. It has a handlebar with a small basket, a bell, and a chain. The frame is made of metal, and the tires are wide and black. It looks fun and ready for a ride.

A balance bike with a small frame, no pedals, and a front wheel. It has a handlebar, a seat, and two wheels. The frame is made of bright yellow metal. The seat is red and has a soft cushion. The wheels are black with white spokes.

A tricycle has three wheels, two front and one large back wheel. It has a small seat in the middle, handlebars on the front, and pedals under the seat. The frame is usually made of metal or plastic, with bright colors and maybe some stickers.

A bright yellow bike with a white frame and blue seat. It has a front basket, a bell, and a sturdy handlebar. The tires are black with white stripes. A red logo is on the side. It looks clean and ready for use.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright red bicycle with a rounded body and two big wheels. It has a handlebar with a bell, a seat, and two small lights. The front wheel has a yellow tire, and the back wheel is black. The frame is metal with a blue seat.

entities.visual_description: A sport bike has a sleek, low-slung frame with a powerful engine. It features a high seat, narrow handlebars, and a long, pointed front fork. Bright colors like red or blue stand out, with bold racing stripes and a shiny, aerodynamic design. Twin headlights and a fuel tank with a cool, angular shape make it instantly recognizable.

ja.ipa: /クルーザー/, /モーターサイクル/

entities.visual_description: A cruiser motorcycle has a long, low frame with a wide seat. It features a big front wheel, a tall handlebar, and a chrome exhaust pipe. The body is sleek with bold lines and a strong, muscular look. It has a classic design with a powerful engine and a sturdy, rugged appearance.

ja.ipa: /トゥーリン/, /モーターサイクル/

entities.visual_description: A touring motorcycle has a long, streamlined frame with a large fuel tank. It features a front fairing, handlebars, and a rear seat. The bike has two wheels, a chrome exhaust, and a windshield. Its design is sturdy and built for long rides.

ja.ipa: /スタンダード/, /モーターサイクル/

entities.visual_description: A standard motorcycle has a sleek steel frame, two wheels, a front fork, and a handlebar. It features a fuel tank, a seat, and a rear wheel. The engine is visible under the seat. It has a headlight, turn signals, and a tail light. The body is painted in a dark color with chrome accents.

A naked bike has a sleek, stripped-down frame with exposed engine parts. It features a single seat, handlebars, and wheels. The body is metal, with a shiny, polished look. It has no body panels, showing the raw mechanics. Bright colors and bold lines make it stand out.

names.vi: Mô tô địa hình đường trường
names.ja: アドベンチャーバイク

ja.ipa: /アドベンチャー/, /モーターサイクル/

entities.visual_description: A bold adventure motorcycle with a rugged frame, wide tires, and a high seat. It has a chrome exhaust, handlebars with grips, and a front fork with a protective guard. Bright red paint with black accents and a large fuel tank stand out.

names.ja: デュアルスポーツバイク

zh.pinyin: shuāng yòng tú mó tuō chē

entities.visual_description: A dual sport motorcycle has a rugged frame, large wheels, and a bold front fork. It features a high seat, handlebars, and a sturdy engine. The body is often off-road ready with protective plates and a durable paint job.

A dirt bike has a rugged frame, large wheels, and a high seat. It features handlebars, a front fork, and a rear suspension. The body is made of metal, with a fuel tank and exhaust pipe. It has a bold, off-road design with a dirt-friendly look.

zh.pinyin: mó tuō yuè yě sài chē

entities.visual_description: A motocross bike has a rugged frame, large wheels, and a low seat. It features handlebars, footpegs, and a fuel tank. The body is made of metal with a dirt-friendly design. It has a front fork and rear suspension for off-road riding. Bright colors and bold graphics stand out.

zh.pinyin: nài lì yuè yě mó tuō chē

ja.ipa: /エンデューロ/, /モーターサイクル/

entities.visual_description: A sleek Enduro motorcycle with a matte black frame, chrome exhaust, and knobby tires. It has a tall handlebar, a reinforced seat, and a rugged front fork. The body is compact, with a powerful engine visible through the fuel tank. Bright yellow accents highlight the bold, adventurous design.

A sleek, sporty motorcycle with a low seat and wide handlebars. Bright red body with black accents. Large wheels and a bold front fork. Twin exhaust pipes and a high-performance engine visible. Streamlined design with a racing look.

A Cafe Racer motorcycle has a sleek, stripped-down frame with a high seat and small fuel tank. It features chrome exhaust, fenders, and a single headlight. The handlebars are straight, and the wheels are small with spoked design. The body is painted in a bold, retro color.

zh.pinyin: gǎi zhuāng xún háng mó tuō

entities.visual_description: A large, rugged motorcycle with a wide, muscular frame. It has a front wheel, a rear wheel, and a long, low seat. The body is painted in bright colors with bold stripes. It has a big engine and strong tires. The handlebars are wide and sturdy.

A sleek, red motorcycle with a long, curved fairing. It has a single front wheel, a high handlebar, and a streamlined body. The engine is visible, with a chrome exhaust pipe. Bright yellow accents and a bold, angular design make it stand out.

A sleek electric motorcycle with a bright blue body, glowing LED headlights, and a streamlined frame. It has a large battery compartment on the side, chrome wheels, and a digital dashboard. The front has a sharp, angular design with a high seat and a sporty look.

A police motorcycle has a sleek black frame with red and blue lights. It has a large front wheel, a handlebar with a siren, and a rear wheel with a tire. The body is shiny and has reflective stickers. It has a sidecar and a mounted siren. The front has a bullhorn speaker.

A bright yellow delivery motorcycle with a large cargo basket. It has a sleek frame, two wheels, and a handlebar with a bell. The front has a small light and a logo. The back has a storage compartment and a tire.

A sleek racing motorcycle with a black frame, red racing stripes, and a polished chrome engine. It has a low seat, wide handlebars, and a rear wheel with a glowing tire. The front has a sharp headlight and a small windshield.

A three-wheel motorcycle has a compact frame with two front wheels and one large rear wheel. It features a small engine, handlebars, and a seat. Bright colors and bold lines make it stand out. The design is simple, with a streamlined body and visible mechanical parts.

zh.pinyin: biān sān lún mó tuō chē

entities.visual_description: A sidecar motorcycle has a small attached cabin on the right side. It has a front wheel and a larger back wheel. The sidecar has a door and a windshield. The whole vehicle looks like a motorcycle with a tiny house attached.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright red motorcycle with a long, curved body. Two big wheels at the back. A small front wheel. No doors. Big headlights and taillights. A handlebar in front. A seat for riding. A fuel tank on the side.

entities.visual_description: A steam train has a long metal body with a red engine, black wheels, and a smokestack that releases white steam. It has a driver's cab at the front, yellow stripes, and a coal car behind. The wheels spin, and the train moves slowly on tracks.

A diesel train has a long, dark green body with a red stripe down the sides. It has a rounded front with a glass window, a metal roof, and a smokestack. Big wheels and a driver's cab at the front make it instantly recognizable.

A bright yellow electric train with a rounded front, silver stripes, and a long, sleek body. It has large windows, a curved roof, and a small cab at the front. Black wheels and a red stripe run along its sides.

A sleek high-speed train with a long, streamlined body. Bright silver and blue colors. Large windows along the sides. A curved nose and a high roof. Red and white stripes on the sides. Twin tail lights at the end.

A sleek bullet train with a long, narrow body, shiny silver surface, and a pointed front. It has large windows, a high roof, and a streamlined shape. Bright red and white stripes run along its sides. Twin smokestacks rise from the back.

A sleek, silver maglev train glides on a track. It has a smooth, curved body with bright LED lights. Long glass windows show the landscape. The front has a pointed nose and a high-tech dashboard. Metal panels and glowing signs add to its futuristic look.

A long freight train with multiple boxcars, each with red stripes and white panels. Big wheels, metal tracks, and a steam engine with a tall smokestack. Brightly colored, with visible rivets and bold lines.

A long passenger train with a red and white striped engine, blue and yellow boxcars, and a green dome. It has a metal roof, windows, and a smokestack. The wheels are black with yellow rims. The train is moving on a track with a bridge in the distance.

A commuter train has a long, sleek body with a dark blue paint job. It has a curved front with a glass window, silver stripes along the sides, and a metal roof. The front has a driver's cab with a windshield and a small antenna. The sides have numbered carriages and a logo.

A long, sleek train with a bright blue and white color scheme. It has a rounded front with a glass window, silver roof, and multiple carriages connected by black couplings. Each carriage has a door and a window with a green stripe.

A long, dark blue train with silver stripes runs through a starry night. Bright red lights glow along the sides. Windows are dark, with faint silhouettes inside. The engine has a glowing yellow headlight and a curved metal shape.

A luxury train has a long, sleek body with a dark blue paint job. It features gold accents, large windows, and a dome-shaped roof. The front has a brass nose and a polished wooden sign. It has a tall smokestack and decorative lights along the sides.
A colorful tourist train with a bright red and yellow body, large windows, a shiny brass dome, and a fun logo. It has a long, curved roof and a friendly face painted on the front.

A rack railway train has a sturdy metal frame with a narrow wheelbase. It features a rack rail along the top, with teeth engaging the rack. The front has a small engine with a pointed nose, and the sides show rivets and metal panels. It has a low profile and a simple, functional design.

A bright yellow monorail train with a rounded front and smooth curves. It has a single track above, two long windows, and a small driver's cabin. The body is sleek and shiny, with a blue stripe running down the side.

zh.pinyin: guǐ dào jiǎn cè liè chē

entities.visual_description: A long, shiny silver train with bright red stripes. It has a rounded front with a large glass window. Big wheels and a metal roof. Yellow lights on the sides. A small platform at the front. Bright colors and clean lines.

zh.pinyin: guǐ dào wéi xiū liè chē

entities.visual_description: A long, green train with a red stripe down its side. It has a flat, boxy car with a door on top. The front has a small engine with a yellow light. Wheels are black with white rims. The whole train looks sturdy and simple.

A colorful rescue train with a red and yellow body, blue roof, and white stripes. It has a long flatbed with a ladder and a bright light on top. Big wheels and a horn are visible. The front has a friendly face with big eyes and a smiling mouth.
A long metal railcar with a rounded front, large windows, and a flat roof. It has a steel frame, metal wheels, and a single door. The sides are painted in bright colors with bold stripes.
A large red locomotive with a long metal body, black wheels, and a smokestack. It has a rounded front, a driver's cab, and a funnel shape. The sides have yellow stripes and a number plate.

subcategories.visual_description: A long train with a rounded front, bright yellow body, and blue stripes. It has big windows, silver wheels, and red doors. Two small lights shine on the top. The train has a fun shape with a smiling face on the front.

entities.visual_description: A rocket stands tall with a sleek, metallic body. It has a pointed nose cone, clustered engines at the base, and a long, cylindrical fuel tank. Bright orange flames burst from the bottom, and there are small control panels along the sides.

A bright silver rocket with a rounded nose cone and long cylindrical body. It has four small boosters at the base and a tail fin. Red and white stripes run along its sides. Twin engines protrude from the back.

A sleek silver suborbital rocket with a pointed nose cone, long cylindrical body, and four clustered engines. It has a white underbelly with dark blue stripes and a tail fin. Streamlined and powerful, it looks ready for space travel.

zh.pinyin: kě chóng fù shǐ yòng huǒ jiàn

entities.visual_description: A sleek, silver reusable rocket with a pointed nose cone and a cylindrical body. It has four sturdy landing legs and a bright orange nozzle. Streamlined design with white markings and a glowing engine flame at the base.

zh.pinyin: gù tǐ rán liào huǒ jiàn

entities.visual_description: A solid fuel rocket stands tall with a cylindrical body, dark metallic skin, and a pointed nose cone. It has four sturdy legs and a tail with small fins. Bright orange flames burst from its base, and a large fuel tank sits at its bottom.

zh.pinyin: yè tǐ rán liào huǒ jiàn

entities.visual_description: A bright orange liquid fuel rocket with a pointed nose cone, tall cylindrical body, and four clustered engines at the base. It has a metallic silver tail and a large fuel tank below, with glowing exhaust flames trailing behind.

names.ja: ハイブリッドロケット

zh.pinyin: hùn hé rán liào huǒ jiàn

ja.ipa: /ハイブリッド ロケット/

entities.visual_description: A hybrid rocket has a sleek, metallic body with glowing blue engines at the base. It features a pointed nose cone and streamlined wings. Bright red stripes run along its sides, and it has a glowing tail flame.

A slender, white rocket with bright orange fins and a pointed nose cone. Streamlined body with metallic silver panels. Twin tail stabilizers and a small payload bay door. Glowing engine nozzles at the base.

zh.pinyin: zhòng xíng yùn zài huǒ jiàn

entities.visual_description: A large rocket with a rounded nose cone, silver metallic body, and four clustered engines. It has a tall, slender shape with a tail section and a payload bay door open to show cargo. Bright orange nozzles and white markings add contrast.

zh.pinyin: qīng xíng yùn zài huǒ jiàn

entities.visual_description: A small-lift rocket has a sleek, silver body with red stripes. It has a pointed nose cone, four small engines at the base, and a tail with fins. The rocket is compact, with a bright orange payload compartment on top.

A multi-stage rocket has a tall, slender body with several sections stacked vertically. Each stage is covered in metallic skin with dark markings. It has a pointed nose cone and four tail fins. Smoke trails behind as it launches into the sky.

A single-stage rocket stands tall with a smooth metallic body, cone-shaped nose, and four clustered engines at the base. It has a streamlined design, with a bright orange fuel tank and white markings. Twin stabilizers extend from the sides, and a tail fin adds balance.

zh.pinyin: tài kōng fā shè xì tǒng

entities.visual_description: A tall rocket with a white body and orange stripes, featuring a pointed nose cone and four clustered engines at the base. It has a large fuel tank beneath the first stage and a slender upper stage with a payload fairing on top.

A large rocket booster with a shiny silver body, red and white stripes, and a pointed nose cone. It has four sturdy legs, exhaust nozzles at the base, and a glowing tail flame. The surface has bold markings and a rugged texture.

A bright red rocket with a pointed nose cone, silver metallic body, and glowing blue exhaust flames. It has large circular windows and bold, white markings. Twin tail fins and a curved wing at the base make it instantly recognizable as a futuristic experimental rocket.

A bright silver rocket with red and blue stripes, long narrow body, and a pointed nose cone. It has glowing engines at the base and a tail with swirling smoke. Streamers trail behind as it zooms through the sky.

A large rocket stage with a shiny silver body, long cylindrical shape, and a pointed nose cone. It has clustered engines at the base and a fuel tank section. Bold red stripes run along the sides, and exhaust nozzles protrude from the bottom.

names.ja: ロケットフェアリング

entities.visual_description: A sleek, white rocket fairing with a glossy finish. It has a pointed nose cone and a cylindrical body. Orange stripes run along the sides. Small windows are near the top. It looks like a futuristic spacecraft ready for launch.

A rocket engine has a long, narrow body with a pointed nose. It features a large circular exhaust nozzle at the bottom. Bold, vertical lines run along its sides. Bright orange flames shoot out from the nozzle. Metal panels reflect light.

A large rocket launch pad with a metallic silver body, orange flame exhaust, and a circular launch ring. It has a tall, narrow structure with a pointed nose cone and four stabilizing fins. The base has a circular platform and a vertical tower with a flame deflector.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright red rocket with a long, pointed nose and shiny silver sides. It has big windows on the front and small round windows on the sides. Two doors open on the bottom. Big glowing lights on the top and bottom.

vi.syllable: スペース シャトル

ja.syllable: スペース シャトル

entities.visual_description: A bright white space shuttle with orange boosters and a tall, slender nose cone. It has a pointed tail and large wings. The body is sleek with panels and a visible fuel tank. Blue markings and a logo are on the side.

A sleek silver space capsule with a rounded nose and a blunt cone shape. It has a white stripe running along its side and small windows near the top. Two small thrusters are visible at the base, and a hatch is open at the front.

names.vi: Tàu vũ trụ có người lái

vi.syllable: Tàu vũ trụ có người lái

entities.visual_description: A sleek, silver spacecraft with a rounded nose and long, narrow body. It has large, glowing windows and two curved wings. Bright blue lights blink around the cockpit. Metal panels shine under the light.

A large silver spacecraft with a rounded front and long cylindrical body. It has a flat bottom and two small wings. Bright blue lights line the sides. A hatch opens on the front. Metal panels reflect light.

A large silver space station with rounded modules connected by narrow tubes. It has solar panels extending like wings and a central hub with docking ports. Windows show stars and Earth. Bright lights glow along its structure.

A sleek silver space probe with a pointed nose and a long, cylindrical body. It has solar panels along the sides and a rounded tail with antenna dishes. Bright white markings and glowing blue lights highlight its futuristic design.

A small, round spaceship with a white and silver body. It has a large dome at the front, two small engines on the bottom, and a ladder extending from the side. The surface is smooth with metallic textures and glowing blue lights around the edges.

A small, round spaceship with a metallic silver body and a cone-shaped top. It has three short legs for landing, glowing blue lights around the base, and a hatch at the front. The surface has rust-colored markings and a circular window.

A glowing orb with sleek, metallic curves, surrounded by swirling light trails. Transparent panels reveal glowing engines and control panels. Streamlined body with glowing blue accents and a rotating central hub.

A large, metallic space tug with a rounded front and long, slender body. It has glowing blue lights along the sides and a docking port at the rear. Twin thrusters on the sides emit a steady white glow. Its surface is covered in reflective panels and has a streamlined, futuristic look.

names.vi: Tàu thăm dò không gian sâu
names.es: Sonda de exploración del espacio profundo

es.syllable: Sonda de exploración del espacio profundo

entities.visual_description: A sleek, silver spaceship with a long, pointed nose and a rounded tail. It has glowing blue lights along its sides and a large dish antenna on top. Streamlined body with metallic panels and a glowing engine at the rear.

A sleek, silver spaceplane with glowing blue engines and a pointed nose. It has a transparent cockpit and solar panels along its wings. Streamlined body with glowing trails and a tail fin shaped like a rocket nozzle.

A silver, oval-shaped satellite with bright white solar panels stretching from its sides. It has a rounded body with small windows and antenna dishes. Streamlined and sleek, it glows softly with blue lights.

A sleek, silver satellite with a rounded body and solar panels stretching out like wings. It has a central hub with antenna dishes and glowing lights. Streamlined design with a metallic sheen and bright, reflective surfaces.

A silver, dome-shaped satellite with solar panels stretching out like wings. It has a rounded body with antenna rods sticking up. Bright blue lights blink around its base. It floats in space with trails of light behind it.

A silver, disk-shaped satellite with bright blue lights around the edge. It has a smooth, metallic surface with small antenna-like protrusions. The top has a glowing circular panel and a rotating dish antenna.

A bright silver space rover with a rounded body and a long, curved antenna. It has large, round wheels and a hatch on top. The front has glowing lights and a small camera. Its surface has metallic textures and some scratches.
A small, silver robotic vehicle with rounded edges and a flat, boxy body. It has six wide wheels, a solar panel on top, and a long antenna. Bright red lights blink along its sides.

A Mars Rover has a rugged, metallic body with solar panels on top. It has a long, segmented robotic arm and six wheel-like legs. Its front has a camera and a scoop for digging. It looks like a small, durable machine built for rough terrain.

A sleek, silver spaceship with glowing blue windows and a rounded cockpit. It has a long, narrow body with metallic panels and a rotating antenna. Bright red stripes run along its sides, and small thrusters are visible at the base.

subcategories.visual_description: A shiny silver spaceship with a rounded body and glowing blue windows. It has big round doors and bright red lights on the top. Two small wings stick out from the sides. The front has a glowing logo and a round cockpit.

entities.visual_description: A small motor scooter has a curved front with a handlebar, a low seat, and two wheels. It has a streamlined body, a front wheel with a hubcap, and a rear wheel. The frame is metal, with a storage compartment at the base. It has a small engine and a horn.

A small electric scooter with a sleek black frame, bright blue wheels, and a red handlebar. It has a front basket, a glowing display screen, and a compact design. The body is smooth with a modern look and a low seat.

A kick scooter has a small frame with a front wheel and a larger rear wheel. It has a deck for standing, a handlebar, and a kick pad for propulsion. The body is usually made of plastic with bright colors and a streamlined design.

names.ja: 折りたたみスクーター

entities.visual_description: A folding scooter has a lightweight frame with a front wheel and a small rear wheel. It features a handlebar with a grip, a step platform, and a collapsible design with hinges on the frame. The body is usually made of metal or plastic, with a compact shape for easy storage.

A three-wheel scooter has a small frame with two front wheels and one large rear wheel. It has a handlebar, a seat, and a storage basket. The body is colorful with bright stickers and a streamlined design. It looks fun and easy to ride.

names.vi: Xe scooter hỗ trợ di chuyển
names.ja: モビリティスクーター

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow mobility scooter with a rounded front and a large front wheel. It has a low seat, a steering wheel, and a control panel with buttons. The body is smooth and has a comfortable design for easy movement.

A bright yellow scooter with a red handlebar, a small front wheel, and a large back wheel. It has a low seat, a footrest, and a storage basket in front. The frame is made of metal with a smooth, rounded design.

names.ja: オフロードスクーター

entities.visual_description: A rugged off-road scooter with a bold, matte-black frame. It has large knobby tires, a reinforced front fork, and a high handlebar. The body is compact, with a small seat and a storage compartment at the back. Bright orange accents highlight the wheels and front panel.

names.ja: シェアードスクーター

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow scooter with a long, curved deck. It has a single front wheel and a small rear wheel. The handlebars are straight, and the frame is made of metal. It has a storage basket in front and a seat at the back. The design is simple and modern.

A small, lightweight gas scooter with a sleek frame, two wheels, and a low seat. It has a handlebar with a grip, a fuel tank, and a front wheel with a hubcap. Bright colors and a sporty design make it stand out.

names.ja: パフォーマンススクーター

zh.pinyin: gāo xìng néng huá bǎn chē

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow performance scooter with a sleek, aerodynamic frame. It has a single front wheel, a small rear wheel, and a high handlebar. The body is made of shiny metal, with bold racing stripes and a red engine cover.

names.ja: フリースタイルスクーター

entities.visual_description: A freestyle scooter has a sleek, lightweight frame with a low seat. It features a deck with a kicktail for tricks, wide handlebars, and small wheels. The body is usually bright and colorful, with a smooth, durable surface.
A small, lightweight scooter with a step-thru frame. Brightly colored, with a front wheel and a large rear wheel. Has a handlebar with a bell. Streamlined design, smooth surface, and a low seat.

names.ja: ツーリングスクーター

entities.visual_description: A small, lightweight scooter with a long, narrow frame. It has a single front wheel and a large rear wheel. The handlebars are straight, and the body is made of bright, colorful plastic. It has a low seat and a streamlined design.

A bright yellow Maxi Scooter with a long, curved deck, wide handlebars, and a sturdy frame. It has a front wheel and a large rear wheel, with a low seat and a storage basket in front. The design is simple and fun, with bold colors and a smooth, rounded shape.

A small red scooter with a white seat and black wheels. It has a handlebar with a bell, a front wheel, and a storage basket. The frame is made of metal, and the tires are black with white walls. It looks fun and ready to ride.

zh.pinyin: zhàn lì shì huá bǎn chē

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow standing scooter with a sleek, lightweight frame. It has a single front wheel, a handlebar with a grip, and a small platform for standing. The body is smooth with a rounded design and a front basket.

names.ja: レーシングスクーター

entities.visual_description: A bright red racing scooter with a sleek, aerodynamic frame. It has a long, narrow body, a low seat, and a single front wheel. The handlebars are curved, and the scooter has a powerful engine with exhaust pipes. It features a streamlined design and glowing lights.

A cargo scooter has a sturdy frame with a large front basket. It has two wheels, a handlebar, and a seat. The body is made of metal with a bright color. It looks like a small bike but with a big storage area in front.

A bright white snow scooter with red racing stripes, a low seat, and wide wheels for snow. It has a small front handlebar, a streamlined body, and a snow shovel attached to the front. The frame is made of metal, and the wheels are large and round.

subcategories.visual_description: A small red scooter with a curved body and two big wheels. It has a front light, a handlebar with a bell, and a seat. The back has a small storage basket. Bright colors and simple shapes make it easy to recognize.

names.ja: ピックアップトラック

entities.visual_description: A large pickup truck with a boxy bed, steel frame, and four-wheel drive. It has a rugged front bumper, chrome wheels, and a high roof. The cab is painted red with black stripes, and the bed is loaded with tools and gear.

A box truck has a long, rectangular body with a high roof. It has large, flat sides and a rear door. It features a cab at the front with windows and a windshield. The truck has heavy tires and a metal frame. It looks strong and sturdy.

names.ja: フラットベッドトラック

ja.syllable: フラットベッﾄ トラック

entities.visual_description: A flatbed truck has a long, boxy body with a raised rear section. It features a flat, open bed in the back. Large wheels and a sturdy frame make it look strong. The front has a windshield and headlights. It has a driver's cab at the front. The sides are straight and boxy. The truck has a heavy, solid look.
A large semi truck with a long flatbed, steel frame, and heavy tires. Bright yellow with black stripes, a cab with windows, and a trailer with a hitch. Big wheels and a rugged look.

A tanker truck has a long, boxy body with a rounded rear. It has a flat front with a driver's window. Large wheels are at the back. The sides are smooth and curved. It has a metal tank on top. The truck is bright yellow with red stripes.

A refrigerated truck has a long, boxy body with a metal roof. It has large, tinted windows and a sliding door on the side. The front has a logo and headlights. The back has a loading door and a ventilation vent. It is painted white with blue stripes.

A large gray truck with a flatbed, steel frame, and heavy-duty wheels. It has a boxy shape, a raised cab, and a trailer hitch. The sides are covered in rust and dirt, with faded logos and metal panels. Bright red warning lights blink on top.

A large truck with a flat, open bed, steel frame, and heavy-duty tires. It has a raised cab, a reinforced bumper, and a trailer hitch. The body is dark gray with bold black markings. Steel cargo rails run along the bed.

A large logging truck with a long, heavy trailer. It has a rugged front bumper, big tires, and a high cab. The body is dark green with yellow stripes. It has a crane arm and a winch on the back. The truck is covered in dirt and mud.

A large red garbage truck with a long, boxy body and a raised rear door. It has yellow stripes, a flatbed area, and a bright logo. Wheels are big and round. The front has a windshield and headlights. The truck is clean and shiny.

A large red tow truck with a flatbed in the back. It has a strong front bumper, a long metal frame, and a crane arm. The truck has big tires, a windshield, and a logo on the side. It looks powerful and ready to help.

A large delivery truck with a boxy body, red and white color scheme, and a flatbed in the back. It has big wheels, a cab with windows, and a logo on the side. The front has a windshield and headlights.

A large white truck with a long box bed, red wheels, and a metal cab. It has a flatbed with a trailer hitch, a windshield, and two front headlights. The sides have logos and a number. The back has a tailgate and a license plate.

A large red stake truck with a long flatbed, steel frame, and heavy-duty wheels. It has a raised cab, a trailer hitch, and a cargo bed loaded with wooden stakes. The truck is rugged, with a bold front grille and bright yellow markings.

names.ja: 横断幕トラック (Yokudan maku torakku)

entities.visual_description: A large curtain-side truck with a long, flat bed. The sides are high and have a metal curtain that can be rolled up. The front has a cab with a windshield and headlights. The back has a tailgate and a logo on the side. The tires are big and black.

names.ja: コンクリートミキサー車 (Konkuriito mikisā-sha)

entities.visual_description: A large cement truck with a long, flat bed loaded with concrete. It has a sturdy metal frame, heavy tires, and a bright yellow body. The front has a logo and a windshield with a driver inside. The back has a dump door open, showing wet cement.

A large red fuel truck with a flatbed and a long metal tank on top. It has a white stripe down the side and a yellow warning sign. The front has a logo and blinking lights. Big wheels and a heavy-duty frame.

A large gray truck with a flat bed, steel wheels, and a boxy shape. It has a red stripe down the side, a windshield, and a cab with windows. The front has a logo and headlights. The back has a trailer hitch and a flat, open bed.

A large heavy-duty truck with a long, boxy cab, steel wheels, and a trailer. It has a rugged front bumper, a high roof, and a heavy-duty trailer hitch. The body is dark gray with bold black lines and a large logo on the side.

A light-duty truck has a boxy body with a high roof, large wheels, and a flatbed. It has a front grille, headlights, and a cab with windows. The sides have metal panels and a ladder for climbing. It looks strong and ready for work.

subcategories.visual_description: A big red truck with a long flat bed. It has four big wheels, two front doors, and two back doors. Large windows on the sides. Bright headlights and taillights. A strong metal body with a logo on the side.

entities.visual_description: A small rowboat has a narrow, flat bottom and a pointed bow. It has a wooden hull with a dark brown color and a light-colored seat. Two oars stick out from the sides, and a rope is tied to the bow. The boat is simple and sturdy.
A small canoe with a narrow, curved hull. It has a flat bottom and two pointed ends. The sides are low and smooth. It is made of dark wood with light-colored seams. A paddle is attached to the side.

A kayak has a long, narrow body with a pointed front and a flat back. It has two low, curved sides and a single paddle holder. The deck is covered with a waterproof skin, and the cockpit is where the person sits. It has a low profile and is designed for water.

A small boat with a flat bottom and high sides. It has a bow at the front and a stern at the back. The hull is made of wood or plastic. It has a sail on top and oars on each side. It is lightweight and easy to move on water.

names.ja: インフレータブルボート (Infurētaburu bōto)

entities.visual_description: A bright yellow inflatable boat with a rounded bow and flat bottom. It has a red handle on the front, black valve at the back, and a blue seat inside. The sides are textured with small bumps for grip.

A motorboat has a long, narrow body with a pointed bow. It has a flat deck, a high windshield, and a propeller at the back. Bright red and white stripes run along its sides. Large wheels at the stern help it move through water.

A sleek speedboat with a bright red hull, white stripe, and blue roof. It has a long, narrow body, a high bow, and a powerful engine. Twin propellers spin rapidly. The deck is smooth with a clear windshield and a small steering wheel.

names.ja: セーリングボート (Sēringu bōto)

entities.visual_description: A colorful sailboat with a tall white sail, wooden hull, and red mast. It has a small cabin at the back, a rope ladder, and a tiny flag flying from the mast. The boat is in the water with waves around it.

A small fishing boat with a pointed bow, wooden hull, and bright red paint. It has a white roof, a single sail, and a rope ladder hanging from the side. The deck is cluttered with fishing nets and buckets.

names.ja: ポンツーンボート (Pon.tsūn bōto)

entities.visual_description: A long, flat boat with wide sides and a smooth bottom. It has a straight hull and no mast. Two small engines sit at the back. The boat floats on calm water with no waves. Bright red and white stripes run along its length.
A colorful pedal boat with a flat bottom and two large plastic paddles. Bright blue and yellow hull, red handlebars, and a small seat. Streamers flutter in the breeze. Simple, fun design for kids.

ja.syllable: ド・ラゴン ボート

entities.visual_description: A long, narrow boat with a dragon head at the front. Bright red and gold colors. Wooden body with carved details. Tall sail on the back. Dragon scales along the sides. Big, curved tail at the end.

A longboat has a long, narrow body with a pointed bow. It has a flat bottom and high sides. It is made of wood with dark stains. It has oars on each side and a small sail at the back. The hull is smooth and dark.

A small boat with a rounded bow and a high, narrow stern. It has a wooden deck, a rope ladder hanging from the side, and a red and white striped life jacket hanging from the bow. The hull is painted bright orange with a white stripe down the center.

A colorful houseboat with a curved roof and large windows. It has a wooden deck, a sail, and a ladder leading to a small bridge. Brightly painted, with a red hull and blue roof. A tiny door and a flag flying from the mast.
A small, flat-bottomed boat with a red and white striped hull. It has a wide, open deck and a single sail made of bright blue fabric. The bow has a rounded shape and a small flag flying from a pole.

A whaleboat is a small, narrow boat with a pointed bow and a flat bottom. It has a low, wide stern and is typically made of wood. It features a single mast and sail, with a rope ladder hanging from the side. The boat has a simple, sturdy design with a curved hull.
A long, narrow boat with a pointed bow and a flat bottom. It has a red and white striped hull, a wooden deck, and a tall white mast with a small sail. Two oars stick out from the sides.
A large tour boat with a bright red hull, white stripe, and blue roof. It has a wide deck, open seating areas, and a small bridge at the front. The boat has a propeller and a clear windshield.

A small white boat with red stripes, flat bottom, and a high bow. It has a wooden hull, a rope ladder, and a bright orange life jacket hanging from the side. The boat is sleek and sturdy, with a clear windshield and a simple steering wheel.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright blue boat with a long, curved body. It has a big open window at the front and small windows along the sides. Two tall white sails stick up from the back. Big red wheels are at the bottom. A yellow steering wheel is in the front.

entities.visual_description: A large metal ferry with a flat deck, wide bow, and rounded stern. It has a red and white striped hull, a bridge with a glass roof, and orange safety ropes along the sides. Twin propellers extend from the rear.

A person with arms raised, face tilted up, eyes closed, mouth open in a wide smile, hair slightly winded, and a glowing aura around the head, showing joy and expression of singing.

A person in mid-twirl, arms outstretched, feet spinning in a circle, face upturned with a joyful smile, hair flowing like a ribbon, body light and graceful, clothes swaying with motion, eyes closed in delight.

A person with hands raised, fingers spread wide, eyes wide open and smiling, head tilted slightly back, mouth open in a joyful expression, wearing a bright colorful shirt, standing in front of a crowd, arms outstretched.

A person leans forward, eyes wide and focused, hands slightly raised as if receiving sound. Their face shows concentration, mouth slightly open, eyebrows raised. Hair is slightly messy from leaning in, and their posture is alert and engaged.

A person leans forward, eyes wide and focused, hands slightly raised as if reaching out. Their face shows intense concentration, mouth slightly open, eyebrows raised. Clothing is casual, with a bright-colored shirt standing out against the background.

A child laughs, arms wide, face bright with joy, eyes closed, cheeks round and red, hair messy and wild, mouth open, teeth visible, body tilted back, feet off the ground, hands up, playful and full of energy.

A person with hands clasped, smiling warmly, eyes crinkled with kindness. Bright, expressive eyes. Warm, inviting smile. Hands in a supportive gesture. Friendly, approachable expression. Open posture. Radiating positivity and connection.

A person stands at a stove, stirring a pot with a wooden spoon. They wear an apron, have flour on their cheek, and a satisfied smile. Their hair is tied back, and they hold a ladle in their other hand, steam rising from the pot.

A person in a bright yellow cleaning uniform, holding a mop and bucket. They have a determined look, wearing a mask and gloves. Their hair is tied back, and they are standing in a clean, shiny hallway.

subcategories.visual_description: A boy and girl, ages 5 and 6, stand side by side. The boy reaches out to touch the girl’s hand. Both smile and look at each other with happy eyes. Their bodies are close, showing friendship and shared joy.

entities.visual_description: A human head with round, smooth skin, dark hair in a messy ponytail, big bright eyes, a small nose, and a mouth curved in a smile. Has freckles on the nose and a tiny scar on the cheek.

Long, wavy brown hair flows down the back, with soft curls at the ends. Thick strands frame the face, some falling over the forehead. A few strands stick up from the sides, adding texture. The hair is smooth and shiny, with a natural, healthy glow.
A face with big, round eyes, wide nose, and full lips. Smooth skin with freckles across the nose. Short, dark hair with bangs. Bright smile showing even teeth. Cheeks slightly flushed with redness.

A large, round eye with thick, dark lashes. Bright, round pupil centered in the iris. Slight brow above the eye. Smooth, pale skin around the eye. Dark eyeliner outlines the edges. Small, clear tear duct at the inner corner.

A large, floppy ear with soft pink skin, folded over itself, hanging loosely. It has a small, round hole at the top, and a few tiny black hairs along the edge. The ear is slightly wrinkled and has a gentle curve, making it look cozy and familiar.

A red, round nose with a small bump at the tip. It has a wide, flat base and a slightly curved shape. The skin is smooth and shiny, with a few tiny freckles scattered across the surface. It sits centered on the face, just below the eyes.
A wide, open mouth with lips parted, showing small, white teeth. The mouth is round and slightly curved upward, with smooth, pink inner lips. Dark, moist lining inside, and a tiny tongue peeking out.
A white, cone-shaped tooth with a slight curve, sharp edges, and a small hole at the top. It gleams in the light, showing a clean, smooth surface with a tiny black spot near the base.

A pink, flexible tongue with a slightly wrinkled surface, long and slender, ending in a rounded tip. It has a glossy sheen, tiny bumps along the sides, and a soft, moist texture. The underside is lighter in color, with a visible vein pattern.

A long, flexible neck with smooth skin, slightly curved, supporting a head. It has a small, rounded collarbone at the base, and a gentle curve leading to the shoulders. The skin is pale, with faint lines and a soft texture.

A shoulder with smooth, rounded edges, slightly curved at the top. It has a soft, pale skin tone with faint muscle definition. Small, dark hair grows along the upper part. The shoulder appears relaxed, with a slight slope leading down to the arm.

A long, slender arm with smooth skin, slightly bent at the elbow. Fingers are spread, palms up, showing knuckles and nails. Muscles are visible but not overly defined. Fingertips are slightly curled, giving a gentle, open appearance.

A hand with long, slender fingers and a slightly curved thumb. The palm is smooth with faint lines, and the nails are short and clean. Skin has a soft, warm tone with a few tiny freckles. Fingers are slightly bent, showing a relaxed, open grip.

A finger with short, stubby nails, slightly bent at the joint, and a pale, smooth skin tone. It has a rounded tip and a small, wrinkled pad at the base. The finger is curled slightly, with a faint line running from the tip to the middle.

A human chest with defined pectoral muscles, smooth skin, and a natural chest hair pattern. Broad and rounded, with a slight curve. Visible ribs near the lower area. Darker skin tone with light freckles. A small scar near the left side.

A red, rounded heart shape with a pointed bottom. Smooth, curved edges. Two small white lines across the top, like a smile. Soft, glowing texture. Bright red color with a slight gradient. Simple, classic design. Easily recognizable as a heart.

A round, soft belly with smooth skin, slightly dimpled. Darker skin tone around the waist. A small belly button. Hairless, with a gentle curve. Appears full and relaxed. No visible clothing. Bright, healthy complexion. Soft, rounded shape.
A long, slender leg with smooth skin, toned muscles, and a slightly bent knee. Dark hair extends from the thigh down to the ankle. The foot is bare, with toes visible and a soft, rounded heel.

A human knee joint shows a rounded, slightly bent leg with a thick, rounded joint at the bend. The skin is smooth with a faint tan color, and the area has a soft, natural texture. The joint is covered in a thin layer of hair, and the surrounding skin shows slight movement and texture.

A foot with rounded toes, thick soles, and five distinct toes. Nails on each toe, some with dirt. Skin texture shows calluses. Ankle and heel visible. Barefoot, with small cracks and a sock peeking from the toes.

subcategories.visual_description: A young boy and girl, ages 5 and 6, stand side by side. The boy reaches out his hand, and the girl takes it. Their faces show smiles, eyes meet, and they lean slightly toward each other. Their bodies are close, showing friendship and connection.

entities.visual_description: A person with glowing eyes that shimmer like stars, their face calm and focused. Their hair flows like liquid silver, and their skin glows softly, reflecting the light around them. They wear a simple white robe that seems to float.

A person with glowing eyes that shimmer like stars, their face soft and warm with a gentle smile. Their hair flows like liquid silver, and their skin glows with a soft, golden light. They wear a simple robe that seems to float around them, untouched by the wind.

A glowing pair of large, round eyes with thick lashes, bright and shimmering in color. The irises are vivid, with a soft glow around them. Long, expressive eyebrows arch above, adding depth and emotion. The eyes are the focal point, surrounded by smooth, pale skin.

A person with large, glowing ears that shimmer like silver. Their face shows surprise, with wide eyes and an open mouth. Their hair is short and dark, and they wear a simple white shirt. A small, glowing sound wave floats near their head.

A person with wide, attentive eyes and slightly parted lips, head tilted forward. Hands raised palms up, fingers spread. Body slightly bent forward. Hair slightly messy, showing focus and openness. Bright, curious expression.

A person with a nose wrinkled and red, eyes wide and glossy, mouth open and slightly parted. Their face shows a mix of surprise and delight, with cheeks flushed and a hint of drool at the corner of their mouth.

A glowing, transparent figure with soft, swirling colors like perfume. Its body is made of light, with faint trails of scent particles floating around. Large, gentle eyes and a gentle smile. Hair flows like mist, and its form shimmers with fragrant hues.

A person with wide, curious eyes and a big smile, holding a spoon with a tiny, colorful cup. Their face shows excitement, and they have a small, sticky smudge on their chin. Bright, playful colors and a happy expression make them instantly recognizable.

A smiling face with bright, colorful swirls around the mouth, representing flavors. Large, round eyes with tiny taste buds visible. Hair shaped like a tongue with tiny bumps. Brightly colored cheeks and a happy, open mouth showing teeth.

A person gently touches another’s hand, eyes closed, smiling warmly. Soft light highlights their connected fingers. The touched person looks calm, with a gentle expression. Both have soft, natural skin tones and simple, expressive faces.

A glowing hand with soft, translucent fingers reaches out, its skin shimmering with warm light. The palm is open, showing gentle waves of light that ripple like water. Fingertips glow softly, creating a gentle, inviting aura around the hand.

A glowing heart with soft, warm light radiating from it. The heart has gentle curves and a smooth surface. It pulses with a golden glow, surrounded by delicate, flowing lines that resemble emotions. The light spreads in soft waves, creating a calming, comforting aura.

A person with flushed cheeks, bright red nose, and sweaty forehead. Their eyes are wide and glassy, showing irritation. They blink rapidly, lips parted, and have a slightly trembling hand. Their hair is messy, and they're breathing heavily, showing clear signs of being overheated.

A pale, translucent figure with glowing blue eyes and frosty breath. Thin, silver hair flows like ice. Skin has a shimmering, icy texture. Wears a long, flowing coat made of snowflakes. Hands are cold and glowing white.

A soft, round face with gentle curves, smooth skin like a cloud, big round eyes that sparkle with warmth, and a small, smiling mouth. Hair flows like a fluffy pillow, and arms drape loosely, creating a calm, comforting presence.

A person with wide, expressive eyes showing clear emotion, a furrowed brow, and a slightly open mouth. Their face shows tension and focus, with dark circles under the eyes and a red nose. Hair is messy and damp, adding to the intense, emotional expression.

A young girl with bright red hair in pigtails, wearing a pink dress and holding a lollipop. Her eyes are wide and curious, smiling with dimples. She has freckles on her nose and a small bow on her head.

A sour face with wrinkled skin, red eyes, and a twisted mouth. Dark circles under the eyes, a runny nose, and a drooping chin. Frowning eyebrows, a pouty lip, and a hunched posture. Bright red cheeks and a sly, squinted gaze.

Bitter has sharp, angular features with a pale, sallow complexion. Their eyes are dark and narrowed, showing suspicion. A thin, straight nose and tight lips add to their stern look. Their posture is rigid, and their hands are clenched, showing tension and unspoken anger.

Salty has big, round glasses with thick frames, a crooked smile, and a salt-shaker-shaped hat. Their skin is pale, with freckles, and they wear a striped shirt with a salt-themed pattern. Their hands are always near a bowl of popcorn, and their eyes sparkle with mischief.

subcategories.visual_description: A young girl and boy, ages 5 and 6, sit side by side on a bench. The girl points at a flower, and the boy leans in to look. Their hands touch slightly, and both smile, eyes wide with curiosity.

entities.visual_description: A person stretching in a sunny room, arms up, face smiling, eyes closed. Hair messy, shirt slightly open, feet bare on the floor. Morning light shines through the window, highlighting the relaxed posture and cheerful expression.

A person standing tall, arms raised, face showing determination. Bright smile, eyes wide with energy. Hair slightly messy, clothes wrinkled from movement. Strong posture, confident stance. Expression shows effort and triumph. Body language shows readiness to act.

A child stands at a sink, holding a toothbrush. Bright toothpaste foam covers their mouth. Their hair is damp, and they have a small towel draped over one shoulder. Eyes are wide with focus. A toothbrush in one hand, a cup of water in the other.

A person with wet, soapy face, scrubbing with a sponge. Bright bubbles surround the face. Hair is damp and messy. Eyes are closed, focused on the task. Water droplets fall from the cheeks. Hands move rhythmically, cleaning the skin.

A person stands in a bathroom, holding a sponge, water dripping from their hair and hands. Their face is wet, eyes closed, and they are smiling. A towel hangs nearby, and steam rises from the shower area.

A smiling child stands in a bedroom, holding a colorful outfit. They have curly hair, a bright shirt, and a pair of pants. Their face shows excitement, and they are looking at a mirror. A stuffed animal sits nearby.

A comb with soft, curved teeth and a handle shaped like a small hand. The teeth are evenly spaced and slightly rounded, with a smooth, wooden texture. The handle has a gentle curve and a small, rounded tip. The comb is light brown with a polished finish.
A person sitting at a table with a plate of toast, eggs, and a glass of juice. Bright smile, messy hair, and a cozy kitchen background. Warm lighting, simple clothes, and a happy, relaxed expression.

A child in a yellow backpack walks toward a blue school bus. Bright red sneakers, a blue hat, and a backpack with a pencil case. The child holds a lunch box and waves at a parent standing near the bus.
A person in a business suit, holding a briefcase, standing near a desk with a laptop, smiling while talking on a phone, surrounded by paperwork and a coffee cup.

A person sits at a desk, focused on a book. They have glasses, a messy hairdo, and a notebook open in front. Their posture is slouched, showing concentration. A cup of coffee sits nearby, steam rising slightly. The room is dimly lit with a single lamp.

A person sits on a cozy couch, holding a book open with one hand. Their face is lit by a warm lamp, showing a focused expression. A blanket is draped over one shoulder, and a cup of tea sits nearby, steaming slightly.

names.ja: コンピュータを使う (konpyūta o tsukau)

ja.syllable: コンピュータを使う (konpyūta o tsukau)

entities.visual_description: A person sits at a desk, facing a computer screen. They have short hair, glasses, and a focused expression. Their hands are on the keyboard, fingers moving quickly. The room has a tidy desk, a chair, and a lamp. The screen shows a document with text.
A person stretches on a mat, arms up, legs bent, face relaxed. Sweaty hair sticks to forehead. Shirt slightly damp. Bright sun behind them. Yoga mat with small flowers. Bare feet on ground.

names.ja: ゲームをする (gēmu o suru)

ja.syllable: ゲームをする (gēmu o suru)

entities.visual_description: A person sitting on a couch, smiling, holding a controller. Brightly colored game console nearby. Focused expression, eyes closed. Comfortable clothes, messy hair. Happy, relaxed, engaged in play.

names.ja: 料理する (りょうり suru)

entities.visual_description: A person with flour-dusted hands, wearing an apron, smiling while holding a tray of cookies. Their hair is tied back, and they have a warm, friendly expression. The background shows a kitchen with a stove and counter.

names.ja: 家を掃除する (ie o sōji suru)

ja.syllable: 家を掃除する (ie o sōji suru)

entities.visual_description: A clean house has tidy floors, neat furniture, and bright lights. Windows are sparkling, walls are dust-free, and surfaces are spotless. A vacuum sits by the door, and a clean cloth hangs by the sink. Everything is organized and shiny.

names.ja: 洗濯する (せんたく suru)

entities.visual_description: A person holds a pile of clothes, bending slightly to reach a laundry basket. Their arms are full of folded shirts and socks. A towel hangs nearby. The person has messy hair and a tired smile. Bright sunlight shines through a window.

names.ja: 買い物に行く (かいものにいく - kaimono ni iku)

ja.syllable: 買い物に行く (kaimono ni iku)

entities.visual_description: A person holding a shopping bag, smiling, with a basket of groceries. Wearing a colorful scarf, sunglasses, and a light jacket. Hair in a messy bun, cheeks flushed from walking. Brightly colored clothes and a happy expression.

A soft, glowing moon hangs above a cozy bed. A small, fluffy stuffed bear sits beside a child, its eyes closed and head resting on a pillow. The room is calm, with gentle lighting and a warm, inviting atmosphere.

subcategories.visual_description: A young girl and her mother sit on a bench. The girl is about 5 years old, the mother is in her 30s. They share a snack, smiling and laughing. The girl's hand is in the mother's, and they both have happy expressions.

entities.visual_description: A classroom with desks, chairs, a whiteboard, and a teacher at the front. Bright lights, colorful posters, and books on shelves. Students sit quietly, some writing, others listening. A clock on the wall shows morning time.
A teacher with a warm smile, glasses, and a neat haircut. Wears a blue blazer and skirt. Has a clipboard in one hand and a bag in the other. Carries a stack of books. Looks approachable and friendly.
