Dark gray clouds hang low, heavy with rain. Dripping water falls in steady streams, glistening in the dim light. The air is thick and cool, with mist curling around the edges. Raindrops splash on wet ground, creating small puddles that reflect the cloudy sky.

A swirling mass of dark clouds with bright lightning bolts. Gray skies filled with heavy rain. Strong winds blowing leaves and small objects. A powerful storm with thunder and flashes of light. Dark, intense, and full of movement.

A fluffy white cloud with soft, rounded edges. Bright, icy crystals cover its surface. It floats gently in a clear blue sky. Light snowflakes swirl around it. The cloud has a smooth, pale appearance with a slight glow.

A swirling, pale blue vortex with wispy, light gray arms. It has a glowing, soft yellow center and faint, shimmering streaks. The wind moves quickly, creating a dynamic, flowing pattern around a clear, open space.

A thick, gray blanket covers the ground and trees, blending everything into a soft, muted gray. Wisps rise and swirl slowly, hiding details. The air feels damp and cool, with a hazy glow around objects. Everything is blurred, soft, and quiet under the gray mist.

A fiery red ball hangs in the sky, glowing bright orange. Thick, dark clouds swirl around it, steaming and bubbling. Lightning flashes nearby, and the air shimmers with heat. The sky is dark, with a glowing orange sun.

A warm sun shines brightly with golden light. Its rays stretch across the sky, glowing orange and yellow. The sky is light blue, with soft clouds drifting by. The sun's edges are slightly blurred, showing its gentle, comforting presence.
A bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. The sun shines brightly, casting warm light. Gentle breezes ripple the clouds. A calm, peaceful atmosphere fills the scene. The air feels fresh and clean.

A pale blue sky with dark, swirling clouds. Heavy frost covers the ground, trees, and rocks. Snowflakes fall slowly, shimmering in the weak sunlight. A cold wind blows, making the air feel sharp and biting. Everything is quiet and still, covered in white.

A swirling mass of ice crystals and frost, glowing blue and white. Sharp, jagged edges with a cold, shimmering surface. Frozen mist curls around, creating a shimmering, icy aura. Bright, icy light reflects off its frozen form.

A swirling, gray cloud with droplets hanging from its edges. Light mist surrounds it, making everything look damp. The cloud has a soft, hazy texture and appears heavy with moisture. It looks like a giant, fluffy, wet blanket in the sky.

A dry, cracked earth surface with brown, dusty patches. Cracks spread like lines in a map. Some areas are sun-baked and hard. A few dry leaves lie scattered. The sky is bright and clear. No rain in sight. Wind moves the dust slightly.

Bright blue streaks of light flash across the sky, zigzagging in sharp lines. Crackle sounds echo as golden sparks fly. Dark clouds swirl below, glowing with a pale yellow glow. Lightning splits the sky into bright flashes, illuminating the world in sudden bursts of light.
A large, dark cloud with bright flashes of lightning. Thick, heavy rain pours down. Thunder rumbles in the distance. Gray skies with strong winds. Dark, stormy clouds fill the sky.

A bright arc of colors stretches across the sky. It has red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and violet bands. The colors are vivid and shimmering. It appears after rain and is curved like a bow.

Small, hard ice pellets fall from dark clouds, bouncing on surfaces. They shine bright white in sunlight, with smooth, rounded shapes. Each one is solid, cold, and reflects light clearly. They move quickly, clattering together as they fall.
A swirling mass of dark clouds with bright flashes of lightning. Strong winds twist the sky, creating a vortex of gray and white. Heavy rain falls in sheets, and the air shimmers with stormy energy.

subcategories.visual_description: A big yellow sun shines brightly. Clouds float in the sky. Raindrops fall from dark gray clouds. A rainbow arcs over a blue lake. Wind blows leaves across the ground.

entities.visual_description: A compass rose with an arrow pointing north. The arrow is bold, red, and has a white background. It stands on a circular base with cardinal directions labeled in bold letters. The design is clean and simple, with clear, distinct lines and colors.

A compass rose with an arrow pointing right. The arrow is red, bold, and stands out against a blue background. The circle has markings for north, east, south, and west. The south direction is marked with a lowercase "s".

A compass rose with an arrow pointing east. The arrow is red, bold, and stands out against a blue background. The circle has markings for north, south, west, and east. The east arrow is the largest and most detailed.

A compass rose with a bold arrow pointing north. The arrow is red with a white tip, surrounded by a circular background with cardinal directions labeled in bold letters. The design is clean and modern, with sharp lines and high contrast.

A left arrow pointing straight up. Bright blue with a white border. Sharp, simple lines. Bold and clear. Stands alone on a white background. Clean and modern design. Easily recognizable. Shows direction clearly.

A bright yellow arrow pointing to the right. It has a bold, simple shape with a straight line and a triangular head. The arrow is solid and clear, with no extra details. It stands alone on a white background.

A bright arrow pointing upward, bold and simple. Its shaft is straight, with a wide, solid head. The arrow is in a vibrant blue color, glowing slightly. It stands on a plain background, clearly showing the direction it points.

A green arrow pointing down, bold and simple. The arrowhead is wide and flat, with a straight line beneath it. The color is bright green, standing out clearly. The shape is unmistakable, showing direction clearly.

A green arrow pointing straight ahead, bold and simple. Its shaft is thick, with a triangular head at the end. The arrow is solid green, no details, just a clear direction. Bright and easy to recognize.

A backward-facing arrow with a curved tail pointing left. The arrow has a bold, solid black shaft and a wide, rounded tip. It stands on a white background, with a faint shadow beneath it. The design is simple and clear, making the direction immediately recognizable.

A large arrow pointing straight ahead, bold and bright. Its shaft is smooth and straight, with a wide, flat head. The arrow is colored bright yellow with a black outline. It stands upright on a plain background, facing forward.
A small arrow pointing backward, with a curved tail and a bold head. The arrow is bright blue, with a white outline. It stands on a dark background, facing left, showing direction clearly.

A glowing compass rose with arrows pointing north, surrounded by a circular map. The map shows roads, mountains, and a sun rising in the east. The compass has a metallic frame and a glass cover, with clear markings and a needle spinning slowly.
A compass rose with arrows pointing north, south, east, and west. Bright red arrow points up, blue arrow down, green arrow right, and yellow arrow left. Simple, clean lines with bold colors.

A simple arrow pointing upward, bright and bold. The arrowhead is wide and rounded, with a smooth curve. The shaft is straight and short, ending in a small tail. The color is bright yellow, with a black outline.
A small arrow pointing downward, bright yellow with a black outline. It has a simple triangular shape with a straight line beneath it. The arrow is centered and surrounded by clean white space.

A glowing arrow pointing forward, bright blue with a white outline. It has a simple, clean design with a triangular tip and a straight shaft. The arrow shines softly, making it easy to see in the dark. It stands upright on a flat surface, pointing clearly in one direction.

A tall, thin figure with long, flowing arms and legs. Has a pointed head and large, glowing eyes. Wears a simple, flowing robe. Moves with a slow, deliberate motion. Has a faint, glowing trail behind.

A glowing arrow pointing straight up, surrounded by swirling light. Its tip shines bright white, while the shaft glows softly blue. The arrow has a smooth, rounded shape with a faint mist around it, making it look magical and clear.

A circular shape with arrows pointing clockwise. Bright blue with white arrowheads. Smooth, glowing edges. Simple, clean lines. Center has a small star. Looks like a compass but only shows one direction.

subcategories.visual_description: A big arrow pointing right with a happy face, a circle with a dot inside, and a star with a line through it. A little robot follows the arrow, jumps over the circle, and stops at the star.

entities.visual_description: A big, round ball with smooth, shiny skin. Bright red color, slightly squishy texture. Large, soft eyes that look curious. Short, stubby legs and a wide, fluffy tail. Round belly and tiny, floppy ears. Looks friendly and playful.
A tiny creature with big round eyes, one side red and the other blue. Short legs, one long and one short. One ear big, one small. One hand with three fingers, one with two. One eye wide, one narrow.

A tall, slender figure with long legs and a small head. Has big, round eyes and a long neck. Wears a short, tight outfit. Has a long, thin body and short arms. Looks very different from a short person.

A short, round creature with big, wide eyes and a tiny body. It has stubby legs and a short tail. Its skin is smooth and bright blue, with white spots. It looks curious and playful, standing on two legs.

A long, thin stick with a round, smooth end. It has a straight, slender body and a slightly curved tip. The surface is smooth and pale, with a faint natural texture. It stands upright, slightly tilted, in a small patch of dirt.

A young child with bright blue eyes and curly brown hair. Wears a red shirt and blue pants. Has a small smile and a happy expression. Holds a toy dinosaur in one hand. Has freckles on the nose and a round face.
A wrinkled, gray-haired old person with a bent back, thick glasses, and a long, flowing coat. Their face has deep creases and a gentle smile, with a cane in one hand and a small bag in the other.
A fast blur of bright yellow and blue streaks, sharp edges, and glowing trails. Streamlined shape with glowing eyes and a tail. Speed lines radiate from its body. Bright, dynamic, and energetic.

A slow-moving creature with thick, heavy legs and a rounded body. Its short, stubby tail drags behind. Large, dull eyes peer forward. Thick, rough skin with dark patches. A wide, flat nose and small, weak mouth. Overall, it moves with a heavy, sluggish pace.

A strong, muscular figure with broad shoulders and defined arms. Thick, dark hair falls over a strong jawline. Deep-set eyes show determination. Broad chest and wide back show power. Strong hands grip a heavy object. Bold, confident posture shows strength.
A small, frail figure with drooping shoulders and pale skin. Long, thin limbs and a weak, wobbly stance. Large, tired eyes and a thin, pale face. Soft, lifeless hair and a weak, trembling grip.

A clean white towel lies flat on a bright blue towel rack. It is smooth, dry, and slightly wrinkled. The edges are neatly folded, and the surface is free of stains or dirt. The color is pure white, with a soft, fluffy texture.

A small, muddy creature with dirt-caked fur, wide eyes full of grime, and a snout covered in mud. Its paws are muddy, and its tail is wrapped around a dirty rock. The whole body is coated in dirt and grime, making it look very dirty and messy.

A bright yellow circle with a wide black border, filled with swirling white lines. The center has a small red dot. The shape is simple and round, with sharp contrast between colors. It looks like a sun with a dark ring around it.
A closed door stands tall, its surface smooth and dark with a metal frame. A small handle hangs still, no movement. The door is shut tight, no light passes through. It stands alone, silent and still.

A tall, thin figure with a round, bright red face and big, black eyes. Long, flowing white hair and a wide, smiling mouth. One arm is stretched out, the other is curled in. Wears a simple white robe with a red sash.

A blank page with no lines, shapes, or colors. Smooth white surface, no text or images. Empty space with no details. Flat and uniform. No edges or markings. Pure, untouched surface. Simple and clear. No features to see. Just blank.

A bright, glowing sphere with soft white light, surrounded by faint golden rays. It has a smooth, round shape with no edges, shining brightly and casting no shadow. The light feels warm and inviting, with a gentle, steady glow that fills the space around it.

A heavy creature with thick, muscular legs and a broad, rounded body. Its skin is dark and rough, like cracked stone. Large, round eyes glow faintly. Short, stubby arms hang loosely. A wide, heavy tail sways slowly behind.

A simple yellow circle with a big smiley face, round and bright. Big black eyes, short stubby arms, and legs. Wearing a red shirt and blue pants. Has a big red balloon tied to its waist. Looks happy and playful.

A small, round, red ball with a smooth surface and a single white stripe running vertically. It has a soft, bouncy texture and a bright, glowing light inside. The ball is simple, colorful, and easy to recognize.

subcategories.visual_description: A big red ball and a small blue ball sit side by side. The big one is round and heavy, the small one is light and bouncy. One is tall, the other is short. One is fast, the other is slow. One is hot, the other is cold. One is soft, the other is hard.

entities.visual_description: A round, smooth head with big, round eyes. Short, dark hair on top. A small nose and wide mouth. Two ears on the sides. A flat forehead. Bright, colorful skin. Simple, friendly face.

A thick, curly strand of hair hangs down, dark brown with light highlights. It has a soft, wavy texture and a natural shine. The strand is slightly frayed at the ends, giving it a lived-in look. It sways gently, showing movement and volume.

A smooth, rounded forehead with soft curves. Skin tone varies, often pale or light. Hair starts at the top, framing the face. No eyes, nose, or mouth. Clean, flat surface with possible slight bumps or ridges. Brightly colored in some cases.

A large, round eye with a smooth, shiny surface. Dark pupil in the center, surrounded by a bright white ring. Thick, dark lashes frame the eye. Slight bulge at the sides. Bright, reflective highlights catch the light.

A large, floppy ear with soft pink skin, rounded and slightly curved. It has a small, dark brown spot near the tip. The inside is pale pink, smooth, and slightly wrinkled. Long, thin hair grows from the top, curling slightly. It hangs loosely, ready to catch a gentle breeze.

A pink nose with a small bump at the tip, slightly rounded and moist. It has tiny red blood vessels visible, and a tiny nose hair sticking out. The skin is smooth and slightly shiny, with a natural color and texture.

A wide, open mouth with lips parted slightly. Upper lip curved upward, lower lip fuller. Teeth visible, small and white. Tongue slightly protruding. Dark, glossy lips with a soft, pinkish inner part. Rounded cheeks around the mouth.

A white, cone-shaped object with a small hole at the top. It has a curved root and a flat surface. It is smooth and round, with a slight indentation on one side. Bright white color, slightly translucent.

A pink, flexible tongue with a slightly wrinkled surface. It has a pointed tip and a broad, flat base. The underside is lighter in color, with small bumps along the edges. It stretches and curls naturally, showing soft, moist texture.

A long, flexible neck with smooth skin, slightly curved, supporting a head. It has a slender shape, with small, delicate bones visible beneath the skin. The skin is pale, with faint lines and a soft texture. It connects the body to the head, showing movement and flexibility.

A shoulder with rounded, smooth skin, slightly raised collarbone, and defined muscle lines. Dark hair lines the neck, and a small scar runs along the upper arm. The skin has a natural texture with light freckles and a faint tan.

A long, slender arm with a rounded shoulder, straight elbow, and a palm facing forward. Fingers are spread apart, slightly curved, with short, blunt nails. Skin is smooth and pale, with a faint shadow under the arm.

A human elbow joint shows a rounded, slightly bent arm connected to a straight forearm. The skin is smooth with a faint crease along the bend. Small bumps and veins are visible on the skin surface. The joint appears flexible and ready to move.

A hand with five fingers, each with a fingertip. Fingers are straight, with short nails. Palm is flat, skin is smooth. Fingers are slightly curved. Fingertips are rounded. Hand is medium-sized, with visible joints. Skin color is light.

A long, slender finger with a rounded tip, covered in smooth skin. It has a single joint, with a small, flat nail at the end. The finger is pale, with faint lines running along its length, giving it a realistic, human-like appearance.
A large, rounded chest with a flat front. Has a wide, sturdy frame. Smooth skin with a slight curve. Two small openings at the bottom. No arms or legs. Solid and heavy-looking.

A back is the rear part of the body, visible when someone is standing or sitting. It has a curved shape, covered in skin with hair, and includes the spine, shoulders, and neck. It may show muscle definition, posture, and clothing details like shirts or backpacks.

A round, soft belly with smooth skin, slightly wrinkled around the edges. It has a pale pink color, with a small belly button in the center. The surface is slightly dimpled and feels warm to the touch.

A long, slender leg with smooth skin, covered in small, dark hairs. It has a rounded knee and a foot with five toes. The ankle is slightly bent, and the leg tapers from thick at the thigh to thin at the ankle.

A human knee joint shows a rounded, slightly bent leg with a thick, rounded joint at the bend. The skin is smooth with a small, dark spot near the joint. The leg is slightly bent, showing the curve of the knee and the surrounding muscle.

A foot with rounded toes, thick soles, and five distinct toes. Nails on each toe, some with dirt. Skin texture visible, with cracks and calluses. Ankle and heel clearly defined. Darker skin tone with light patches.

A big, round toe with a wide, flat top. It has a thick, fleshy bottom and a narrow, pointed tip. The skin is smooth and slightly wrinkled, with a soft, pale pink color. It has a short, stubby nail on the tip.

Smooth, pale pink skin with a soft texture, slightly damp in places. Small, dark spots scattered across the surface. Fine hairs grow in light brown patches. A faint, pale blue tint appears on the cheeks and nose.

A red, rounded shape with a pointed bottom. Smooth, soft curves on the top. Two small, curved lines on the sides. A solid color with no details. Simple and familiar shape. Bright red color. Looks like a heart.

A large, round brain with a smooth, pale gray surface. It has a soft, wrinkled texture with deep folds and grooves. Numerous small blood vessels run through it, appearing as thin red lines. The top has a smooth, rounded shape with a slight indentation.

subcategories.visual_description: A big, smiling face with big eyes, a nose, and a mouth. Two ears on the sides. Hands with fingers and a thumb. Feet with toes. Hair on top. A body with arms and legs.

entities.visual_description: Clear, flowing liquid with a smooth, glassy surface. Shiny and reflective, it moves gently in a glass. Translucent blue and white colors blend together. It sparkles in the light, with tiny bubbles rising slowly. Smooth and cool to the touch, it looks fresh and clean.

White liquid in a glass, smooth and clear, with a slight curve at the top. Tiny bubbles rise slowly. A straw sticks out, slightly bent. The glass is tall and narrow, with a rim. Light reflects on the surface, making it shiny.

A bright orange juice bottle with a curved neck, clear plastic body, and a label in bold letters. The cap is dark and has a twist-off design. The liquid inside is clear and sparkling, with a few bubbles rising.

A steaming cup of tea with a red and white label. The liquid is warm, golden-brown, with small bubbles rising. A handle curves from the cup, and a saucer sits nearby. Steam rises gently from the surface.
A dark brown liquid in a white mug, steaming gently. The surface has swirling patterns and a few small bubbles. A wooden spoon rests beside it, and a cozy cup saucer holds it steady.

Soft golden loaf with a slightly browned crust, round and slightly squashed at the bottom. Cracks run along the top, showing a fluffy inside. Light brown seeds and a small sprout peek through the top.

White grains with a slightly yellowish tint, small and oval-shaped. Smooth, firm texture. Often found in a bowl, steamed and fluffy. Golden color when cooked. Has a soft, grainy feel. Commonly served with rice cooker or steamer.

Long, thin strands of white pasta twisted together, slightly curved, with a smooth, pale yellow surface. Some have small ridges, others are perfectly round. A few are curled into loops, others straight, all soft and flexible, lying in a bowl with a bit of sauce.

A smooth, oval-shaped egg with a pale yellow shell. It has a slightly pointed end and a rounded end. The surface is slightly textured with small bumps. A tiny, dark spot is visible near the rounded end. It appears fresh and clean.

A round, red, juicy piece of meat with a slightly browned surface. Smooth texture, soft and tender. Bright red inside, with a slight fat layer. Dark veins run through it. Shiny and moist, with a natural, fresh appearance.

A bright red fish with shimmering silver sides, big round eyes, and a tall, pointed tail. Its body is smooth and curved, with small, scattered black spots. Fins are triangular and pale, adding movement to its sleek form.

A plump chicken with golden feathers, a red comb on its head, and a small beak. Its body is round and fluffy, with short legs and a tail that flaps slightly. The skin is pale with tiny black dots, and it has bright eyes.

A round, brown package with a red label and white "Beef" text. It has a sealed top, a textured surface, and a slightly curved shape. The label shows a cow logo and nutritional info. It's a solid, compact package with a metallic sheen.

A pink, round, juicy pork chop with a slightly crispy skin. Smooth, pale pink flesh with a golden-brown crust. Bright red juices drip down. Soft, tender texture. Round, thick, and slightly curved. Bright, appetizing colors.

A red apple with a smooth, shiny skin. It has a rounded shape and a small stem at the top. The surface has a slight bumpy texture with tiny dimples. A green leaf is attached near the stem. The color is bright red with a slight greenish tint at the bottom.
A bright yellow banana with a curved shape, smooth skin, and a slight bend. It has a brownish tip at one end and a small, pointed end. The surface has a slightly wrinkled texture with a glossy sheen.

A round, bright orange fruit with a smooth, slightly textured skin. It has a pointed stem at the top and a small, green leafy part at the bottom. The fruit is firm and juicy inside, with a sweet, tangy flavor.

A plump, dark purple grape with a slightly wrinkled skin. It has a tiny stem at the top and a pointed end. The surface is glossy and shiny, with a juicy, round shape. Bright green seeds are visible inside.

A bright red watermelon with green striped skin, round and slightly pointed at the top. It has a smooth surface with a waxy texture, and a green stem at the top. Inside, it shows a pink-red flesh with black seeds.

A bright red strawberry with a slightly pointed tip. It has a smooth, glossy surface with tiny white seeds visible. The fruit is round, slightly elongated, and has a green stem at the top. Its color is vivid red with a white core.

A bright orange carrot with smooth skin and a slightly tapered shape. It has a firm texture and a natural, slightly curved tip. The surface shows small, visible grooves and a few tiny green leaves at the top.

A round, brown potato with smooth skin and a slightly wrinkled texture. It has a pale yellow interior, visible through the skin. The top is slightly rounded, and the eyes are small, dark spots. It looks fresh and ready to cook.
A bright red, round fruit with smooth skin. Small dimples near the top. Green stem end. Crinkled leaves nearby. Juicy inside. Thick, firm flesh. Bright red color. Round shape. Smooth texture.

A round, brown onion with layered skin, wrinkled and dry. White layers inside, some yellowing. Bulbous shape, firm texture. Striped outer layers, slightly pointed ends. Bright green leaves sprouting from the top.

A swirl of creamy white and colorful toppings. Bright red strawberry on top. A cone with a golden-brown shell. A scoop of vanilla with chocolate sauce drizzle. A sprinkle of rainbow candies around the edge.

A round, fluffy cake with a smooth chocolate top, covered in pink frosting. It has a golden-brown crust and a soft, creamy center. Decorated with red berries and a cherry on top, it looks delicious and sweet.
A round, golden-brown cookie with a crispy texture. It has a soft, chewy center and a slightly cracked surface. Decorated with a red cherry on top, it looks delicious and ready to eat.
A bright pink candy with a smooth, shiny surface. It has a round shape and a soft, squishy texture. A small swirl pattern is visible on the wrapper. It glows slightly in the dark.

A round, flat pizza with a golden-brown crust. Red tomato sauce covers the top, with melted mozzarella cheese. Crinkled edges and a few pepperoni slices add texture. Bright green basil leaves are scattered across the surface.

A juicy hamburger with a brown bun, crispy sesame seed top, and a red, white, and green pickle. A melted cheese slice covers the patty, which is browned and slightly charred. Onion rings and lettuce add texture. A slice of tomato adds a splash of red.

subcategories.visual_description: A big red apple, a yellow banana, a green leafy salad, a glass of orange juice, and a cup of hot chocolate with a straw. Bright colors and simple shapes for little hands to recognize.

entities.visual_description: A white T-shirt with a round neckline, short sleeves, and a fitted body. It has a soft, smooth fabric texture and a slightly stretched fit. The shirt is plain, with no logos or patterns, and has a collar that sits neatly around the neck.

A white cotton shirt with a round collar, short sleeves, and a button-down front. It has a fitted body, a V-shaped neckline, and a simple design with no pockets or embellishments. The fabric is smooth and slightly wrinkled, giving it a casual, everyday look.

A dark blue jacket with a rounded collar and long sleeves. It has a front zipper, two front pockets, and a slightly curved hem. The fabric is smooth and slightly worn at the edges, giving it a casual, everyday look.

A long, sleeveless coat with a high collar and a fitted waist. It has a straight, slightly tapered shape and a rounded hem. The fabric is dark and smooth, with a subtle texture. It has two front pockets and a single button closure at the top.

A cozy knit sweater in soft gray, with a rounded neckline and long sleeves. It has a textured pattern of small bumps and a snug fit around the arms and body. The collar is slightly folded up, showing a hint of the inner lining.

A cozy hoodie with a rounded neckline, long sleeves, and a front zipper. It has a soft, pillowy texture with a slightly stretched look. The hood is large and has a drawstring at the back. The body is slightly oversized, with a ribbed hem and cuffs. The color is a warm gray with a subtle pattern.

A simple dress with a round neckline, short sleeves, and a straight hem. It has a solid color, smooth fabric, and a fitted silhouette. The dress is made of light fabric, with a soft, flowing appearance. It has no extra details or patterns.

A bright pink skirt with a straight, fitted silhouette. It has a high waist, a pleated front, and a straight back. The fabric is smooth and shiny, with a slight ruffle at the hem. It is made of soft, flowing material that moves gracefully.

A pair of blue jeans with rolled-up cuffs, faded stitching, and a zipper at the back. Dark blue fabric, pockets on the sides, and a belt loop at the waist. The legs are straight, with a slightly worn look around the knees.

A pair of shorts with a fitted waist, straight legs, and a hem at the ankle. Bright blue color with white stitching. Elastic band around the waist. Two side pockets with embroidered logos. Lightweight fabric, soft and breathable.

A pair of blue jeans with a straight leg and a zip fly. Dark denim fabric with faded patches on the knees. Metal zipper and button fly. Distressed edges and reinforced stitching along the seams. Classic five-pocket design with a worn look.

Two brown leather shoes with laces, one on the left and one on the right. Each has a rounded toe, a thick sole, and a small heel. The left shoe has a slight scuff on the side, while the right is clean. Both are worn and show signs of use.

A pair of sturdy boots with brown leather uppers, thick soles, and laces tied at the top. They have a pointed toe and a reinforced heel. The boots are worn, with scuffed sides and a slightly muddy appearance.

Two brown straps cross over the foot, with a small buckle at the front. The upper part is made of woven material, with a soft sole underneath. The design is simple and classic, suitable for warm weather.

Soft, fluffy slippers with round, cushioned soles. Bright pink with white polka dots. Thick, fluffy socks attached. Rounded toe and heel. Gentle curves. Bright, cheerful colors. Made of plush fabric. Looks cozy and comfortable.

Two colorful socks, one red with a white stripe, the other blue with a yellow stripe. Each has a toe section and a foot part. They are soft, knitted, and have seams visible on the sides. One sock has a small hole near the toe.

A wide-brimmed hat with a rounded top, made of dark brown felt. It has a soft fold at the front and a small ribbon tied under the chin. The brim is slightly curled inward, and the hat sits low on the head, covering most of the forehead.

A red cap with a white star on the front. It has a soft brim and a snug fit. The star is shiny and centered. The cap is made of cotton. It has a small adjustable strap at the back. The color is bright and cheerful.

Two white gloves with finger holes, stretchy fabric, seamless design, soft texture, slightly transparent, finger tips are separate, cuff is elastic, no seams visible, smooth surface, pale color, rounded edges, simple and clean look.

A soft, fluffy scarf in warm beige with a subtle pattern of small, rounded shapes in light brown. It has a gentle wave, a snug fit, and a slightly frayed edge. Made of thick, fluffy yarn, it looks cozy and comfortable.

A sturdy belt made of brown leather with a thick black buckle. It has a simple design, with a flat edge and a loop at the end. The leather is smooth and slightly worn, showing signs of regular use. It sits snugly around the waist, holding up pants securely.

A red tie with a white stripe down the center. It has a flat, narrow shape. The fabric is smooth and slightly shiny. It is tied in a simple knot at the neck. The ends are even and straight. The colors are bright and bold.

A bright yellow backpack with a red stripe down the side. It has a padded shoulder strap, a zippered front panel, and a small pouch on the top. The back is made of durable fabric with a mesh panel for ventilation.

A long, straight pole with a round, collapsible top. The top has a handle and a brim. The pole is made of lightweight material, and the top is covered in water-resistant fabric. The umbrella has a handle at the bottom and a button to open and close it.

A red watch with a round face and silver hands. It has a black strap with a buckle. The numbers are white. The glass is clear. It looks simple and clean. The watch face is slightly curved. The strap is soft and flexible.

subcategories.visual_description: A bright red shirt with a yellow star on the chest, blue jeans with a small pocket, and white socks. A pair of brown shoes sits nearby. The clothes are neatly folded on a blue bed.

entities.visual_description: A school building with red brick walls, large windows, and a white roof. It has a tall flagpole, a playground area, and a blackboard on the front door. The entrance has a metal door with a bell.

A classroom with desks, chairs, a whiteboard, and a teacher's desk. Bright walls with posters. Windows with curtains. Bookshelves. A clock on the wall. Students' backpacks on desks. Crayons and pencils on a table.

A tall adult with a neat haircut, wearing a blue dress with a white collar, holding a blackboard, and smiling warmly. Bright eyes, soft facial features, and a friendly expression make the teacher instantly recognizable in a school setting.

A student with a backpack, wearing a school uniform, has a backpack slung over one shoulder. Their hair is tied back in a ponytail, and they hold a notebook in one hand. They have a bright, focused look with a pencil behind their ear.
A wooden desk with a smooth surface, straight legs, and a front edge. It has a drawer with a handle, a curved corner, and a small clock on top. The desk is light brown with a clean, simple design.

A wooden school chair with a straight back and a curved seat. It has a metal frame, a small armrest, and a flat, wide seat. The legs are sturdy and slightly angled. The chair is light brown with a smooth, clean surface.

A large vertical blackboard with white letters and numbers. It has a wooden frame around the edges. The surface is smooth and clean, with a few chalk marks. It stands on a metal stand. The board is in a classroom setting.

A school book with a hard cover, blue and white stripes, and a yellow label reading "Math." It has a spine with the title and author, and pages inside are blank. The cover is slightly worn at the edges.

A yellow school notebook with a hard cover, blue lines, and a ribbon for flipping pages. It has a metal clasp, a pencil holder, and a small pocket on the side. The cover is labeled "Notebook" in bold letters.

A yellow pencil with a wooden body, smooth and slightly curved. It has a pink eraser at the end, soft and round. The pencil is capped with a small, flat yellow cap. It lies on a desk, surrounded by paper and a ruler.

A yellow plastic pen with a rounded body, a blue cap, and a silver button at the end. It has a smooth, slim shape and a small eraser on one side. The body is slightly curved, and the cap is slightly larger than the pen body.

A pink eraser with a smooth, rubbery surface. It has a rounded shape and a small, flat end. The body is slightly curved, with a soft, bumpy texture. It features a small, white stripe running vertically down the middle.

A ruler with a straight, flat top and evenly spaced markings. Bright yellow body with black lines. Rounded ends. Sturdy and simple design. Made of plastic. Has a handle on one end. Clean and clear markings. Easy to grip. Bright and visible.

A yellow marker with a pointed tip, smooth body, and a rubber eraser at the end. It has a label reading "MARKER" in bold letters. The body is slightly curved, and the tip is sharp. The color is bright yellow with a matte finish.

A crayon is a short, thick stick with a rounded end. It has a smooth, waxy surface and a flat, colored tip. The body is usually cylindrical, with a label wrapped around it. It comes in many bright colors and is often found in a box with other crayons.

A paint brush has a long, flexible bristle head attached to a wooden handle. The bristles are soft and slightly curved, with a flat edge. The handle is smooth and slightly tapered, with a small metal ferrule at the end. The brush is bright yellow with a red stripe along the handle.

White flat sheet with faint lines and edges, smooth texture. Bright and clean, often seen in classrooms. May have a rough edge or be folded. Usually found in folders or desks. Simple, plain, and easy to recognize.
Two metal blades with sharp edges, connected by a pivot point. Handles are curved and grip-friendly, with a small pin near the pivot. Brightly colored, often red or blue, with a simple design.

A small, clear bottle with a narrow neck and a yellow label. It has a cap that's slightly twisted. The bottle is made of plastic, with a smooth, transparent body. A few drops of sticky liquid cling to the sides.

A yellow calculator with a blue screen, round buttons, and a number pad. It has a sleek plastic body, a small display window, and a slide cover. Bright colors and simple design make it look like a school tool.
A computer with a screen, keyboard, and mouse. Bright blue case with silver accents. Keyboard has letters and numbers. Mouse is small with a scroll wheel. Screen shows a desktop with icons.

A bright blue school bag with a yellow stripe down the side. It has a front zipper pocket, adjustable shoulder straps, and a small logo on the front. The top has a flap with a buckle closure. It looks sturdy and ready for school.

A yellow school bus with black stripes, large windows, and a rounded front. It has a metal roof, black wheels, and a door on each side. The front has a logo and a driver's window. Bright colors and simple design make it easily recognizable.

A stack of colorful notebooks and papers covered in pencil marks. Crayons, markers, and pens scattered around. A ruler and protractor lie nearby. A backpack hangs on the wall with books peeking out. A clock shows 3:00 PM.

A large wooden desk with a closed book, a pencil, and a ruler. A clock shows 10:00. A blackboard with writing. A teacher's chair in the corner. Bright classroom walls with posters. Window with sunlight coming in.

subcategories.visual_description: A big yellow school bus with windows, a teacher in a blue shirt, kids in backpacks, books, and pencils on a desk, a blackboard with letters, and a playground with swings and slides.

entities.visual_description: A sturdy wooden table with a rectangular top, four legs, and a smooth surface. It has a dark brown color with light wood grain visible. The edges are slightly rounded, and the corners are square. The table is simple and clean, with no extra decorations.

A wooden chair with a curved backrest and a straight seat. It has four sturdy legs and a simple design. The wood is light brown with smooth surfaces. The chair is empty, showing its basic shape and structure.

A cozy sofa with a dark brown fabric, rounded corners, and a soft, plump look. It has a wooden frame with curved legs and a deep cushioned seat. The backrest is slightly sloped, and the arms are rounded and padded.

A wooden bed with a metal frame, four legs, and a mattress on top. It has a headboard and footboard with simple designs. The mattress is soft and slightly indented. The bed is placed in a bedroom with a white wall and a window.

A soft, fluffy pillow with a light blue fabric cover. It has a rounded top and flat bottom, with a stitched edge. The surface is smooth and slightly textured, showing a gentle indentation where it has been used. It looks cozy and comfortable.

A soft, fluffy blanket with a light gray color, covered in tiny white stars. It has a smooth, even texture and a slightly wrinkled surface. The edges are neatly folded and slightly frayed. It looks warm and cozy, perfect for snuggling.

A round lamp with a white shade and a tall metal stem. The base is a dark wooden circle with a small switch on top. The stem has a few small decorative patterns. The shade is slightly curved and has a soft glow.

A fan has a round handle with curved blades. The blades spin quickly, making a buzzing sound. It has a switch on the side. The handle is wooden, and the blades are metal. It sits on a stand with a base. The fan is bright and colorful.

A rectangular box with a screen on the front. The screen is flat and shows images. There are buttons and a remote control slot on the sides. The body is usually black or white. It has a power button and volume controls.

A tall, boxy refrigerator with a silver metallic body and a glass door. The door has a handle and a frost-free panel. Inside, shelves and drawers are visible. The front has brand logos and a digital display.

A tall, boxy appliance with a front panel. It has a door with a handle, a control panel with buttons, and a slot for laundry. Metal body with a white front, round wheels at the bottom, and a hose connected to the back.
A tall, boxy unit with a front panel showing temperature display. It has vents on the top and bottom, a control panel with buttons, and a handle on the side. The body is white with a metal frame.

A microwave has a square body with a glass door. It has a control panel with buttons and a light inside. The top has a turntable. It is usually white or stainless steel. The door opens to show the interior. It has a handle on the door. The sides are smooth and clean.

A tall, boxy oven with a stainless steel front, a glass door, and a control panel. It has a knob for opening, a handle, and a vent at the top. The door shows a glowing interior with heat-resistant glass.

A tall, boxy stove with a metal body and a glass top. It has a handle on the front, a knob for the knob, and a door with a window. The sides have burners and a knob for the knob. The back has a knob for the knob. The top is smooth and shiny.

A white sink with a curved edge, stainless steel surface, and a drain hole at the bottom. It has a faucet with a handle on the left and a spout on the right. The sink is rectangular, sits on a countertop, and has a smooth, clean look.

A smooth, rectangular mirror with a silver surface. Clear glass reflects images perfectly. Straight edges and a thin silver border around the frame. Clean, unmarked, with a polished look. Reflects light and surroundings clearly.

A wall clock has a round face with numbers and a moving hand. It stands on a wooden base. The face is white with black markings. A small glass cover protects the face. The clock has a ticking sound. It shows the time clearly. The hands move smoothly. The base is dark brown. The clock is made of wood and metal. It has a traditional look.

A tall, rectangular door with a wooden frame and a glass panel. It has a metal handle on the right side and a small peephole on the left. The surface is smooth with slight weathering and a painted blue doorframe.

A rectangular opening in a wall with glass panes, framed by wooden edges. Clear glass shows the outside, with a sill below. Handles on the sides, a latch on the top. Bright light shines through from outside.

A white ceramic cup with a blue rim, handle curved at the top, and a spout at the bottom. It has a smooth surface with a few small chips on the body. The handle is slightly thicker than the rest of the cup.

A flat, round plate with a smooth, white surface. It has a slightly curved edge and a rim. The bottom is slightly raised with a pattern of small dots. It's made of ceramic and has a clean, simple design.

A round, shallow container with a wide opening. Made of ceramic, smooth and white. Has a slight curve at the bottom. Handles on either side. Decorated with blue flowers around the rim. Bright and clean.

A long, slender metal utensil with a curved handle and a flat, narrow bowl. The handle has a slight bend, and the bowl is smooth with a rounded edge. It shines slightly in the light, showing its metallic surface.

A long, thin metal utensil with a handle on one end and tines on the other. The tines are straight and evenly spaced, with a slightly curved tip. The handle is often gripped with a hand, and the fork is typically made of stainless steel or silver.

A long, slender blade with a sharp edge, held in a handle made of wood or plastic. The blade is metal, shiny, and straight, with a pointed tip. The handle has a grip area with grooves for a secure hold.

A tall, cylindrical trash can with a hinged lid. It has a metal body with a green paint job. Two handles on the top for lifting. A small footrest at the bottom. A small slot for emptying. A label "Recycle" on the side.

A vacuum cleaner has a long, flexible hose, a round handle, and a curved wand. It features a dust bin on the bottom, a power cord, and a motorized brush. The body is usually black or gray with a sleek, compact design. It has a suction nozzle and a handle with a grip.

A long wooden stick with a flat head, covered in bristles. The handle is smooth and straight, with a small brush at the end. The bristles are stiff and upright, some slightly bent. The whole broom is brown with a worn look.

A long, flat mop head with twisted twine strands, attached to a wooden handle. The head has a sponge-like texture with small holes. The handle is straight, with a grip at the end. The mop is light brown with a slightly worn look.

Red face with wide, angry eyes. Furrowed brow and raised eyebrows. Open mouth showing teeth. Dark, messy hair. Hands clenched into fists. Sweat droplets on forehead. Bright red cheeks. Strong, angry expression.
A small child with wide, tear-filled eyes, mouth open in a silent scream, cheeks flushed red, hair messy and sticking out. Clenched fists, trembling limbs, and a pale face show fear.
A child's face shows surprise. Wide, round eyes with big white pupils. Open mouth, tongue slightly out. Raised eyebrows. Hair stands up. Hands raised in shock. Bright red cheeks.

A calm face with soft, closed eyes and a gentle smile. Smooth skin, relaxed shoulders, and a peaceful expression. Hair flows gently, and the whole body radiates tranquility.

A small child with wide, glossy eyes and a parted mouth, cheeks flushed red, hands clasped tightly in front. Hair is messy and unkempt, eyebrows furrowed, and a slight tremble in the fingers shows anxiety.

A child with wide, tear-filled eyes, mouth open in a silent scream, cheeks flushed red, hair messy and sticking out. Hands clutched to the chest, body hunched forward, eyes darting around, lips quivering, nose slightly runny, and a trembling chin.

Eyes are heavy-lidded and droopy, with dark circles under them. Hair is messy and unkempt. Mouth is slightly open, lips are pale. Skin looks pale and dull. Shoulders are slumped, posture is slouched. Hands are limp, fingers are curled.

Sleepy has big, heavy eyelids that droop low, dark circles under the eyes, and a slightly open mouth. Thick, messy hair falls over the face, and a small, soft smile curves on the lips. The cheeks are pale and round, with a relaxed, tired expression.

Big, round eyes wide with wonder, eyebrows raised high. A small, upturned nose. A mouth slightly open, showing tiny teeth. Hair messy and tousled, sticking out in all directions. A curious look on a face full of excitement and surprise.
Big, round eyes with soft white lashes, wide smile showing tiny teeth, cheeks flushed pink, hair in fluffy puffs, and a bright red heart-shaped badge on the chest.

A tall, clear plastic bottle with a curved neck and a screw-on cap. Bright labels in bold colors show a cartoon character holding a drink. Stripes and dots add fun patterns. The bottle is full and ready to drink.

A soft, glowing figure with closed eyes and a peaceful smile. Its body is wrapped in a fluffy cloud, with gentle waves of light around it. It has a small, round head and floating arms in a resting position. A starry halo surrounds its head, and a gentle breeze flows around its form.

A glowing sun rises over a calm lake, casting warm light across the water. The sky transitions from dark blue to soft pink and orange. Gentle ripples spread from the shoreline, reflecting the vibrant colors of dawn.

A small, round, red ball rolls across the ground, bouncing with each step. It has smooth, shiny skin and moves steadily forward, leaving a trail of tiny marks behind. Its shape is perfectly round, and it glows slightly in the dark.

A small, fast-moving creature with long, slender legs and a rounded body. It has large, expressive eyes and a tail that flicks rapidly. Its fur is short and smooth, with a bright stripe running down its back. It moves with quick, jerky motions, always in motion.

A small, round ball bounces high in the air, glowing with bright yellow light. It has smooth, elastic skin and a tiny, glowing dot at the top. The ball moves quickly, leaving a trail of light behind as it jumps up and down.

A small, round, cushiony seat with soft blue fabric, a yellow stripe around the edge, and a fluffy pillow on top. It sits on the floor, inviting and cozy, with a gentle curve and a smooth, friendly look.

A tall, slender figure with arms outstretched, standing still. Long, flowing robes with intricate patterns. A crown of stars on the head. Eyes closed, face serene. Hands touching the ground. A glowing aura surrounds the figure.

A small, soft plush animal lying flat on its back, limbs spread, belly up. Round, closed eyes. Fluffy fur, slightly flattened. Tiny paws splayed, tail curled. Bright, cheerful colors. Soft, rounded shape. Appealing, relaxed pose.
A small, round, red creature with big, black eyes and a smiling face. It has floppy ears and a stubby tail. Its body is covered in soft, fuzzy fur. It holds a tiny book in its paws.

A glowing, floating hand writes in mid-air, ink trailing like smoke. The hand is pale with glowing blue veins, fingers long and slender, holding a quill that sparkles. The writing glows faintly, forming words in the air.

A small, round creature with big, glowing eyes and a long, flexible tail. It has soft, fuzzy fur in shades of blue and purple. Its arms are short and stubby, and it wiggles happily, drawing shapes in the air with a glowing pencil.

A small, round creature with glowing blue eyes and a soft, pink body. It has four tiny arms and two floppy ears. Its face is wide and smiling, with a tiny nose and a mouth that looks happy. It wears a simple yellow hat.

A person in motion, arms sweeping wide, legs lifting high, body twisting gracefully. Bright colors swirl around them, showing movement. Hair flows like a ribbon, feet light on the ground, face joyful and focused.

A small, round creature with big, curious eyes and floppy ears. It has a soft, fluffy body and a long, wiggling tail. Its face is wide and gentle, with a tiny nose and a smile. Bright, colorful spots cover its body.

A small, round creature with big, glowing eyes and a wide smile. It has floppy ears and a short, stubby tail. Its body is covered in soft, fuzzy fur that shimmers in the light. It holds a tiny microphone in its paws, ready to speak.
A small, round watch with a silver face and glowing green numbers. Thin, black hands move smoothly. A red button at the bottom. A leather strap with a buckle. Bright, clear display.

A small, round creature with big, glowing blue eyes and a fluffy white body. It has tiny wings and a long, floppy tail. Its face is wide and soft, with a smiling mouth and rounded cheeks. It looks curious and playful.

A glowing hand reaches out, fingers spread wide, with soft light radiating from its palm. The hand is pale with faint shimmering lines, like light trails, and has a gentle, inviting glow that surrounds it in a soft halo.

A small, open box with a hinged lid lifted slightly, revealing a soft yellow interior. The box has a smooth wooden surface, rounded edges, and a simple metal handle. Brightly colored stickers cover the front, showing a smiling face and a star.

A close-up of a small, round, red apple with a shiny surface. It has a slight dimple at the top, a green stem, and a few tiny white spots. The skin is smooth and slightly wrinkled, with a juicy, fresh look.
A small, round, red button with a white plus sign. Smooth surface, slightly raised edges. Bright red color, clean and simple design. Looks like a push button ready to be pressed.
A glowing hand reaches out, fingers stretched toward a small, floating object. The hand is pale with faint blue veins, and the object shines with a soft golden light, hovering just out of reach.

A small, glowing orb floats in the air, smooth and round with a soft, golden light. It spins slowly, leaving faint trails of light behind. The surface has a gentle shimmer, making it look like a tiny sun suspended in space.

A small, round, glowing orb with a bright yellow light inside. It floats gently, leaving a trail of sparkling gold dust. Smooth, shiny surface with a soft, pulsing glow. Bright, cheerful, and magical.

Carry is a small, round creature with soft, pink skin and big, curious eyes. It has floppy ears and a tiny tail. Its body is covered in fluffy white fur, and it holds a basket in its paws, filled with colorful items.

A small, glowing orb with soft golden light, floating gently. Smooth, round shape with a faint shimmer. No details, just pure light. Appears to emit warmth and comfort. Bright, gentle glow with a soft, steady pulse.

A small, round, glowing orb with a soft blue light. It floats gently, leaving faint trails of light behind. Smooth, shiny surface with a gentle hum. Bright, swirling patterns inside. Soft, warm glow that changes colors slowly.
A small, round, red button with a white plus sign. Smooth surface, bright colors, simple design. Looks like a basic add button. Clean and clear, easy to recognize.

entities.visual_description: A doctor in a white coat, holding a stethoscope, with glasses and a friendly smile. Hair is neatly combed, and they wear a name tag. The coat has a pocket with a pen and a badge. Their expression is calm and approachable.

A nurse in a blue uniform with a white collar, wearing a name tag and a stethoscope. Short hair, glasses, and a warm smile. Hands in medical gloves, holding a clipboard. Bright scrubs and a red cross emblem on the chest.
A tall adult with a neat haircut, wearing a blue dress and a name tag. Carries a stack of books and a clipboard. Smiles warmly, with glasses and a friendly expression. Has a warm, approachable look.

A student with a backpack, wearing a school uniform, has a backpack slung over one shoulder. Their hair is tied back, and they hold a notebook in one hand. They have a bright, focused look, with a pencil in the other hand. Their face shows concentration and readiness to learn.

A tall police officer in a blue uniform with a white shirt and dark pants. He has a strong face, a shaved head, and a badge on his chest. His eyes are alert, and he carries a baton in his hand. His shoes are dark and polished.

A firefighter has a helmet with a red visor, a thick red coat with yellow trim, black pants, and heavy boots. They carry a hose and have a sturdy, muscular build. Their face is partially hidden by the helmet, but their determined expression is visible through the visor.

A chef in a red coat with a white apron, holding a wooden spoon. Short, curly hair, round face, and a warm smile. Bright eyes, thick eyebrows, and a pot of bubbling soup on the stove. Strong, handsomely built, with a chef’s hat tilted forward.
A farmer has calloused hands, a sunburned face, and a straw hat. They wear overalls, boots, and a faded bandana. Their skin is weathered, and their eyes show hard work. A pitchfork leans nearby.

A driver sits behind the wheel, hands on the steering wheel, wearing a dark jacket and sunglasses. Their face is partially visible, with a focused expression, and a helmet is placed beside them on the seat.

A pilot sits in a cockpit with a headset, hands on controls. Dark jacket, light hair, glasses, and a watch. Strapped in with a seatbelt. Focus on the dashboard and instruments. Sharp features, determined expression.

A flight attendant stands with a uniform, smiling, and attentive. She has a neat ponytail, wears a blue jacket with a white collar, and carries a small tray. Her face is calm, with soft features and bright eyes. She looks approachable and professional.

A construction worker in a bright yellow high-visibility vest, blue hard hat, and steel-toed boots. He wears a red safety harness and carries a tool belt with a hammer, nails, and a tape measure. His face is covered with dust, and he has a beard.

A short-sleeved man with a tool belt, wearing a hard hat and safety goggles. He holds a voltage tester and a wrench. His face shows focus, with a beard and mustache. His clothes are workwear, and he has a tool bag at his side.

A plumper is a person with a tool belt, wearing a yellow raincoat, and holding a pipe wrench. They have a sturdy build, a hard hat, and safety goggles. Their face shows focus, with a beard and a determined look. They stand near a pipe and a ladder.

A mechanic in a yellow high-visibility jacket, wearing thick gloves and safety goggles. Tools hang from a belt. A wrench and screwdriver are in hand. Hair is messy, face is dusty, and boots are muddy.

A tall human with a tool belt, wearing a hard hat and safety goggles. Has a tool box at their feet and is holding a wrench. Clothes are dusty and work-worn.

A person with paint-stained hands, wearing a paint-splattered apron, holding a paintbrush. Their hair is messy with streaks of color, and they have a smudge of paint on their cheek. Brightly colored clothes and a palette nearby.

A musician has a guitar slung over their shoulder, fingers strumming the strings. Their face shows concentration, with a slight smile. Dark hair is tousled, and they wear a band T-shirt. One hand holds a microphone, the other rests on their knee.

A photographer stands with a camera slung over one shoulder. They wear a dark jacket, jeans, and sneakers. Their hair is tousled, and they have a focused look, holding a lens cap in one hand. A tripod leans nearby.

A tall person in a dark suit, wearing a tie and holding a script. Sharp features, neatly combed hair, and a confident posture. Dark glasses and a microphone stand nearby. Professional and focused expression.

A singer stands center stage, wearing a bright red dress with a sequined bodice. Long, flowing hair in a loose bun, eyes closed, hands raised. A microphone in one hand, spotlight shining on face. Smiling, with a confident, expressive look.

A veterinarian has a white coat, glasses, and a stethoscope. They hold a clipboard and a small animal. Their face shows concern, with a warm smile. Hair is neatly combed, and they wear closed shoes. A badge with a paw print is on their coat.

A businessperson in a dark suit, tie, and dress shoes. Sharp features, neatly combed hair, and a confident posture. Wears a watch and carries a briefcase. Has a professional expression with focused eyes.

A mail carrier in a bright yellow jacket with a red logo, holding a brown paper bag. Has a helmet, sturdy shoes, and a friendly smile. Wears a name tag and carries a bicycle.

A tall, stern judge with a white robe, silver hair, and a red robe collar. Sharp features, a strong jaw, and a stern expression. Wears round glasses and has a gavel in one hand. Has a strict, authoritative look with a serious face and a formal posture.

A person in hiking gear stands on a rocky trail. They wear a dark jacket, jeans, and hiking boots. A backpack is slung over their shoulder. Their face is focused, with a cap covering part of their head. They hold a hiking stick in one hand.

A person stands by a lake with a fishing rod in hand. The rod has a reel and a line in the water. A bucket sits nearby with a fish inside. The person wears a hat and sunglasses, with a smile on their face.

A bowling lane with a green felt surface, straight arrows, and a heavy ball. The ball has a smooth surface, a pin at the front, and a handle. Pins are white with black dots. A bowler stands at the end, ready to roll.

A billiards table with a green felt surface, wooden rails, and pockets. Cue ball sits center, surrounded by colored balls. Brass cues lean against the table. Brightly colored balls are arranged in a triangle.

A chessboard with alternating black and white squares, eight rows and columns. Pieces include a king, queen, rook, bishop, knight, and pawn in their traditional designs. Each piece has a distinct shape and color.

subcategories.visual_description: A big red ball bounces on the ground, next to a smiling kid in a blue jersey kicking it. A coach in a green shirt waves a white flag. A yellow cone stands near a green field.

entities.visual_description: A tall, rectangular piano with a dark wooden body, curved top, and a keyboard of white and black keys. It has a polished surface, a metal frame, and a lid that opens to reveal the internal strings and hammers.

A keyboard with white and black keys, arranged in repeating patterns. Brightly colored keys stand out, some with symbols. The top has a row of letter keys. It sits on a stand with a curved surface. The keys are smooth and shiny.

A guitar has a long wooden body with a curved top and a flat back. It has a neck with frets and strings stretched across. The headstock has tuning pegs. There are pickups near the bridge and a soundhole on the top.

names.ja: アコースティックギター (akōsutikku gitaa)

entities.visual_description: A wooden acoustic guitar has a rounded body with a soundhole in the center. It features a neck with frets, a headstock with tuning pegs, and a bridge. The top is often light-colored, and the back and sides are darker, with a carved design. Strings stretch across the fretboard.

entities.visual_description: A bright electric guitar with a sleek black body, glossy finish, and a pointed headstock. It has a solid wood neck with a fretboard, metal strings, and a pickup near the bridge. The body curves slightly, and the controls are visible on the lower part.

A bass guitar has a long, narrow body with a rounded back. It has four strings stretched over a fretboard. The neck is thick and has a pickguard. The headstock has tuning pegs. The body is usually made of wood. It has a soundhole like a violin.

A violin has a long, wooden body with a curved back and a flat belly. It has four strings stretched over a bridge. The neck is thin and has a fingerboard. A pegbox holds tuning pegs at the top. A tailpiece connects to the strings at the bottom.

A cello has a long, curved body with a flat back and rounded belly. It has four strings stretched over a wooden soundbox. The neck is thin and has a fingerboard with frets. The top has a sound hole. It is held between the legs and played with a bow.

A wooden harp with a curved triangular frame, strings stretched across it, and a soundboard at the base. It has a decorative headpiece with intricate carvings and a tailpiece with metal attachments. The strings are made of metal, and the frame is polished and smooth.

A small, wooden ukulele with a rounded body and a curved neck. It has four strings stretched over a fretboard. The top is glossy with a dark wood finish, and the back is lighter, showing the grain. The tuning pegs are at the top, and the sound hole is on the front.

A bright red banjo with a rounded wooden body, steel strings, and a resonator cone. It has a carved head, a fingerboard with frets, and a tailpiece. The strings are taut and shiny, and the instrument has a classic, folk-style appearance.

A drum is a round, hollow cylinder with stretched animal skin on both ends. It has a wooden frame and sturdy straps. The skin is tight and smooth, with a dark, shiny surface. It stands on legs and has a handle for carrying.

A drum set has a bass drum, snare drum, and tom-toms. It includes a kick pedal, hi-hat, and cymbals. The drums have smooth wood surfaces, metal rims, and drumsticks. The set has a sturdy frame and tuning pedals. It looks ready for a performance.

A tambourine has a round frame with metal rings around the edge. It has a drumhead stretched over the center. Straps connect the frame to a strap loop. The instrument has a bright, shiny surface with colorful patterns. It is small and holds a set of small metal discs.

A xylophone has long wooden bars of different lengths, arranged in order from shortest to longest. Each bar is struck with mallets, producing musical notes. The bars are mounted on a resonating frame, often with a curved shape. The instrument has a bright, polished look with smooth surfaces.

A wooden flute with a curved body, six finger holes, and a narrow mouthpiece. It has a smooth, polished surface with light wood grain. A small metal tuning plug is at the top, and the end is slightly tapered.

A wooden recorder with a curved body, smooth surface, and a small hole at the top. It has a rounded end and a handle, with a mouthpiece at the front. The instrument is light brown, with faint carvings along its length.

A clarinet has a long, narrow wooden body with a curved shape. It features a mouthpiece, a barrel, and a bell. Keys and pads cover the holes. It has a straight, metal tube with a curved end. The body is often dark with polished wood grain.

A saxophone has a curved metal body with a mouthpiece at the top. It has a long neck, a bell at the end, and a series of keys along the body. The body is usually silver or brass, with a smooth, shiny surface. It has a flexible neck and a curved shape.

A bright yellow trumpet with a curved body, silver tubing, and a flared bell. It has a mouthpiece at the end, a valve section with three pistons, and a handle for support. The surface is smooth with polished metal and a glossy finish.

A large brass trombone has a long, curved slide, a flared bell, and a straight, cylindrical body. It features a mouthpiece, valves, and a handle. The surface is shiny with a metallic sheen, and the tubing is smooth and polished.

A large, curved metal tube with a flared bell at the end. It has a piston valve and a mouthpiece. The instrument is shiny, with bold engravings and a sturdy frame. It stands tall, ready to produce deep, resonant sounds.

A small wooden box with a metal reed inside. It has a curved mouthpiece and a handle. The body is rectangular with holes along the top. It's simple, with a smooth surface and a few metal parts visible.

A long, folded accordion with a curved metal frame, wooden body, and a row of buttons on top. It has a bellows in the middle and a keyboard on the bottom. Brightly colored, with a handle on one side and a strap loop on the other.

A bagpipe has a curved wooden body, a leather bag, and a mouthpiece. It has pipes with reed holes and a drone. The pipes are made of wood or metal. It has a bellows and a blowpipe. The instrument has a traditional look with carved details.

Two hollow tubes connected at the center, covered in colorful beads and shells. Each end has a small drumhead stretched over a wooden frame. The whole instrument is wrapped in bright, shiny fabric with tassels hanging down.
A bright yellow triangle with a smooth, curved edge. It has a long, thin neck and a wide base. The triangle is made of metal and has a small hole near the top. It hangs from a thin string.

Two metal discs attached to a single rod, each with a curved edge and a central hole. The discs are slightly concave, with a polished surface and a bright, shiny finish. The rod is straight and sturdy, connecting the two discs at their centers.

A large round drum with a stretched animal skin stretched over a wooden frame. It has a curved edge and a central hole. The skin is taut and smooth, with a dark color and light markings. The frame is sturdy and has a handle on one side.

A microphone has a long, slender body with a round front end. It has a flexible cable attached at the bottom. The top has a small button and a mesh grille. It is usually held in one hand. The body is often black or silver. It looks like a small tube with a mouthpiece.

subcategories.visual_description: A big red drum with shiny black drumsticks, a green guitar with a curved body, a yellow triangle with a pointy tip, and a blue xylophone with wooden bars. All instruments are colorful and easy to touch.

categories.visual_description: A colorful book with big letters, a crayon drawing of a sun, a pencil, and a ruler on a table. Bright colors and simple shapes show learning and creativity.
